title: Senior Software Engineer - Egress (Go/Rust)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>Lisbon, Portugal </li> <li>London, UK </li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Egress team was formed to own a very important aspect of Cloudflare's network-as-a-service: Egress connectivity for our vast portfolio of products.</p> <p>As a member of the Egress team, you will be a key technical contributor to a cutting edge network software infrastructure used by a growing number of Cloudflare products to connect to any destination from Cloudflare's network. Among the products powered by this technology is WARP, our Zero Trust platform, and Cloudflare's egress proxy for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/icloud-private-relay/">iCloud Private Relay</a> product.</p> <p>You will work closely with various Engineering teams to translate their requirements into new capabilities on the platform. Likewise you will partner with Network Engineering and SRE to ensure that the technology makes the best use of Cloudflare's world-class edge network.</p> <p>You will participate in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from designing and documenting systems, to writing code and automated tests, to planning, managing, and monitoring production software deployments. You will work with a wide range of technologies and programming languages, including Rust, Go, Linux networking, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Grafana, Kubernetes, and more.</p> <p>Engineering teams at Cloudflare operate a Run What You Build model, including ours. We are responsible for the health of our system and participate in our team's on-call rotation as part of operational responsibilities.</p> <p>Because you’ll be solving problems of massive scale and significance, you are a growth-oriented individual who enjoys being outside of your comfort zone. You are comfortable in a fast-paced but sensible work environment. You value curiosity and empathy and lead with these values.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Make daily progress on assigned engineering tasks, such as designing systems, writing specs, writing team meetings to share progress and collaborate</li> <li>Participate in the team’s on-call schedule to ensure uptime of our production systems</li> <li>Investigating customer issues that are escalated to the Egress team for triage and resolution</li> <li>Responding to questions from other teams in the Egress team’s internal, public chat room</li> <li>Using AI-powered tools and systems as part of your daily workflow to analyze and extend codebases, introspect production systems and datasets, and accelerate problem-solving</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Programming experience in <strong>Go or Rust</strong> and a desire to improve your skills in both.</li> <li>8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including a track record of owning the architecture of complex, distributed, production-critical systems end to end.</li> <li>Demonstrated technical leadership beyond your own code: driving RFCs and design reviews that other senior engineers and teams rely on, and being sought out as a technical escalation point.</li> <li>A solid grasp of networking protocols in Layers 3 and 4 of the OSI Model.</li> <li>Knowledge of HTTP, TLS, and CDN networks.</li> <li>Experience in implementing secure and highly-available distributed systems.</li> <li>Strong ability to debug issues in complex systems.</li> <li>Strong collaboration and communication skills.</li> <li>Experience/interest in HTTP networking and VPN technologies.</li> <li>Experience/interest in network performance monitoring and tuning.</li> <li>Willingness to adopt and integrate AI tools and systems into your engineering workflow.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Knowledge of TCP/IP and Internet routing.</li> <li>Professional systems-level programming experience in Rust.</li> <li>Experience building tools and APIs.</li> <li>Experience with monitoring, alerting, and debugging large-scale distributed systems</li> <li>Experience participating in an on-call rotation.</li> <li>Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code completion, codebase analysis, log/data exploration) in a professional setting.</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="1">● For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - agreements.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="3"><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Solutions Architect - Search Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What Is The Role</strong></h3> <p>At Elastic, we're revolutionizing the search and data analytics space. We're pioneers in the integration of Gen AI, powerful retrieval models like ELSER, and cutting-edge semantic search technologies like vector search, empowering businesses to unlock unprecedented insights and experiences.</p> <p>As a Search Solutions Architect, you'll be at the forefront of this transformative journey. You'll play a pivotal role in designing and deploying innovative solutions that leverage the combined power of these technologies, helping organizations unlock the full potential of their data. Your work will directly influence the success of organizations worldwide, helping them unlock new opportunities and make insightful decisions. </p> <p>Are you ready to join the Elastic Revolution and be a pioneer in the next generation of Search powered AI? Apply now and embark on this exciting journey with us! We're eager to welcome you to a team that's shaping the future and helping organizations unlock the full potential of their data.</p> <h3><strong>What You Will Be Doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Architect next-generation search solutions: Design and implement cutting-edge solutions utilizing Elastic's latest advancements in AI, semantic search, and vector search, including RAG, vector databases, and other emerging technologies.</li> <li>Harness the power of ELSER: Enable organizations to achieve unparalleled accuracy and efficiency in their search queries and data retrieval processes, leveraging the capabilities of the Elastic Learned Sparse Encoder.</li> <li>Unlock the potential of vector search: Implement powerful vector search algorithms and create high-dimensional vector representations of data, allowing users to find the information they need even with imprecise queries.</li> <li>Deliver compelling proof-of-concept (POC) projects: Showcase the combined value of AI, semantic search, vector search, and ELSER through successful POCs, demonstrating the potential for improved search relevance, user experience, and decision-making.</li> <li>Become a thought leader and evangelize our vision: Share your expertise through presentations, blog posts, and other channels, positioning Elastic as the leader in AI-powered search and semantic data exploration.</li> <li>Cultivate a collaborative environment within the Solutions Architecture team and across departments, promoting knowledge sharing and driving continuous improvement.</li> <li>Collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, data scientists, and industry experts who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of search and AI-powered solutions.</li> <li>Continuously learn and explore the ever-evolving landscapes of AI, semantic search, vector search, and related technologies, ensuring your solutions are always at the forefront of innovation. We provide access to world-class training programs and cutting-edge technology.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in designing and architecting enterprise-level search solutions.</li> <li>Deep understanding of AI and semantic search technologies, with a focus on RAG, vector search, and NLP.</li> <li>Familiarity with emerging ecosystem technologies and how they interoperate like Hugging Face, Langchain, etc.</li> <li>Solid knowledge of ELSER's architecture and other models within the Hugging Face ecosystem.</li> <li>Experience with vector databases and other emerging data storage solutions.</li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to engage both technical and non-technical audiences. We think of it like this, “ You may be speaking to a developer in the morning, an architect in the afternoon and an executive buyer in the evening.”</li> <li>Collaborative spirit and a passion for sharing knowledge and expertise.</li> <li>Unwavering commitment to continuous learning and staying ahead of the curve in technology and emerging trends.</li> <li>Fluency in Spanish would be an advantage. </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>#LI-PF1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.</p> <p>We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary</li> <li>Health coverage for you and your family in many locations</li> <li>Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles</li> <li>Generous number of vacation days each year</li> <li>Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service</li> <li>Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love</li> <li>Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email </span><span style="font-weight: ----- style="font-weight: 400;"> We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.</span></p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below:</span> <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/fmlaen.pdf" target="_blank">Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)</a> <span style="color: #000000;">Poster;</span><span style="color: #000000;"> <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/ofccp/pdf/pay-transp_%20English_formattedESQA508c.pdf" target="_blank">Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision</a> Poster; </span><a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/eppabw.pdf" target="_blank">Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA)</a> <span style="color: #000000;">Poster and <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/OFCCP/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights.pdf" target="_blank">Know Your Rights</a> (Poster)</span></p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Elasticsearch develops and distributes encryption software and technology that is subject to U.S. export controls and licensing requirements for individuals who are located in or are nationals of the following sanctioned countries and regions: Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria, the Crimea Region of Ukraine, the Donetsk People’s Republic (“DNR”), and the Luhansk People’s Republic (“LNR”). If you are located in or are a national of one of the listed countries or regions, an export license may be required as a condition of your employment in this role. Please note that national origin and/or nationality do not affect eligibility for employment with Elastic.<br></span></p> <p>Please see <a href="https://www.elastic.co/legal/applicant-privacy-statement" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.elastic.co/legal/applicant-privacy-statement&source=gmail&ust=1611068262479000&usg=AFQjCNG3orAPk5sJIr9WVm0ZDxYw82c5DA">here</a> for our Privacy Statement.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Information Security Infrastructure Engineer - Security Architecture - InfoSec
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What is The Role :</strong></h3> <div class="p" data-block="true" data-editor="pi9d" data-offset-key="6hmd4-0-0"> <div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" style="text-align: justify;" data-offset-key="6hmd4-0-0"><span data-offset-key="6hmd4-0-0"><span data-text="true">Join the </span></span><span data-offset-key="6hmd4-0-1"><span data-text="true"><strong>InfoSec - Security Architecture</strong> </span></span><span data-offset-key="6hmd4-0-2"><span data-text="true">team as a </span></span><strong><span data-offset-key="6hmd4-0-3"><span data-text="true">Senior Information Security Infrastructure Engineer</span></span></strong><span data-offset-key="6hmd4-0-4"><span data-text="true">, where you'll have the chance to play a key role in protecting our organization's data and systems. This position offers the opportunity to work on meaningful projects that directly impact our security posture and collaborate with a skilled team passionate about information security.</span></span></div> <div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" style="text-align: justify;" data-offset-key="6hmd4-0-0"> </div> </div> <div class="p" data-block="true" data-editor="pi9d" data-offset-key="45je2-0-0"> <div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" style="text-align: justify;" data-offset-key="45je2-0-0"><span data-offset-key="45je2-0-0"><span data-text="true">In more details: We ingest the security telemetry that the whole security org runs on. In this role you'll get that telemetry into Elasticsearch consistently and keep the underlying Elastic clusters healthy. You own the pipeline end to end: from a new security data source landing, through ingest pipelines, into the indices detection, IR, and consulting teams query, plus the clusters that store it all. </span></span></div> </div> <h3><strong>What You Will Be Doing :</strong></h3> <ul> <li class="public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-reset public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="pi9d" data-offset-key="ero1a-0-0"> <div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="ero1a-0-0"><span data-offset-key="ero1a-0-0"><span data-text="true">Security telemetry ingestion - build and maintain ingestion of security-relevant data into Elasticsearch (cloud provider audit logs, identity/SaaS activity, endpoint and asset data). This means integrating with third-party and cloud provider APIs to pull telemetry: auth, pagination, rate limits, and handling schema changes. title: Director, International Delivery Management - Professional Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><p><strong>What is The Role</strong></p> <p>Elastic is looking for an exceptional delivery consulting leader — someone who has built and run international delivery organisations, understands how to drive bookings growth and revenue expansion inside complex enterprise accounts, and can operate at the highest levels of client engagement while simultaneously leading and transforming a mid-sized, globally distributed team.</p> <p>You will own the international Delivery Management function across Elastic Professional Services — leading the team, driving the transformation, and acting as the senior client presence on our most strategic engagements. You will be accountable for both the operational health of the delivery organisation and the commercial outcomes it generates: bookings, revenue, and margin across EMEA and APJ.</p> <p><em>Delivery excellence is your foundation. Commercial growth is your north star. Building the team that industrialises both — and equips it for an AI-enabled future — is your legacy.</em></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What You Will Be Doing </strong></p> <p><strong>International Delivery Organisation — EMEA & APJ</strong></p> <p>▸  <strong>Own and lead the international Delivery Management function</strong>  a team of ~15 Delivery Managers today, distributed across global delivery hubs in EMEA and APJ — with a clear mandate and expectation to scale substantially through 2027 and 2028 as the practice grows and demand accelerates across both regions.</p> <p><strong>▸  Drive a team transformation </strong>— reframing how Delivery Managers operate, shifting from project execution to outcome-led consulting, equipping the team to hold more strategic client conversations and drive greater account value.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Champion and drive the adoption of Fixed Price engagement models</strong>  leading the organisation through the commercial, contractual, and delivery discipline required to scope, price, and execute fixed-price engagements with confidence, especially with platform migrations — protecting margin while driving predictable, high-quality client outcomes.</p> <p>▸  Build a dual-mode delivery capability that operates with excellence across two distinct motions:</p> <p><strong>①  Packaged Solutions</strong>  —  fast, repeatable, industrialised delivery of high-value outcome-based offerings at scale — anchored in Fixed Price commercial models.</p> <p><strong>②  Transformative Engagements</strong>  —  large, complex migrations and solution delivery that require senior delivery governance, deep client partnership, and adaptive programme leadership.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Lead the integration of AI into the Delivery Management function</strong>  identifying and embedding AI-powered tools and practices that improve team productivity, sharpen delivery insight, and — critically — enrich the client experience by enabling more proactive, personalised, and higher-value engagement throughout the delivery lifecycle.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Design and embed delivery standards, frameworks, and tooling</strong> — including AI-augmented capabilities — that enable the team to scale both delivery modes without sacrificing quality or client outcomes.</p> <p><strong>▸  Act as a player-coach</strong> — maintaining direct governance oversight on the most complex or at-risk international engagements, intervening and course-correcting where needed.</p> <p><strong>▸  Build a coaching and development culture within the team</strong> — raising the floor on delivery craft and the ceiling on consulting commerciality across every region working closely with the Regional Services Directors, to generate new opportunities on the back of outstanding delivery. </p> <p><strong>Financial Leadership & Commercial Growth</strong></p> <p>▸  <strong>Own financial accountability across the international delivery portfolio</strong>  driving consulting bookings growth from delivery, maximising revenue realisation from engagements, and actively improving delivery margin through disciplined engagement management, Fixed Price adoption, and commercial rigour.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Grow the consulting footprint</strong> within a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts across EMEA and APJ, driving land-and-expand value outcomes in close partnership with regional Sales organisations.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Build and sustain C-level and VP-level executive relationships</strong> that extend beyond the project — becoming the trusted advisor clients return to for their most important decisions.</p> <p>▸ <strong> Develop compelling value narratives</strong> that articulate the value of engaging Elastic's consulting services, influencing renewal, expansion, and new commercial commitments.</p> <p>▸ <strong> Partner with Regional Services Directors on pipeline development</strong> — acting as a senior consulting delivery voice in pre-sales conversations, solution framing, and commercial structuring including Fixed Price proposals.</p> <p><strong>Cross-Functional & Organisational Impact</strong></p> <p>▸  Serve as the connective tissue between Consulting, Sales, Customer Success, and Product when driving an engagement — ensuring a unified client experience and shared accountability for outcomes across EMEA and APJ.</p> <p>▸  Contribute to the evolution of Elastic's delivery consulting go-to-market: methodology design, packaged solution development, delivery model innovation, AI-enabled tooling, and commercial frameworks.</p> <p>▸  Represent Elastic Professional Services at the senior leadership level — internally and externally — with the credibility and presence to influence how the organisation grows internationally.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What You Bring </strong></p> <p>▸  <strong>International enterprise leadership</strong>  Proven track record building and leading delivery teams across EMEA and/or APJ. You understand how regional culture, client expectations, and hub-based delivery dynamics shape outcomes.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Fixed Price engagement expertise</strong>  You have designed, sold, and delivered Fixed Price consulting engagements at scale. You understand the scoping rigour, risk management, and delivery discipline required to make this model work — and you have driven its adoption across a delivery organisation.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Financial accountability</strong>  You have owned a P&L or delivery portfolio with direct accountability for bookings, revenue, and margin — and you have a track record of improving all three.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Dual-mode delivery experience</strong>  You have designed and operated delivery models that handle both high-velocity repeatable engagements and complex, multi-stakeholder transformations — simultaneously.</p> <p>▸  <strong>AI fluency in a delivery context</strong>  You have a clear point of view on how AI can transform delivery management and client engagement — and you have practical experience applying AI tools to improve team effectiveness, delivery quality, or customer outcomes.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Commercial acumen</strong>  You have expanded client accounts, shaped SOWs, and driven revenue growth from within a delivery or consulting organisation. You know how value conversations are won.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Executive presence</strong>  You are credible at the C-suite level across multiple geographies. You have built relationships that outlast individual projects and turned delivery success into long-term strategic partnership.</p> <p>▸  <strong>People leadership at scale</strong>  You have led and transformed mid-to-large delivery teams, building coaching cultures that raise performance and commerciality across a distributed, multi-timezone workforce.</p> <p>▸  <strong>12+ years</strong>  in management consulting, professional services, or enterprise SaaS delivery leadership — with meaningful time spent in both client-facing growth roles and people/org leadership.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Bonus Points </strong></p> <p>▸  Experience industrialising packaged service offerings — creating repeatable, Fixed Price delivery motions from complex, bespoke prior engagements.</p> <p>▸  Hands-on experience deploying AI tools within a professional services or consulting delivery environment.</p> <p>▸  Background spanning pre-sales/solutioning and post-sales delivery — the full consulting lifecycle.</p> <p>▸  Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms (e.g. Elastic, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Databricks) in a consulting or professional services capacity.</p> <p>▸  Agile and hybrid delivery framework fluency in complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments, but with extensive experience of platform migrations / tools consolidation.</p> <p>▸  Certifications (PMP, CSM, or equivalent) are valued, though leadership track record and client outcomes matter more.</p> <p> </p> <p>Elastic's Professional Services organisation is at an inflection point internationally. We are scaling a delivery team across EMEA and APJ — with significant headcount growth expected through 2027 and 2028 — building a dual-mode delivery capability, shifting to Fixed Price engagement models, embedding AI into how we deliver and engage clients, and growing a client base that demands senior, outcome-focused leadership. All at once.</p> <p> </p> <p>This role carries real financial weight and a real transformation mandate. You will have the authority to reshape how an international team operates, the commercial platform to build lasting client partnerships across two major regions, and the executive visibility to influence how Elastic goes to market with its consulting capability globally.</p> <p> </p> <p>If you have built delivery organisations, owned the numbers, led through transformation, embraced AI as a genuine force multiplier, and made Fixed Price work where others haven't — and you are looking for a role where all of it matters — this is it.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our Peo

title: Associate Director, HEOR & Market Access, EU West
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Mavericks Wanted</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p></div><h3><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></h3> <p>You will report to the Senior Director, Head of Market Access, EU West Region and work closely with Medical affairs, Market Access, Commercial locally and globally, to support BridgeBio’s mission of delivering transformative medicines to patients with genetic rare diseases.</p> <p>You will own the value demonstration strategy for our products across the region, and translate it into effective patient access: design each product's evidence generation plan, drive it through to delivery, and align it with pricing and access strategy, starting in France, then extending to the other countries of the EU West region</p> <p>Your main responsibilities include:</p> <p><strong>Evidence generation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and lead natural history studies, cohorts, registries, and analyses of medico-administrative databases (SNDS, BNDMR/ BaMaRa, rare disease network registries)</li> <li>Lead indirect comparisons in the context of single-arm trials and very small patient populations</li> <li>Develop health economic models (cost-effectiveness, budget impact) for France, then for other markets in the region</li> <li>Design real-world data collection frameworks (PUT-RD / data collection protocols) that can be reused for reassessment and in other countries</li> <li>Define the scientific publication and communication plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Study management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Draft specifications, run tenders, and select vendors</li> <li>Convene and lead external scientific advisory committees</li> <li>Secure all required approvals (health data access, ethics committees, regulatory compliance)</li> <li>Manage the administrative, contractual, and budgetary aspects of studies</li> <li>Review and validate all deliverables (protocols, analysis plans, study reports, publications)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Value communication and internal expertise</strong></p> <ul> <li>Translate study results into actionable clinical and economic arguments</li> <li>Drive scientific dissemination (congresses, publications)</li> <li>Serve as the internal reference point on epidemiology, health economics, and health data matters</li> <li>Build and maintain a network of research agencies, academics, and institutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Value and access strategy</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and own the value demonstration strategy for each product across the region</li> <li>Build economic value propositions and value dossiers and ensure their local adaptation</li> <li>Contribute to pricing strategy and preparation for CEPS negotiations (e.g., positive externalities, budget impact)</li> <li>Coordinate and build the economic modelling and CEESP dossier (early scientific advice, modelling, CEESP submission, technical exchange, etc.)</li> <li>Contribute the health-economic and RWE content of early access dossiers and submissions to the Transparency Committee, in coordination with the Market Access Director, with progressively increasing ownership of Benelux dossiers</li> <li>Anticipate assessors' objections and build responses ahead of submission</li> </ul> <p><strong>French rare disease ecosystem</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build working relationships with rare disease networks, reference and competence centres, patient associations, and learned societies</li> <li>Negotiate collaborations with existing registries and cohorts</li> <li>Contribute to documenting the patient journey and disease burden</li> </ul> <p><strong>Function leadership and development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and arbitrate the region's HEOR and RWE budget</li> <li>Structure the function (methods, quality standards, vendor panel, review processes)</li> <li>Recruit and manage future team members</li> <li>Represent the region to global HEOR and Market Access teams</li> </ul> <p>The above list of tasks is not exhaustive.</p> <h3><strong><u>Where You’ll Work</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>This is a France-based role</li> <li>Travel within France, a priority country, is expected, as is travel to our international office in Zug, Switzerland, for team alignment and engagement.</li> <li>Travel to other countries in the EU West region may also be required. Local team meetings and the designated office location in France are in the Paris area.</li> </ul> <h3><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><span class="TextRun Underlined SCXW398674 class="List-kOVW5V UnorderedList-nqKD7g"> <li class="ListItem-ncLgmg">7–10 years of experience in HEOR, real-world evidence (RWE), or market access within industry, biotech, or specialized This role requires effective collaboration with cross-functional colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure high-quality execution and impact. title: Senior Product Designer, Platform (Geospatial)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:  </strong></p> <p>The design team at Planet is looking for a Senior Product Designer to shape Planet's platform experience (insights.planet.com - free trial available). In this role, you will be responsible for defining the core user journeys across our platform, addressing the needs of different user types (from admins, to developers, to end users). With a relentless focus on those users, you will define jobs-to-be-done and design end-to-end user flows across web frontends and agentic workflows. You will collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to decompose these workflows into scalable, reusable UX building blocks, ultimately crafting a cohesive, user-centric platform experience.</p> <p>The perfect candidate brings a track record of designing sophisticated, data-heavy geospatial applications. This role is full stack, in the design sense: you take a problem from discovery with users all the way to designing and building the interfaces, side by side with our engineers. </p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin or Haarlem office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Product Design Ownership: Lead the end-to-end process from discovery and prototyping to high-fidelity design.</li> <li>Geospatial Interface Design: Create intuitive, powerful geospatial interfaces that translate complex data into actionable insights. </li> <li>User Research: Gather feedback and conduct user interviews in close collaboration with product partners.</li> <li>UI Architecture: Define and architect the interaction patterns and design system for Planet’s platform.</li> <li>Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with product and engineering to ensure top-tier design quality.</li> <li>Culture: Help build and elevate Planet's design culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years designing complex digital products, with a track record of shipping technical, SaaS, or B2B software end to end. </li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in design or an equivalent field.</li> <li>A portfolio with geospatial or data analytics work: interactive maps, layered geospatial data and time series (time sliders, change over time, comparisons), plus the statistics and charts that turn data into an insight. </li> <li>Solid core craft in UX/UI, interaction design, prototyping, accessibility, and visual design, plus Figma and enterprise design systems.</li> <li>An AI-native way of working. You can prototype in code with AI coding assistants, and you're comfortable with Git and merge requests. </li> <li>Research you run yourself: user interviews and usability testing, synthesized into clear product direction.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity. You take vague, complex problems and drive them to a validated solution without daily oversight.</li> <li>A dynamic, iterative, low-ego way of working with PMs, engineers, and other designers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience designing for developers, data scientists, or AI agents.</li> <li>Hands-on with remote sensing analysis and familiarity with geospatial standards.</li> <li>You enjoy meeting customers and are open to travel within Europe.</li> <li>Experience helping a team adopt new ways of working.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.</p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off </li> <li>Employee Wellness Program </li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity </li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong></p> <p>The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Netherlands Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€66.600</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€83.300 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance<br></strong>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Why we care so much about Belonging. <br></strong>We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride. </p> <p><strong>EEO statement: <br></strong>Planet is committed to building a community where everyone belongs and we invite people from all backgrounds to apply. Planet is an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12.pdf">Know Your Rights.</a></p> <p><strong>Accommodations: <br></strong>Planet is an inclusive community and we know that everyone has their own needs. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the hiring process, please reach out to ----- or contact your recruiter with your request. Your message will be confidential and we will be happy to assist you.</p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy</strong>: By clicking "Apply Now" at the top of this job posting, I acknowledge that I have read the <a href="https://www.planet.com/privacy/#california">Planet Data Privacy Notice for California Staff Members and Applicants</a>, and hereby consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of my personal information as described therein.</p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy (European Applicants):</strong> By clicking "Apply Now" at the top of this job posting, I acknowledge that I have read the <a href="https://www.planet.com/privacy/">Candidate Privacy Notice GDPR Planet Labs Europe</a>, and hereby consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of my personal information as described therein.</p> <p><strong>AI in Our Interviewing Process</strong>: Planet is committed to providing an exceptional interview experience for all candidates. We currently use <a href="https://www.metaview.ai/" target="_blank">Metaview</a> to better focus on candidates and less on trying to capture notes. As such, with the candidate's consent, select interviews may be recorded and include a "Planet AI Notetaker" for transcription and summarization purposes. Should an interview involve use of AI interview technologies, the candidate will receive notification and have the ability to opt out both in advance and/or real-time. Opting out will not affect one's candidacy.</p> <p><strong>Candidate AI Policy</strong>: Planet embraces Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools, and we encourage its responsible use. We understand that candidates may use various resources, including AI tools, to <em>prepare</em> for interviews and assessments. However, <em>during any live interview stage or when actively completing assessments for this position, the use of AI tools—e.g. Large Language Models (LLMs), deep fake technology, etc.—is strictly prohibited unless explicitly prompted by an interviewer or assessment instructions</em>. If you are unsure about acceptable use, please contact your recruiter for clarification. If an AI tool or similar technology is desired as an accommodation, please contact ----- with your request for assistance. Your message will be confidential, and we will be happy to assist you. Violation of this policy may result in disqualification of your application.</p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Value Engineer - Supply Chain
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p>The position of the <strong>Senior Value Engineer</strong> is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.</p> <p><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p>You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.</p> <p><strong>The work you’ll do:</strong><strong><br><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Identify & Frame Value</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases</li> <li>Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers </li> <li>Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive</li> </ul> <p><strong>Realize Value</strong></p> <ul> <li>Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement</li> <li>Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives</li> <li>Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives</li> </ul> <p><strong>Scale Value</strong></p> <ul> <li>Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing</li> <li>Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion</li> <li>Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The qualifications you need:</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Live for Customer Value: </strong>Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: </strong>Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP),  experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of <strong>Python</strong> and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.</p> <p><strong>Process Improvement & Value Realization: </strong>Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures,  being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value</p> <p><strong>Project Management: </strong>Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.</p> <p><strong>Executive Stakeholder Management: </strong>Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.</p> <p><strong>Business Domain Expertise: </strong>Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)</p> <p><strong>Industry Expertise: </strong>Ideally expertise in Aviation/Logistics/Transportation and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities  <strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Degree: </strong>In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Pioneer Innovation:</span> Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Ownership from Day 1:</span> Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Unrivaled Family Support:</span> Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Work-Life Integration:</span> Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Continuous Growth:</span> Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Holistic Well-being:</span> Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Drive Sustainability:</span> Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Global Inclusion & Belonging:</span> Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Value-Driven Impact:</span> Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1264">Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1982">Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _ect4ttxp _2rkolb4i _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YR5oRJGhJYg&list=PLuVor-ZUD4pnM6G33C5D0tjXUvlTPYBRe" data-renderer-mark="true" data-is-router-link="false" data-testid="link-with-safety">video</a>.</p> <p><strong>Celonis Inclusion Statement:</strong></p> <p>At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Your Privacy:</strong></p> <p>Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ <a href="https://www.celonis.com/careers/candidate-notices">Accessibility and Candidate Notices</a></p> <p>By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our <a href="https://www.celonis.com/careers/privacy-notice/">Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process</a>.</p> <p><strong>Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools</strong><br><br>We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptio

title: Senior Data Scientist, Workforce Management Analytics
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2><strong>About the Support Group</strong></h2> <p>As the name Support Group implies, this group is responsible for the core part of the customer experience journey that has got Wolt top-notch ratings in app stores. </p> <p>During the years we’ve invested a lot in the in-house built support tooling as we believe that it’s the only way we can ensure the satisfaction of all of our customers and partners in each of the 25 countries that we operate in. We take huge pride in our customer operations’ quality, so on top of building delightful support experiences in our consumer app we also want to proactively identify and solve issues even before our customers and partners even notice something might be wrong.</p> <h2><strong>About the Support Analytics Team</strong></h2> <p>Our Support Analytics team’s main goal is to deliver an amazing Customer, Merchants & Courier support experience while optimizing our operations by providing actionable insights and quantifying the impact of those actions on the overall business. 💡 </p> <p>You’ll be part of this team working with top Data Science and Analytics Engineering professionals.</p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.</p> <p>Your job will mainly focus on driving operational efficiency with the <strong>Workforce Management (WFM) </strong>team and optimizing resource allocation by creating accurate scheduling and intraday forecasts, simplifying forecasting processes, building and supporting KPI dashboards, conducting root cause analysis for SLA improvements, exploring cost optimization opportunities, managing the capacity plan framework, enhancing the WFM data pipeline, and uncovering data-driven insights to refine planning, scheduling, reporting, and intraday management.</p> <h2>Our humble expectations</h2> <p>Required:</p> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years of experience</strong> in a data science or analytics position</li> <li>Experience building<strong> forecasting models and time series analysis</strong> (Prophet, SARIMA, Holt-Winters or similar)</li> <li>Experience in<strong> Cost Analysis and What-if Scenario Analysis</strong></li> <li>Deep knowledge of statistical packages in <strong>Python or R</strong></li> <li>Proficiency in writing structured and efficient<strong> SQL queries</strong> for large data sets</li> <li>Ability to<strong> influence and advise senior stakeholders </strong>Good to have:</li> <li>Experience using ML for forecasting</li> <li>Experience working with ML engineers/ML platform</li> <li>Building data pipelines using Airflow or similar tools</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li>The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. title: AI Platform Engineer
description: <h1>In a nutshell </h1> <p>Picnic is building a new generation of intelligent shopping experiences and fulfillment automation with AI. In our app, we help customers search in their own words, plan meals around their household and shop effortlessly. In our supply chain, automation helps us deliver efficiently and sustainably. </p> <p>As an AI Platform Engineer, you’ll build the tools and infrastructure to take AI from experiment to dependable production system: model access, tracing, evaluation, fine-tuning and low-latency serving. You'll set the technical direction for how engineers build with AI, working closely with product teams across search, personalisation, and fulfillment automation.</p> <h1>Tricks of the trade</h1> <p><strong>Provide an environment in which agents run at optimal cost: </strong>Evolve our AI Gateway with provider integrations, model routing, fallbacks, rate limits, privacy controls, and cost attribution.</p> <p><strong>Standardise LLM tracing, evals and benchmarking:</strong> Build end-to-end tracing, evaluation, and production monitoring across prompts, models, retrieval, tools, and agent state. Help teams turn human judgement and customer outcomes into repeatable evaluation sets.</p> <p><strong>Productionize open-weight models:</strong> Create the path to fine-tune, evaluate and serve open-weight models. Support real-time inference and high-throughput batch workloads, and make latency, performance and cost trade-offs visible.</p> <p><strong>Build a paved path for getting agents to run in production:</strong> Enable developers by providing clear APIs, SDKs, templates and local tooling for structured generation, tool use, model experiments and agent workflows. Make the supported path easier than assembling one-off infrastructure.</p> <p><strong>Our Tech: </strong>You’ll work with Python on a daily basis, using frameworks like FastAPI, LiteLLM, OpenAI, Gemini and more. Supporting this core stack are Snowflake, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Helm, Terraform, Vault, and Datadog. Our open-weight training and serving stack is one of the choices you'll help us make.</p> <h1>We’re looking for</h1> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, AI or a related field</li> <li>Strong backend engineering fundamentals, especially in Python</li> <li>Proven track record building self-service AI platforms and scaling their adoption</li> <li>Experience bringing language models or other ML/AI systems into production with meaningful reliability, latency, security, and cost requirements</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD and observability</li> <li>Able to take end-to-end ownership, make pragmatic build-versus-buy decisions and work effectively across platform, ML/AI and product teams</li> </ul> <p><em>+ Bonus points!</em></p> <ul> <li>Experience with LLM or agent gateways, tool protocols such as MCP, guardrails or policy-aware model access</li> <li>Experience with LLM fine-tuning and serving</li> </ul> <h1>Picnic Perks </h1> <p><strong>🫱🏼‍🫲🏾 Teamwork makes the dream work</strong></p> <p>With more than 80 nationalities across 3 countries, you’ll be part of a diverse company with plenty of cool stuff to get involved with, from board game evenings to after-work drinks to our company ski trip and more!</p> <p><strong>💡 Make a difference</strong></p> <p>You’ll work in an awesome startup environment with the freedom to drive your own projects and create a visible impact. Our fully electric vehicles and sustainable business model mean you’ll also be contributing to making the world a better place! </p> <p><strong>🥗 Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks </strong></p> <p>Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen and chefs. They prepare delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.</p> <p><strong>🚲 Health insurance discount & bike plan</strong></p> <p>We have a partnership with CZ (a health insurance provider). Picnic employees get a discount on CZ insurance packages between 5% and 15%. Furthermore, through our partnership with Lease a Bike, you can rent-to-own a new (e)bike at a discounted rate</p> <p><strong>🌎 Relocation</strong></p> <p>If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs for you and your partner and kids, your first month's rent and moving costs (up to €2000), and help you with the 30% tax ruling setup and application. </p> <p><strong>📆 All the rest </strong></p> <p>At Picnic you get 25 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, as well. </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) indépendant
description: <h1>Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) </h1> <p>Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées</p> <h2>À propos de l’opportunité</h2> <p>Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l’aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.</p> <p>En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d’opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.</p> <p>Vous devrez justifier d’une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.</p> <h2>Vos missions</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Cibler les entreprises locales générant d’importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.</p> </li> <li> <p>Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.</p> </li> <li> <p>Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Établir des relations avec les chefs d’entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.</p> </li> <li> <p>Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d’optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.</p> </li> <li> <p>Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Ce que nous recherchons</h2> <h3>Indispensable</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Au moins un an d’expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l’énergie, les technologies d’entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l’approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des résultats démontrables en matière d’acquisition de nouveaux clients et d’atteinte d’objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.</p> </li> <li> <p>Un bon sens de l’organisation et un suivi rigoureux.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d’expérience et à persévérer.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une bonne compréhension du statut d’indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Atouts</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Un réseau existant de chefs d’entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.</p> <h2>Rémunération</h2> <p>Il s’agit d’une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l’activité des commerçants apportés.</p> <p>Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :</p> <ul> <li> <p>Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.</p> </li> <li> <p>Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.</p> </li> <li> <p>Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.</p> </li> <li> <p>Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.</p> </li> <li> <p>Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d’activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s’appliquer.</p> <p>Les conditions d’éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s’entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.</p> <h2>Formation et accompagnement</h2> <p>Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l’accompagnement des clients.</p> <p>Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.</p> <p>Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d’analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d’organisation.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>About the team:</strong></p> <p>In this role as Engineering Manager for our Verification squad, you will lead the team responsible for identity checks across all of SumUp's markets. This is a high-impact opportunity to guide a team running high-stakes work streams across KYC and a wide range of regulatory environments, in a domain that is both technically complex and central to the customer journey. You will help bring clarity, stability, and momentum to a complex domain, supporting the evolution of legacy-heavy systems into a platform that is increasingly observable, maintainable, and resilient in the face of a fast-changing regulatory landscape. The role calls for strong technical depth and sound engineering judgment, enabling you to lead delivery with confidence while shaping the architecture decisions that will define how verification works at SumUp for years to come.</p> <p>You will work closely with Product, Compliance, and Operations to ensure solutions are practical, safe, and scalable, with regulatory requirements considered early and effectively throughout the development process. At the same time, you will create the conditions for engineers to do their best work by providing direction, support, and space for ownership. Together, you will raise the bar for how verification systems are designed, built, and operated at SumUp.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the Verification Squad as its engineering leader, creating focus and momentum by removing bottlenecks, managing cross-team dependencies, and helping engineers navigate complexity across legacy systems and evolving processes.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product, Compliance, and Operations to translate complex cross-market KYC and KYB requirements into clear engineering outcomes, identifying buildability considerations and regulatory risks early.</li> <li>Drive the technical and organisational improvements that strengthen the squad over time, reducing legacy overhead, improving tooling, and fostering greater shared ownership and sustainable delivery practices.</li> <li>Shape roadmap priorities alongside the PM, ensuring trade-offs are well understood and that compliance requirements and AI-influenced features are properly accounted for.</li> <li>Maintain high standards for how verification systems are built and operated, ensuring flows are observable, failures are controlled, and AI-driven components meet the same bar for reliability, traceability, and auditability as any other part of the system</li> <li>Develop engineers with intention through regular 1:1s, direct feedback, and deliberate stretch opportunities, building a team with strong technical and product judgment</li> </ul> <p><strong>You'll be great for the role if you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A proven track record of leading engineering teams through technical transformation, including large-scale migrations and legacy modernisation.</li> <li>You bring strong technical depth in backend technologies, particularly Go and API/integration architecture, and have hands-on experience with observability, CI/CD, and testing practices</li> <li>You have experience (or a appetite to learn) in KYC/KYB regulatory environments and understand how frameworks like eIDAS interact with product and engineering decisions</li> <li>You combine strategic thinking with hands-on technical credibility, and you communicate with clarity, empathy, and transparency across both technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>You are a solid people leader who develops high performers, addresses underperformance directly and fairly, and
