description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members across UK and India</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>Over 2,800 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3>ABOUT THE TEAM: </h3> <p>The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Threat Detection & Response, and Identity.</p> <p><strong>Product Security</strong> (this role!) consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews to threat modelling and penetration testing, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.</p> <p><strong>Threat Detection & Response</strong> focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.</p> <p><strong>Identity</strong> is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.</p> <p>While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.</p> <h3><br>ABOUT THE ROLE: </h3> <p><strong>As a Senior Product Security Engineer you’ll:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Regularly dive deep into mobile, web app technologies in order to understand feature development and proactively hunt for vulnerabilities</li> <li>Be proficient in securing cloud-native applications, ensuring that security best practices are applied consistently across our cloud environment</li> <li>Be proficient in threat modelling and guide developers in secure design principles to prevent vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place</li> <li>Help remediate vulnerabilities through strategic initiatives, writing patches, or creating understandable and actionable vulnerability tickets.</li> <li>Be the subject matter expert across a wide range of security areas, particularly in Application Security.</li> <li>Make security invisible when possible, believing that gatekeeping and blocking product teams should be avoided in favour of enabling secure development.</li> <li>Mentor and coach junior engineers, sharing your knowledge to help raise the security bar across the organisation</li> <li>Leverage automation and security tools to seamlessly integrate security into our CI/CD pipelines, ensuring vulnerabilities are caught early without disrupting development.</li> </ul> <h3><br>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: </h3> <p>First and foremost you will be passionate about security and resilient software development processes. You will enjoy hunting for vulnerabilities in our web and mobile applications and working with our engineering teams to remediate them strategically. You will be comfortable explaining security issues and concerns to product owners, engineers, VPs and executives and love the feeling you get when this results in them releasing a more resilient product. You will be a keen follower of all things Infosec and constantly be on the lookout for ways to apply new industry trends, tools and automations to your day-to-day role.</p> <p><strong>What makes you a great fit:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a breadth and depth of knowledge across AppSec; you’re expected to understand topics like why private keys should be stored in the Secure Enclave, the differences between URL Schemes and Universal Links, what presigned URLs are in the context of S3 and the safest storage mechanisms for modern browsers.</li> <li>You know Burp Suite (or your favourite attack proxy) inside and out; bonus points if you’ve written or contributed to an extension that enhances its functionality.</li> <li>You have excellent spoken and written communication skills to articulate vulnerabilities clearly and persuasively, advocating for their remediation even when faced with competing production pressures.</li> <li>As a passionate senior security engineer, you have a blog, public speaking engagements, bug bounty profile, or a Git repository showcasing your work.</li> <li>You’re comfortable writing proof-of-concept (POC) scripts to demonstrate your findings and their potential impact, as needed.</li> <li>You have hands-on experience with securing cloud-native applications, ensuring that best practices are consistently applied</li> </ul> <h3><br>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: </h3> <ul> <li>Competitive salary </li> <li>Group Life Insurance </li> <li>Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing</li> <li>24/7 Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days</li> <li>We invest in your development with a £1,000 professional L&D budget per year</li> <li>Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution</li> <li>Spacious brand-new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar</li> <li>Enhanced family-friendly leave</li> <li>3 days for L&D or volunteering time off per year</li> <li>Flexible working options</li> <li>Sabbatical leave </li> <li>Share options</li> </ul> <h3>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. </p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>#LI-MP1</strong></p> <p><strong>#LI-Remote</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. </p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. title: Geschäftsführer (m/w/d) Gebäude-Energieberatung – Aufbau neuer Standort im Umland
company: ENERDOMO Erfurt, Weimar, Gotha, Arnstadt und Sömmerda
description: Haben Sie schon länger über eine berufliche Veränderung nachgedacht? Möchten Sie ein Unternehmen als Geschäftsführer in unserem Franchise leiten und dabei eine Aufgabe übernehmen, die wirtschaftlich attraktiv ist und echten Sinn stiftet? Dann könnte diese Chance für Sie passen – insbesondere, wenn Sie aus einer dieser Regionen kommen: Erfurt Weimar Gotha Arnstadt Sömmerda Gebäude-Energieberatung Die Nachfrage nach Gebäude-Energieberatung steigt stark: Kunden wollen ihre Öl- und Gaskosten senken und Immobilien zukunftssicher sanieren. Gleichzeitig fehlen vielerorts Gebäude-Energieberater – das schafft hervorragende Chancen für Quereinsteiger. Ideal für Quereinsteiger Sie benötigen keine umfangreichen fachlichen Voraussetzungen, um einen gebietsgeschützten Standort aufzubauen. ENERDOMO unterstützt Sie von Anfang an – auch nach der Neueröffnung. Qualifizierung in 27 Tagen In der hybriden ENERDOMO Akademie (Königstein/Frankfurt & Online) erhalten Quereinsteiger ein strukturiertes Einarbeitungs- und Qualifizierungsprogramm. Projektleiter, Ingenieure, Maschinenbauer, Handwerksmeister und Immobilienmakler finden bei uns einen schnellen Einstieg in alle Themen rund um die energetische Sanierung. ENERDOMO Sanierungssprint Ein- und Zweifamilienhäuser werden in 22 Werktagen energetisch saniert. Ein Taktplan steuert die Gewerke, die parallel arbeiten. Die Sanierungssprintkoordination übernimmt Baubegleitung, Bauzeitenplanung sowie die Koordinierung der Gewerke. Zukunftsmarkt mit Sinn „Grüne Jobs“ sind dabei mehr als ein Trend. Umwelt- und Energieberufe gehören zu den wichtigsten Zukunftsmärkten. ENERDOMO gibt Know-how an Existenzgründer und Quereinsteiger weiter, die Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas Eigenes aufbauen wollen. Aufgaben Wir helfen Immobilienbesitzern (privat und gewerblich), Fördermittel für energetische Sanierungen zu beantragen. Dazu erstellen wir einen Sanierungsfahrplan (iSFP) und unterstützen bei den baulichen Maßnahmen. Statt die Arbeit von Architekten, Dachdeckern oder Heizungsbauern zu ersetzen, kooperieren wir eng mit ihnen. Als Geschäftsführer und ENERDOMO-Partner übernehmen Sie dabei folgende Aufgaben: Aufbau Ihrer eigenen, lokalen Präsenz von ENERDOMO, inklusive eines Netzwerkes aus Handwerkern und eventuellen Mitarbeitern Beraten von Kunden zu allen Fragen rund um die Gebäude-Sanierung und verfügbaren Fördermittel Beantragen von Fördermitteln mit oder für den Kunden Vor-Ort Begehung von Gebäuden zur Aufnahme von Gebäude-Daten Erstellung von individuellen Sanierungsfahrplänen (iSFP) in Hottgenroth Erstellungen von Zusatzleistungen wie z.B. Energieausweisen oder Heizlastberechnungen Schreiben von Angeboten und Rechnungen in Lexware Office Qualifikation Ein erfolgreicher Geschäftsführer im Bereich der Energieberatung sollte folgende Qualifikationen mitbringen: Interesse am Energiesektor: Kenntnisse über Immobilien, Produkte und Dienstleistungen sowie die Fähigkeit, sich in dieses Thema einzuarbeiten. Führungserfahrung: Erfahrung in der Leitung von Teams und der Entwicklung von Geschäftsbeziehungen. Unternehmerisches Denken: Fähigkeit, neue Ideen und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten umzusetzen und Verantwortung für den erfolgreichen Betrieb des Standorts zu übernehmen. Finanzielle Kenntnisse: Kenntnisse in Budgetplanung, -analyse und -berichterstattung zur Sicherstellung des erfolgreichen Betriebs. Marketing- und Vertriebskenntnisse: Fähigkeit, erfolgreiche Marketing- und Vertriebsstrategien zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, um neue Kunden zu gewinnen und den Umsatz zu steigern. Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Kunden, Mitarbeitern und Geschäftspartnern zu kommunizieren und zu präsentieren. Sie benötigen: Technisches Verständnis Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit technischen Anlagen Zusätzlich vorteilhaft: Ein Abschluss in einem technischen Studiengang oder einer berufsbildenden höheren Schule. Dies ist jedoch keine Voraussetzung bei ENERDOMO. Wir unterstützen Sie bei der Befähigungsprüfung zum Energieberater. Quereinsteiger: Selbst wenn Sie kein Handwerksmeister, Ingenieur oder Architekt sind, können Sie mit unserer Hilfe die „Qualifikationsprüfung Energieberatung“ erfolgreich ablegen. Benefits Gestalten Sie Ihr eigenes Unternehmen innerhalb eines erprobten Geschäftsmodells Profitieren Sie vom ENERDOMO-Netzwerk: Erhalten Sie die Unterstützung bestehender ENERDOMO-Partner bei fachlichen Fragen und wachsen Sie gemeinsam mit uns in einem aufstrebenden Markt. Unterstützung im Marketing durch die Systemzentrale: Konzentrieren Sie sich ganz auf den Vertrieb und Ihre Kunden Unterstützung beim Aufbringen der Startgebühr und der Finanzierung der Selbstständigkeit mithilfe fachkundiger Inhouse-Beratung durch einen unserer Experten wie zum Beispiel Dr. Arthur Schäfer CO₂ runter, Umsätze hoch! Mit ENERDOMO gestalten wir aktiv die energetische Zukunft der Immobilienberatung. Mit einer starken Marke. Aber noch wichtiger: mit starken Partnern. Deshalb rücken wir am liebsten Menschen wie Patrik Brings ins Rampenlicht. Denn letztlich geht es nicht um Logos, sondern um echte Persönlichkeiten – mit Profil, klarer Haltung und einer echten Story. Warum setzen wir so auf Personal Branding?Weil Menschen am liebsten mit Menschen zusammenarbeiten. Weil Persönlichkeit die besten Kunden anzieht – und gleichzeitig die passenden Mitarbeiter. Weil jeder Partner einzigartig ist und genau das sichtbar werden soll. Patrik hat sich entschieden, Gesicht zu zeigen – heute steht er nicht nur für ENERDOMO, sondern ist die Adresse Nr. 1 in Koblenz, wenn es um energetische Sanierung geht. Brings sagt: „Die Entscheidung für ENERDOMO war eine der besten meines Lebens. Jetzt unterstütze ich Menschen dabei, ihre Immobilien zukunftssicher zu gestalten. Diese Aufgabe ist wirtschaftlich äußerst attraktiv und gibt meinem Leben einen echten Sinn." Du fühlst dich davon angesprochen und tickst ähnlich wie wir bei ENERDOMO – Das Original? title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/d)
description: About Valova We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients. Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs , while most German hospitals already operate at a loss . We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash . Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital , until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe. Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin . Join us! Why this role matters Valova only works as well as it fits into the hospital. Our product creates the most value when it’s deeply connected to a hospital’s systems and built around how coders and medical controlling actually work. Today, connecting to a hospital information system can take months. That’s time hospitals keep losing revenue and coders keep working by hand. That’s where you come in. As Forward Deployed Engineer, you own technical go-lives from start to finish : from the first sandbox to production, from the interface to the workflow on the ward. You’re the bridge between hospital IT, the people who use Valova and our engineering team . Your impact is easy to see: in hospitals that go live faster, in integrations that run reliably, and in a product that gets better with every deployment because you bring back what you learn. This is a hands-on engineering role with real code in production and direct influence on our roadmap. It’s not a support desk, not a pre-sales role and not project management where others do the building. And it’s not a desk job: you’ll regularly be on site in hospitals How the role sits in the team You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on connectors, deployments and internal tooling. With Malte and our product team, you turn what you see in hospitals into clear requirements. In hospital projects, you work hand in hand with our customer success and sales team and on the hospital side with IT leads, KIS vendors, coders and medical controlling. What you will do Bring hospitals live: You take hospitals from sandbox to production, deploy Valova on hospital VMs and connect it to KIS systems such as SAP i.s.h.med, Orbis or Dedalus. Build the connections: You build and maintain interfaces (HL7, FHIR, archive and document exports) together with hospital IT and their partners. Set up Valova for each customer: You configure document types, case filtering, department rules and coding workflows. Learn from the ward: You work on site with coders and medical controlling and turn their friction into clear product requirements. Make deployments repeatable: You write the code that makes the next go-live faster: connectors, scripts, monitoring and internal tooling. Earn the hospital’s trust: You answer technical questions in security and data protection reviews (BSI C5, GDPR). What we are looking for: Engineering experience: At least two years in software engineering, and you’re comfortable with Linux, Docker and basic networking. Integration know-how: You’ve worked on system integrations. Experience with HL7/FHIR or SAP environments is a big plus. Customer focus: You enjoy working with customers and explain technical topics clearly to IT leads and coders alike. High ownership: You move things forward, even when three parties are involved. Travel: You’re happy to spend around 30 percent of your time at hospitals across Germany. Languages: You speak fluent German and English, since our customers work in German. Location: You work from our office in Munich or Berlin. Missing one or two points, but convinced you’re the right person for this role? Apply anyway. We’re looking forward to meeting you! What you get Work that means something, every day. Your agents are the core of our product and directly help improve the German healthcare system. Ownership from week one. You take over real projects with a clear outcome and your name on it, not a list of tasks someone else defined. Direct access to the founders. You work day to day with our founders Sophia, a physician and ex-McKinsey consultant, and Christian, who has founded two health tech startups and spent a decade building clinical systems. No layers, no waiting weeks for approvals. Trust and freedom. We trust you to solve problems your way, and the team has your back 100%. Learning at startup speed. You will see more in one year here than in three years elsewhere, across models, infrastructure, product and customers, with a team that has a proven track record of deploying AI in healthcare. One team, in the heart of the city. We work together on-site at WeWork Odeonsplatz in Munich and WeWork in central Berlin. Fully serviced offices with coffee, meeting rooms and phone booths mean zero admin, and the city-center location means short commutes, easy access to customers and investors, and lunch spots around every corner. Team events that bring Munich and Berlin together, because the people you build with should also be the people you celebrate with. What success looks like After 3 months, you know Valova’s stack inside out and have taken a hospital through its first technical setup together with our team. After 6 months, you’ve taken at least two hospitals live, and a new KIS connection takes weeks instead of months. After 12 months, our deployments are largely repeatable: connectors, scripts and monitoring you built make every go-live faster. Throughout, what you learn in hospitals shapes our roadmap, and hospital IT teams see you as their trusted contact at Valova. How it works Just upload your CV with your application. We’ll get in touch with you for the next steps: Intro call (30 min): We get to know each other, talk about your background and answer your first questions. Technical interview with Christian (CTO) (60 min): We dive into your engineering experience and the integrations you’ve built. Case: You work through a realistic hospital integration scenario and present it to the team. References: We speak with two or three people you’ve worked with, such as former managers or colleagues. Meet the team: You spend a day with us on-site in Munich or Berlin, meet our founders Sophia and Christian and see how we work day to day. Offer: If it’s a match for both sides, you’ll hear from us quickly. We look forward to your application, regardless of gender, background, religion, disability, age or sexual identity. First-principles thinker who writes things down. Default output: a document, not a meeting. Low ego, high bar: able to tell a founder no, with evidence. description: Join the battery cell data revolution⚡ Location: Chemnitz (onsite preferred, hybrid possible) · Position: Full-time · Start: As soon as possible Who We Are 🌍 Limatica measures what batteries whisper. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team. What You'll Do 🔧 Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer. • Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production • Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour. • Make throughput a design decision: Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment. • Ship modules, not scripts: Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers. • Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures. • Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain. • Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing. • Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it. • Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike. Why Limatica 🚀 • Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead. • Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers. • Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options. • Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning • Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud Card and free beverages What it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. Those who help shape the architecture and lead projects independently grow into a senior role with us. title: AI/ML Engineer (f/m/d)
description: About Valova We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients. Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs , while most German hospitals already operate at a loss . We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash . Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital , until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe. Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin . Join us! Why this role matters Our agents are the product. Every case Valova codes runs through agentic systems that read clinical documentation, apply coding rules and justify every decision. How accurate, how fast and how efficient these systems are decides how much revenue hospitals recover and how much time coders get back. As AI/ML Engineer, you own the core of Valova : the agents that turn long, unstructured German clinical documentation into codes a hospital can bill and defend. You decide how we combine large and small models, how we measure quality and how new research makes it into production within weeks, not quarters . Your impact is directly measurable: in coding accuracy, in token costs per case and in hospitals that trust every decision because they can trace it. This is a hands-on engineering role building AI systems in production with real users. It’s not academic research, and it’s not prompt tinkering on the side of a product others build. How the role sits in the team You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on the agent pipeline, infrastructure and evaluation. With Malte and our product team, you translate what is technically possible into product decisions. Our doctors and coding experts are your sparring partners for clinical quality, and our forward deployed team brings back how the agents perform in real hospitals. Du berichtest direkt an Christian, unseren CTO, und arbeitest täglich mit unserem Engineering-Team an der Agenten-Pipeline, der Infrastruktur und der Evaluation. Mit Malte und unserem Produktteam übersetzt Du, was technisch möglich ist, in Produktentscheidungen. Unsere Ärzt:innen und Kodierexpert:innen sind Deine Sparringspartner für klinische Qualität, und unser Forward-Deployed-Team bringt zurück, wie die Agenten in echten Kliniken performen. What you will do Build state-of-the-art agents: You build high-performing agentic systems that define the state of the art in healthcare text processing, while staying efficient in token usage and leveraging small models wherever possible. Make every decision traceable: You ensure every decision and output of our agents is traced, and you monitor their performance in production. Measure what matters: You build the evaluation and benchmarking setup that tells us, on every change, whether our agents got better or worse. Bring research to production: You follow new AI/ML approaches, benchmark promising ideas and make sure the best results reach production within weeks. Shape the product: You use your AI/ML expertise to evaluate future projects and inform product decisions. What we are looking for: Production experience: At least two years building and shipping ML/AI systems in production. LLM and agent expertise: Strong experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks. Engineering depth: Strong proficiency in your primary programming language. Evaluation mindset: Experience with observability, evaluation and benchmarking of ML systems. Product mindset: You care about outcomes that lead to great user experiences and are passionate about using LLMs in real-world scenarios rather than academic research. Nice to have: Experience in healthcare, regulated environments or with sensitive data. Languages: You speak fluent English. German is a big plus, since the clinical documents our agents process are in German. Location: You work from our office in Munich or Berlin. Missing one or two points, but convinced you’re the right person for this role? Apply anyway. We’re looking forward to meeting you! What you get Work that means something, every day. Your agents are the core of our product and directly help improve the German healthcare system. Ownership from week one. You take over real projects with a clear outcome and your name on it, not a list of tasks someone else defined. Direct access to the founders. You work day to day with our founders Sophia, a physician and ex-McKinsey consultant, and Christian, who has founded two health tech startups and spent a decade building clinical systems. No layers, no waiting weeks for approvals. Trust and freedom. We trust you to solve problems your way, and the team has your back 100%. Learning at startup speed. You will see more in one year here than in three years elsewhere, across models, infrastructure, product and customers, with a team that has a proven track record of deploying AI in healthcare. One team, in the heart of the city. We work together on-site at WeWork Odeonsplatz in Munich and WeWork in central Berlin. Fully serviced offices with coffee, meeting rooms and phone booths mean zero admin, and the city-center location means short commutes, easy access to customers and investors, and lunch spots around every corner. Team events that bring Munich and Berlin together, because the people you build with should also be the people you celebrate with. What success looks like After 3 months, you know our agent pipeline inside out, every agent decision is traced, and you have shipped your first improvement to production. After 6 months, our evaluation and benchmarking setup runs on every change, and you have measurably improved coding quality or reduced token costs per case. After 12 months, at least one new approach from research is running in production, and parts of our pipeline run on smaller models without losing quality. Throughout, our AI-related product decisions are grounded in your benchmarks, and the team turns to you when a new model or method comes out. How it works Just upload your CV with your application. We’ll get in touch with you for the next steps: Intro call (30 min): We get to know each other, talk about your background and answer your first questions. Technical interview with Christian (CTO) (60 min): We dive into the ML/AI systems you’ve built and how you evaluated them in production. title: Senior Data Scientist, Workforce Management Analytics
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. About the Support Group As the name Support Group implies, this group is responsible for the core part of the customer experience journey that has got Wolt top-notch ratings in app stores. During the years we've invested a lot in the in-house built support tooling as we believe that it's the only way we can ensure the satisfaction of all of our customers and partners in each of the 25 countries that we operate in. We take huge pride in our customer operations' quality, so on top of building delightful support experiences in our consumer app we also want to proactively identify and solve issues even before our customers and partners even notice something might be wrong. About the Support Analytics Team Our Support Analytics team's main goal is to deliver an amazing Customer, Merchants & Courier support experience while optimizing our operations by providing actionable insights and quantifying the impact of those actions on the overall business. 💡 You'll be part of this team working with top Data Science and Analytics Engineering professionals. What you'll be doing As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role. Your job will mainly focus on driving operational efficiency with the Workforce Management (WFM) team and optimizing resource allocation by creating accurate scheduling and intraday forecasts, simplifying forecasting processes, building and supporting KPI dashboards, conducting root cause analysis for SLA improvements, exploring cost optimization opportunities, managing the capacity plan framework, enhancing the WFM data pipeline, and uncovering data-driven insights to refine planning, scheduling, reporting, and intraday management. Our humble expectations Required: 5+ years of experience in a data science or analytics position Experience building forecasting models and time series analysis (Prophet, SARIMA, Holt-Winters or similar) Experience in Cost Analysis and What-if Scenario Analysis Deep knowledge of statistical packages in Python or R Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets Ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders Good to have: Experience using ML for forecasting Experience working with ML engineers/ML platform Building data pipelines using Airflow or similar tools What we offer The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics. You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote in Berlin. 💙 You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don't learn, we won't stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda's greatest achievement. Next steps The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us! For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash . description: Haben Sie schon länger über eine berufliche Veränderung nachgedacht? Gleichzeitig fehlen vielerorts Gebäude-Energieberater – das schafft hervorragende Chancen für Quereinsteiger. Ideal für Quereinsteiger Sie benötigen keine umfangreichen fachlichen Voraussetzungen, um einen gebietsgeschützten Standort aufzubauen. ENERDOMO unterstützt Sie von Anfang an – auch nach der Neueröffnung. Qualifizierung in 27 Tagen In der hybriden ENERDOMO Akademie (Königstein/Frankfurt & Online) erhalten Quereinsteiger ein strukturiertes Einarbeitungs- und Qualifizierungsprogramm. Projektleiter, Ingenieure, Maschinenbauer, Handwerksmeister und Immobilienmakler finden bei uns einen schnellen Einstieg in alle Themen rund um die energetische Sanierung. ENERDOMO Sanierungssprint Ein- und Zweifamilienhäuser werden in 22 Werktagen energetisch saniert. Ein Taktplan steuert die Gewerke, die parallel arbeiten. Die Sanierungssprintkoordination übernimmt Baubegleitung, Bauzeitenplanung sowie die Koordinierung der Gewerke. Zukunftsmarkt mit Sinn „Grüne Jobs“ sind dabei mehr als ein Trend. Umwelt- und Energieberufe gehören zu den wichtigsten Zukunftsmärkten. ENERDOMO gibt Know-how an Existenzgründer und Quereinsteiger weiter, die Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas Eigenes aufbauen wollen. Aufgaben Wir helfen Immobilienbesitzern (privat und gewerblich), Fördermittel für energetische Sanierungen zu beantragen. Dazu erstellen wir einen Sanierungsfahrplan (iSFP) und unterstützen bei den baulichen Maßnahmen. Statt die Arbeit von Architekten, Dachdeckern oder Heizungsbauern zu ersetzen, kooperieren wir eng mit ihnen. Als Geschäftsführer und ENERDOMO-Partner übernehmen Sie dabei folgende Aufgaben: Aufbau Ihrer eigenen, lokalen Präsenz von ENERDOMO, inklusive eines Netzwerkes aus Handwerkern und eventuellen Mitarbeitern Beraten von Kunden zu allen Fragen rund um die Gebäude-Sanierung und verfügbaren Fördermittel Beantragen von Fördermitteln mit oder für den Kunden Vor-Ort Begehung von Gebäuden zur Aufnahme von Gebäude-Daten Erstellung von individuellen Sanierungsfahrplänen (iSFP) in Hottgenroth Erstellungen von Zusatzleistungen wie z.B. Energieausweisen oder Heizlastberechnungen Schreiben von Angeboten und Rechnungen in Lexware Office Qualifikation Ein erfolgreicher Geschäftsführer im Bereich der Energieberatung sollte folgende Qualifikationen mitbringen: Interesse am Energiesektor: Kenntnisse über Immobilien, Produkte und Dienstleistungen sowie die Fähigkeit, sich in dieses Thema einzuarbeiten. Führungserfahrung: Erfahrung in der Leitung von Teams und der Entwicklung von Geschäftsbeziehungen. Unternehmerisches Denken: Fähigkeit, neue Ideen und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten umzusetzen und Verantwortung für den erfolgreichen Betrieb des Standorts zu übernehmen. Finanzielle Kenntnisse: Kenntnisse in Budgetplanung, -analyse und -berichterstattung zur Sicherstellung des erfolgreichen Betriebs. Marketing- und Vertriebskenntnisse: Fähigkeit, erfolgreiche Marketing- und Vertriebsstrategien zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, um neue Kunden zu gewinnen und den Umsatz zu steigern. Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Kunden, Mitarbeitern und Geschäftspartnern zu kommunizieren und zu präsentieren. Sie benötigen: Technisches Verständnis Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit technischen Anlagen Zusätzlich vorteilhaft: Ein Abschluss in einem technischen Studiengang oder einer berufsbildenden höheren Schule. Dies ist jedoch keine Voraussetzung bei ENERDOMO. Wir unterstützen Sie bei der Befähigungsprüfung zum Energieberater. Quereinsteiger: Selbst wenn Sie kein Handwerksmeister, Ingenieur oder Architekt sind, können Sie mit unserer Hilfe die „Qualifikationsprüfung Energieberatung“ erfolgreich ablegen. Benefits Gestalten Sie Ihr eigenes Unternehmen innerhalb eines erprobten Geschäftsmodells Profitieren Sie vom ENERDOMO-Netzwerk: Erhalten Sie die Unterstützung bestehender ENERDOMO-Partner bei fachlichen Fragen und wachsen Sie gemeinsam mit uns in einem aufstrebenden Markt. Unterstützung im Marketing durch die Systemzentrale: Konzentrieren Sie sich ganz auf den Vertrieb und Ihre Kunden Unterstützung beim Aufbringen der Startgebühr und der Finanzierung der Selbstständigkeit mithilfe fachkundiger Inhouse-Beratung durch einen unserer Experten wie zum Beispiel Dr. Arthur Schäfer Echte Einblicke: Franchise-Partner:innen berichten von ihren Erfahrungen CO₂ runter, Umsätze hoch! Mit ENERDOMO gestalten wir aktiv die energetische Zukunft der Immobilienberatung. Mit einer starken Marke. Aber noch wichtiger: mit starken Partnern. Deshalb rücken wir am liebsten Menschen wie Patrik Brings ins Rampenlicht. Denn letztlich geht es nicht um Logos, sondern um echte Persönlichkeiten – mit Profil, klarer Haltung und einer echten Story. Warum setzen wir so auf Personal Branding?Weil Menschen am liebsten mit Menschen zusammenarbeiten. Weil Persönlichkeit die besten Kunden anzieht – und gleichzeitig die passenden Mitarbeiter. Weil jeder Partner einzigartig ist und genau das sichtbar werden soll. Patrik hat sich entschieden, Gesicht zu zeigen – heute steht er nicht nur für ENERDOMO, sondern ist die Adresse Nr. 1 in Koblenz, wenn es um energetische Sanierung geht. Brings sagt: „Die Entscheidung für ENERDOMO war eine der besten meines Lebens. Jetzt unterstütze ich Menschen dabei, ihre Immobilien zukunftssicher zu gestalten. Diese Aufgabe ist wirtschaftlich äußerst attraktiv und gibt meinem Leben einen echten Sinn." Du fühlst dich davon angesprochen und tickst ähnlich wie wir bei ENERDOMO – Das Original? title: Director, Developer Relations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. You will be accountable for defining the regional strategy, establishing the partnerships and programs required to execute it, and delivering measurable outcomes for the Roblox developer ecosystem.</p> <p>You will build deep relationships with leading developers, studios, publishers, technology partners, and emerging creators while identifying the next generation of high-potential partners for Roblox. You will serve as a senior representative of Roblox within the regional games and technology industries and as an executive-level advocate for the needs and opportunities of developers within Roblox.</p> <p>This role requires both strategic vision and operational leadership. You will translate Roblox’s global priorities into a regional strategy, identify opportunities and barriers to ecosystem growth, and mobilize teams across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Partnerships, Creator, and International to deliver against those opportunities.</p> <h2><strong>You Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in developer relations, games, partnerships, in Europe.</li> <li>Able to influence senior internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Data-driven, strategic, and comfortable operating in ambiguity.</li> <li>Familiar with Roblox Studio, Unity, description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Mirakl:</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.<br><br>Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).<br><br>With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.</p> <p>For more information: <a href="http://www.mirakl.com">www.mirakl.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Mirakl in Numbers:</strong></p> <ul> <li>🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40</li> <li>👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo</li> <li>🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France</li> <li>⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Values:</strong></p> <p>Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.</p> <p>Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:</p> <ul> <li>💡<strong> Work Hard Together:</strong> Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success</li> <li>🏆 <strong>Get Things Done: </strong> We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results</li> <li>🚀 <strong>Go Above & Beyond:</strong>  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence</li> <li>🎓 <strong>Succeed Through Expertise:</strong> Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture</li> <li>🤝 <strong>Satisfy & Empower Clients:</strong> We're committed to our clients' success</li> </ul></div><h2><strong>About the job</strong></h2> <p>Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.</p> <p>You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.</p> <p>As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal</p> <p>This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Why Now, Why Mirakl</strong><strong><br></strong></h2> <p>Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.</p> <p>At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.</p> <p>We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.</p> <p>You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.</p> <h2><strong><br>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <h4><strong>1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders</li> <li>Define the Tech vision and own the agent product roadmap for your domain</li> </ul> <h4><strong>2. Lead AI System Development</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Design and build production-grade AI systems</li> <li>Drive architecture decisions</li> <li>Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability</li> </ul> <h4><strong>3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Work closely with end users</li> <li>Measure adoption and outcomes</li> <li>Accelerate AI transformation across your domain</li> </ul> <h4><strong>4. Establish Technical Excellence</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability</li> <li>Review designs and mentor engineers</li> <li>Raise the quality bar across initiatives</li> </ul> <h4><strong>5. Grow AI Capability</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders</li> <li>Share knowledge and reusable components</li> <li>Build AI expertise within your organization</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Success Metrics</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Business impact delivered by AI initiatives</li> <li>Adoption within the domain</li> <li>Technical quality and reliability</li> <li>Team capability growth</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Our stack and tools</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Languages: </strong>Python and SQL</li> <li><strong>AI Stack: </strong>OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models</li> <li><strong>Agentic & Retrieval: </strong>LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases</li> <li><strong>Infrastructure: </strong>AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>You'll Love This Job If you have </strong></h2> <ul> <li>7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI</li> <li>Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems</li> <li>Ability to influence Product and Business decisions</li> <li>Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives<br><br></li> </ul> <p>Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!<br><br></p> <h2><strong>Want to join us? Here is our process </strong></h2> <ul> <li>A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.</li> <li>An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.</li> <li>2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. title: Product Manager  H/F
description: <h1><strong>Product Manager – Innovation & Design</strong></h1> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Location: Paris (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Imaginez et construisez des produits qui répondent aux vrais besoins des utilisateurs et transforment durablement les services financiers.</strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd"> </p> <p>Capco recherche des <strong>Product Managers</strong> pour accompagner les acteurs majeurs des services financiers et de l'énergie dans la conception de produits utiles à leurs clients et créateurs de valeur pour leur organisation.</p> <p>Au sein de notre capability <strong>Tech, Product & Engineering</strong>, vous intégrerez des équipes pluridisciplinaires réunissant Product Managers, ingénieurs, développeurs et experts métiers.</p> <p>Votre rôle sera de comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, identifier les bonnes problématiques à résoudre et transformer ces insights en produits simples, viables et performants.</p> <p>Vous intégrerez également de manière pragmatique les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés dans vos méthodes de travail pour accélérer la recherche, l’analyse et l’expérimentation, tout en conservant le jugement humain au cœur des décisions produit.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Travailler avec des équipes produit pluridisciplinaires pour identifier les problématiques utilisateurs prioritaires et concevoir des solutions à la fois désirables, viables et techniquement réalisables.</li> <li>Intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et de la recherche utilisateur jusqu’au lancement, à la mesure de la performance et à l’optimisation continue.</li> <li>Combiner études de marché, recherche qualitative, données quantitatives et comportements observés pour construire une compréhension structurée des utilisateurs<strong> </strong>et exploiter, lorsque pertinent, des outils d’IA approuvés pour accélérer l’analyse et faire émerger des insights.</li> <li>Intégrer les contraintes propres aux services financiers – réglementation, risques et contrôles, protection des données et viabilité économique – dans les décisions produit.</li> <li>Piloter le produit par les résultats et la valeur créée pour les utilisateurs et le business, en testant différentes approches plutôt qu’en vous concentrant uniquement sur la production de livrables.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compétences et expériences désirées </strong> </p> <ul> <li>Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en Product Management, acquise au sein d’une entreprise technologique ou d’un cabinet de conseil.</li> <li>Une expérience avérée dans la discovery, la conception et le développement de produits de bout en bout, idéalement sur des expériences web et mobiles.</li> <li>Une bonne maîtrise des méthodologies produit – Jobs-to-be-Done, personas, frameworks de priorisation, KANO, Lean Startup – et des méthodes de delivery Agile.</li> <li>Une capacité démontrée à collaborer avec des designers, ingénieurs/développeurs, équipes métiers et parties prenantes, ainsi qu’à traiter des problématiques complexes à partir de données et d'insights structurés.</li> <li>Une bonne connaissance de la banque et des services financiers, associée à une curiosité pour les usages de l’IA et des workflows AI-enabled permettant d'améliorer la qualité, la rapidité ou la pertinence du travail produit, dans un cadre responsable et avec validation humaine.</li> <li>Vous êtes à l’aise pour travailler en français et en anglais dans des environnements internationaux. </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Pourquoi rejoindre Capco?</strong></p> <p>Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.<br>Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris. </p> <p>Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.</p> <p><strong>Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation – réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel.</strong></p> <p>Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Nos marqueurs distinctifs :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Une spécialisation sectorielle forte</strong><br>Nous apportons à nos clients une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux métiers, en particulier dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux et l’énergie.</li> <li><strong>Une approche collaborative et sur mesure</strong><br>Nous intégrons les équipes clients, adaptons nos méthodes à leur culture et co-construisons des solutions concrètes et opérationnelles.</li> <li><strong>L’excellence comme exigence</strong><br>Notre ambition est d’obtenir des résultats mesurables et durables pour nos clients – et de toujours viser la valeur ajoutée.</li> <li><strong>Un esprit “One Capco”</strong><br>Nos équipes collaborent à l’échelle internationale pour mobiliser les meilleures expertises et partager les bonnes pratiques.</li> <li><strong>Une culture entrepreneuriale et inclusive</strong><br>L’innovation, l’initiative et le mérite sont au cœur de notre modèle. Nous valorisons les idées, la diversité et le progrès collectif.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Nos expertises s’articulent autour de 6 métiers complémentaires</strong></p> <ol> <li>Stratégie & Transformation</li> <li>Finance, Risque & Conformité</li> <li>Product, Innovation & Design</li> <li>Data & Analytics</li> <li>Conseil Tech (Advisory)</li> <li>Engineering (Delivery)</li> </ol> <p> </p> <p><strong>Chez Capco, nous vous offrons :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels</li> <li>Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise</li> <li>Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)</li> <li>Une rémunération compétitive avec un bonus lié à la performance</li> <li>Un PEE avec un abondement de 2903€ par an</li> <li>Une culture d’entreprise entrepreneuriale, inclusive et méritocratique, de nouveau certifiée Great Place To Work</li> <li>Des initiatives pour construire le Capco de demain :</li> <ul> <li>#BeYourselfAtWork</li> <li>Woman@capco</li> <li>RSE (forfait mobilité durable, jour de solidarité, etc.)</li> <li>Des communautés métiers, sportives et culturelles</li> </ul> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Chez Capco Paris, handicap visible ou invisible, parcours atypique ou classique, toutes les candidatures sont les bienvenues et seront traitées avec équité.</p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Analyst, France & Netherlands (12 Month Fixed-Term Contract)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><em>Please note this is a hybrid position from our Paris office. Please submit your CV in English.</em></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Community You Will Join</strong></span></p> <p>The Global Markets Strategic Finance & Analytics team provides budget oversight, reporting, strategic planning and analytical decision making support to the Global Markets team and in-region business teams across EMEA. In addition this team supports identifying and pursuing opportunities to drive growth and business impact for our international business.</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong><br>The Difference You Will Make</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>While your formal reporting structure is into the Director, Strategic Finance & Analytics, EMEA, on a day-to-day basis you will work closely with the cross-functional team that is based in-region. </li> <li>You will directly support Country Managers (and their teams) based around EMEA to drive clear reporting, produce actionable insight, track core KPIs, evaluate investment decisions and work cross-functionally to develop strategies to solve problems.</li> <li>The individual is expected to be a strong cross-functional business partner who has a combination of hands-on analytical skills, financial modelling expertise, commercial acumen, and the ability to package their insights into strong narratives appropriate for senior executive consumption. They will be comfortable working in cross functional teams based in EMEA and around the world including Finance & Accounting, Business Operations, Data Science, Marketing, Product and Supply.</li> <li>The ideal candidate relishes the opportunity to roll up their sleeves to drive meaningful impact, possess strong stakeholder management skills, and is a self-starter that is comfortable with ambiguity in a fast paced global work environment.</li> <li>This person will have a high degree of visibility with senior management within the organization, including Country Managers, Regional and Finance Leaders. </li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong><br>A Typical Day</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Partner with a Country Manager in driving performance management, including development and ongoing analysis of KPIs, creating goals/OKRs and measuring performance.</li> <li>Develop a deep understanding of what levers drive growth and efficiency for our business and translating that into investment cases and initiatives to drive business impact.</li> <li>Partnering with the business on annual planning and budgeting, laying out risks and opportunities and debating strategies and capital allocation to maximise growth.</li> <li>Stepping in to lead EMEA’s monthly business review and speaking to key drivers of variance to goal and potential actions to improve performance.</li> <li>Modelling and summarising the implications of a regulatory action and potential mitigating actions we could take to minimize business impact.</li> <li>Joining a call with the Regional Marketing team to discuss changes to channel or country spend and helping bridge local and regional considerations.</li> <li>Digging into the regional impact of a global product feature and identifying relevant regional insights that could point to local optimization opportunities.</li> <li>Analytical deep dives: Conduct deep dives into business trends across EMEA and different segments of the business. Independently lead data extraction, analysis, visualization, and presentation. </li> <li>Build ad hoc reporting and analysis to help business operations and other cross functional partners understand the drivers of performance for key performance indicators.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong><br>Your Expertise</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of relevant experience. Ideally, you have demonstrated relevant experience in an analytical role such as Strategic Finance, Financial Planning and Analytics (FP&A), Strategy/Management Consulting, Investment Banking or Business Operations. </li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, accounting, engineering, statistics or other relevant field that demonstrates quantitative orientation; MBA or advanced degree a plus.</li> <li>Superb financial modeling and quantitative analysis skills, SQL experience highly preferred.</li> <li>Strong analytical abilities and able to synthesize complex information. You enjoy absorbing large amounts of data and qualitative insights and can quickly develop a strong narrative that leads to recommendations and builds our understanding of the business.</li> <li>Stakeholder Management: The ability to work and influence cross-functionally in a matrixed business environment is a must. You are proactive, great at communicating with different audiences and can bring stakeholders on-board. You seek out and have a track record for driving change and impact in a fluid, unstructured working environment.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to put together clear, polished, insightful recommendations for peers, managers and senior management.</li> <li>You’re very comfortable with financial modeling in Excel, and are willing to gather internal and external data points to help build a comprehensive business case.</li> <li>You’re someone who possesses grit and finds creative ways to get the job done. You bring high energy and the ability to prioritize and deliver in a fast paced environment while balancing multiple projects.</li> <li>Relevant Sector Experience: Experience in B2C technology businesses is preferred, particularly Marketplace/Classifieds/E-Commerce businesses; broader experience in B2B technology, including Fintech and B2B Software will also be considered.</li> <li>Fluent in <strong>English and French</strong>.</li> <li>Experience in travel and hospitality is a plus.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</span></p></div><div class="title">France Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€64.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€75.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Now is an amazing time to join Nozomi Networks as we build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.</p> <p>We defend some of the world’s largest organizations and critical infrastructure in more than 68 countries and we’re just getting started. Our AI-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.</p></div><p>Due to exponential growth, we are looking to appoint a Global Renewals Leader who will be responsible for renewing large volumes of customer contracts.<br>We are seeking someone who can quickly ramp up on our product offerings, client engagement model and renewal processes, whilst building out our global renewals team. You will play a critical role in supporting our customer success and revenue organizations, and your work will directly impact our corporate goals. This is a unique opportunity to build a global renewals team, whilst implementing best practice processes working with our sales leadership team.</p> <p><br>This position requires a strong knowledge of systems and process selling, the ability to manage and close large volumes of opportunities. account.</p> <h2><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></h2> <div> <ul> <li>Own the renewal strategy and operating model, including process, coverage, segmentation, playbooks, and workflows.</li> opportunities.</li> </ul> </div> <h2>To be successful in this role, you need:</h2> <div> <ul> <li>Experience managing a recurring revenue book of business with accountability for GRR and renewal with pricing, uplift, multi-year agreements, and contract terms.</li> <li>Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, and Revenue Operations.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to identify renewal risk, trends, and opportunities.</li> <li>Experience in cybersecurity, infrastructure, networking, or another technically complex B2B SaaS environment.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience building a global renewals team from the ground up.</li> <li>Proven track record of success managing a high-volume portfolio of accounts.</li> <li>Strong communication, relationship-building, and follow-up skills.</li> <li>Excellent organization and time management skills.</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce.</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 20%.</li> </ul> </div> <h2>Competencies:</h2> <div> <ul> <li class="p1">Active Listening and Communication</li> <li>Business Insight and Acumen</li> <li>Drive for Results (Get things <li>Collaboration & Team Leadership</li> <li>Leadership Performance through Action</li> <li>People Development and Performance Management</li> </ul> <hr></div><div title: Principal Customer Success Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Principal Customer Success Manager</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":100}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">So, what's the role all about?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"335559738":200,"335559739":160}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our Principal Customer Success Managers are the face NiCE CX puts in front of our most valuable customers and partners – the people who can walk into a boardroom, read the room, and change how a conversation is going within minutes. This is a role for someone who thrives on relationships, backs their own instincts, and isn’t afraid to lead from the front.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":200}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You’ll take ownership of some of our most strategic, high-value, and high-complexity accounts, becoming the one person a customer or partner turns to when it matters most. Programme delivery, governance, and technical execution sit with our specialist teams – your job is to be the constant thread that keeps the customer’s priorities, expectations, and experience front and centre, whatever is happening behind the scenes.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":200}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">This isn’t a role for someone who wants to sit behind a desk managing a queue of tickets. It’s for someone who wants to own outcomes, influence at the highest levels, and be trusted to make the right call under pressure.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":200}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You’ll work closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and every team working behind the scenes – not to do their job for them, but to make sure their work lands in a way the customer genuinely feels and values. title: Lead Software Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>Lead Software Architect</strong></p> <p>At NICE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p> <p><strong>Why this role matters now</strong></p> <p>This role sits at the centre of our AI-led delivery transformation. We are rebuilding our digital evidence platform as AI-Native, with AI tooling acting as a daily partner from design through verification. The right architect is not someone with a long list of AI credentials - AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. The right architect is someone who already uses AI in their daily work, has formed clear judgement about where it belongs and where it does not, and is curious enough to learn the next tool when their current one is superseded.</p> <p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a talented Architect and Software Developer to join our team. You must:</p> <ul> <li>Be able to communicate effectively, including via email, instant message, phone, and video conferencing tools.</li> <li>Be fierce in your pursuit of product quality.</li> <li>Be an excellent problem solver with an active interest in the latest design and development tools and technologies.</li> <li>Be knowledgeable and enthusiastic about process.</li> <li>Be practically fluent with AI tooling - using Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent in your daily work, not just experimentally. We will discuss specific examples at interview.</li> <li>Be able to recognize opportunities for optimization and enhancement of process, product architecture and delivery based on the evolutions in AI.</li> <li>Have clear judgement about where AI belongs in a public-safety platform, and where it does not.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <p>You will be responsible for:</p> <ul> <li>Owning the architecture, and carrying out design, AI-led implementation and validation in Cloud-based, multi-threaded, multi-server environments -working in our AI-led delivery method where code, tests and decisions are AI-drafted, with you setting intent, orchestrating implementation, and validating outputs.</li> <li>Leading technical decisions on architectural direction using a collaborative, team-based approach.</li> <li>Ensuring the architecture takes into account the concerns of security, scalability, compatibility, maintainability — and the responsible, evidenced use of AI in both build-time and run-time.</li> <li>Performing testing of your work, fixing defects, and helping to resolve customer support cases.</li> <li>Ensuring that the team adheres to the architectural direction and standards.</li> <li>Mentoring and coaching team members in architecture practices, AI-led delivery techniques, and the discipline of validating AI outputs.</li> <li>Liaising with Product Management during planning sessions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solid experience developing applications in C# using Visual Studio/Visual Studio Code.</li> <li>Proven track record of breaking down complex market requirements into secure, scalable and resilient system designs.</li> <li>Experience with multi-tenant cloud solutions.</li> <li>Experience working in collaborative multidisciplinary teams.</li> <li>Experience creating maintainable code and using source control solutions such as DevOps, GIT or similar.</li> <li>Experience of unit testing, code reviews, and other product quality disciplines.</li> <li>Solid understanding of the principles of network security, authentication, and authorization.</li> <li>Experience of working with databases using Entity Framework or similar.</li> <li>Good knowledge of SOLID principles.</li> <li>Experience creating RESTful APIs and ensuring API extensibility.</li> <li>Recent practical experience using AI tooling (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent) in your daily work, not just experimentation. Comfortable describing what worked, what did not, and what you decided.</li> <li>Output discipline: you remain accountable for the architecture you are responsible for, whatever helped you produce it.</li> <li>Comfort with probabilistic systems, and clear judgement about when to use AI in a high-trust domain.</li> <li>Learning velocity: able to ramp on a new AI tool or technique in days, not months.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will have an advantage if you also have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Security best practice (OWASP top ten)</li> <li>Azure SQL Server</li> <li>DevOps, Pipelines, TeamCity, GitHub</li> <li>Windows services</li> <li>Experience using AI tooling specifically in the architect role - for design review, ADR drafting, threat modelling, contract design, or similar.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-Native software patterns (agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, prompt-and-response evaluation, evidence packets).</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we do not require</strong></p> <p>We do not require you to be an AI expert. AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. We require curiosity, recent practical use, output discipline, and the judgement to ship under accountability.</p> <p><strong>About the interview process</strong></p> <p>The final stage includes a working session using our AI tooling. The aim is to see how you think - how you set intent, validate outputs, and make decisions - not to test memorised knowledge.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></p> <p>Learn more about the <u>Benefits at NICE</u></p> <p>Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NICEr!</p> <p><strong>Enjoy NICE-FLEX!</strong></p> <p>At NICE, we work according to the NICE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.</p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Requisition ID: 11268</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Role Type: </strong>Individual Contributor</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. </em></p> <p><em>Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. </em></p> <p><em>NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.</em></p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
