description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are:</strong></p> <p><strong>Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure </strong>for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.<br><br>Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.<br><br>Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.<br><br><strong>Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.</strong><br><br><strong>Our Team Members:</strong></p> <p>We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!<br><br>We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.</p></div><p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>Your Role:</strong> </p> <p>As a Product Manager - Accounts, you will be responsible for the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Alpaca's core account management and identity verification systems. You will be the voice of our partners, working to create a flexible and compliant global account infrastructure. This role is critical to enabling financial institutions around the world to seamlessly and securely onboard and manage their end-users. You will work closely with engineering, legal, compliance, and business development teams to navigate the complexities of different jurisdictions and deliver a world-class account experience.</p> <p>Things You Get To Do:</p> <ul> <li>Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Alpaca's account opening and identity verification services</li> <li>Manage the lifecycle of various account structures, including fully disclosed, omnibus, and omnibus with sub-accounting, to meet the diverse needs of our global B2B clients.</li> <li>Develop and enhance features such as the ability to open accounts for entities, create sub-accounts for distinct trading strategies, and manage multiple account types (e.g., self-directed, robo, retirement)</li> <li>Lead the strategy for KYC and identity verification, supporting various models from partner-led KYC to integrated solutions with third-party providers</li> <li>Collaborate with legal, compliance, and regional business teams to navigate the complexities of different jurisdictions, ensuring our account systems meet local licensing, data management, and financial requirements</li> <li>Author detailed product requirement documents (PRDs) and user stories to ensure clarity and alignment across all teams</li> <li>Work with go-to-market teams to enable adoption of new account features and onboarding flows</li> <li>Define and analyze key metrics such as onboarding success rates, account funding times, and KYC pass-through rates to measure success and identify areas for improvement</li> </ul> <p>Who You Are (Must-Haves):</p> <ul> <li>At least 5 years of product management experience, with a focus on B2B, fintech, or complex platform products</li> <li>Experience with products related to user onboarding, title: Senior Energy Market Analyst - Trading
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Energy Exemplar</strong></p> <p>In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation. </p> <p>Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:</p> <ul> <li><em>SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.</em></li> <li><em>Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.</em></li> <li><em>IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners</em></li> <li><em>Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category</em></li> <li><em>Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change</em></li> <li><em>Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>How We Work</strong></p> <p>Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.</p> <p>We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.</p> <p>Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.</p></div><p><strong>About the Position</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Energy Market Analyst – Trading, you will sit within Energy Exemplar’s EMEA Solutions team, acting as a key technical partner to power trading customers across the region. You will combine deep knowledge of electricity markets and fundamental energy market modelling with an understanding of trading desk workflows to help customers use PLEXOS to support commercial and trading decisions.</p> <p>The role will work closely with power trading organisations, the EMEA Sales team, Solutions colleagues and Product teams. You will support customers across the full lifecycle from pre-sales demonstrations and proof-of-concept engagements through to model implementation, onboarding, optimisation and ongoing customer success.</p> <p>You will be accountable for delivering high quality modelling solutions that address customer needs, translating complex market and modelling concepts into actionable insights, and identifying opportunities to improve how trading organisations use fundamental modelling in their decision-making.</p> <p>This is a highly collaborative and customer facing role, with the opportunity to work with leading organisations across EMEA, contribute to thought leadership in power trading, and influence the continued development of PLEXOS for trading applications. The role can be based from Energy Exemplar’s London office or remotely within Europe, with international travel across EMEA as required.</p> <p><strong>Primary Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a trusted technical advisor to power trading customers, developing strong relationships and understanding their commercial objectives, workflows and modelling requirements.</li> <li>Lead the design, development and delivery of fundamental energy market modelling solutions using PLEXOS and related technologies to support trading and portfolio decision-making.</li> <li>Work with customers to analyse modelling outputs, validate assumptions and data, and continuously improve models to ensure they provide relevant and actionable market insights.</li> <li>Support the full customer lifecycle, including requirements gathering, onboarding, training, troubleshooting, model optimisation and ongoing technical support.</li> <li>Partner with the EMEA Sales team on prospective customer engagements, including technical demonstrations, proof-of-concept studies, presentations and responses to detailed functional and technical requirements.</li> <li>Use scripting, automation, APIs, CLI tools and cloud-based environments to develop efficient modelling workflows and integrate PLEXOS into customer processes.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product and Solutions teams to communicate customer needs, identify opportunities for product improvement and contribute to the development of trading-focused capabilities.</li> <li>Conduct market research and develop original analysis on emerging trends in power markets and trading, contributing to thought leadership, webinars, conferences and customer-facing content.</li> <li>Manage multiple customer engagements and priorities across EMEA, balancing delivery, stakeholder management and commercial requirements in a dynamic environment.</li> <li>Travel internationally across the EMEA region when required to support customers, sales opportunities, training and industry engagements.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Candidate Requirements & Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>5-7+ years of experience in energy markets, with a strong understanding of electricity market fundamentals, energy economics, power system operations and/or energy trading.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience using fundamental energy market supply and demand models, including optimisation, unit commitment or dispatch modelling, to analyse electricity markets.</li> <li>Strong understanding of power trading and electricity market dynamics, including how modelling can support price forecasting, market analysis, portfolio decisions, risk assessment and trading strategies.</li> <li>Strong Python or similar scripting skills, with experience using code to automate analytical or modelling workflows and work with data.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex modelling outputs, challenge assumptions and translate analysis into clear commercial insights.</li> <li>Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credibility and rapport with both technical and commercial audiences, including traders and other senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, customer requirements and competing priorities in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment.</li> <li>A tertiary qualification in Electrical Engineering, Energy Economics, Operations Research, or a related discipline, ideally with a focus on electricity systems or energy markets.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired but not required </strong></p> <ul> <li><br>Hands on experience with PLEXOS or another commercial energy market optimisation platform such as EPSI, BID3, Antares, SDDP or PROMOD.</li> <li>Direct experience working within or closely with a power trading desk, including exposure to day-ahead, intraday, balancing or other electricity markets.</li> <li>Experience applying fundamental modelling to cross-border flows, congestion analysis, ancillary services, capacity markets, portfolio optimisation, VaR or hedging strategies.</li> <li>Experience working with APIs, CLI tools and cloud-based computation environments, particularly where these have been used to integrate energy market models into automated trading or analytical workflows</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Energy Exemplar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential.</p> <p><em>Energy Exemplar respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data you share during the recruitment process. This Candidate <a>Privacy Notice</a> explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you apply for a role with us.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Technical Content Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><p>We are seeking a dynamic and hands-on Senior Manager to lead Anaplan’s Technical Content team – the group responsible for Anapedia (our product documentation), the Anaplan Planual (our modeling best-practice standard), documentation for the Anaplan Applications portfolio, and supporting disciplines such as localisation. This is a working manager role: you will lead a team of roughly 18 people organised into three sub-teams, while staying close enough to the content itself to set direction, raise the bar, and jump in where it matters.</p> <p>The ideal candidate is not satisfied with how technical content has “always been done.” You will be expected to question established processes, modernise our content operations, and champion the use of AI technologies to scale content creation, maintenance, and localisation – without compromising the accuracy and trust our customers place in Anapedia and the Planual.</p> <h1><strong>Your Impact</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Set the Direction:</strong> Own & drive the vision and strategy for Anaplan’s technical content function, spanning Anapedia, the Planual, Anaplan Applications documentation, and localisation, and translate that vision into a clear, prioritised roadmap.</li> <li><strong>Lead a Multi-Team Organisation:</strong> Lead, coach, and develop a ~15-person organization structured across two sub-teams, building strong second-line leadership and a culture of ownership, quality, and continuous improvement.</li> <li><strong>Challenge the Status Quo:</strong> Actively challenge the status quo in how technical content is planned, produced, and maintained – retiring processes that no longer serve the business and introducing better ones, even when that means disrupting familiar ways of working.</li> <li><strong>Scale Content with AI:</strong> Identify and implement AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate content creation, review, updating, and translation, increasing both the velocity and consistency of our documentation at scale.</li> <li><strong>Modernize the Content Stack:</strong> Evaluate, select, and evolve the content management systems and tooling that underpin Anapedia, the Planual, and our localisation pipeline, ensuring the team works with modern, fit-for-purpose platforms.</li> <li><strong>Lead as a Practitioner:</strong> Stay close to the work: contribute directly to complex or high-visibility content, model editorial standards, and provide hands-on guidance to sub-team leads and writers.</li> <li><strong>Partner Cross-Functionally:</strong> Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, UX, and Support to ensure technical content keeps pace with new releases, platform capabilities, and the Anaplan Applications roadmap.</li> <li><strong>Drive Localisation:</strong> Own the roadmap and operating model for translating and localising technical content, ensuring quality and consistency across languages and markets.</li> <li><strong>Measure What Matters:</strong> Define and track metrics for content quality, coverage, freshness, and efficiency, and use them to continuously improve how the team operates.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>Your Qualifications</strong></h1> <p><strong>Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience managing a mid-size team (roughly 15–25 people), ideally including a nested or multi-team structure with team leads reporting to you.</li> <li>Strong track record of setting up, maintaining, and scaling technical content operations – documentation, knowledge bases, or similar content at enterprise scale.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with AI technologies applied to content creation, editing, quality assurance, or localisation, and a clear point of view on how to use them responsibly to increase efficiency.</li> <li>Solid working knowledge of modern content management systems and documentation tooling (e.g., component content management systems, docs-as-code platforms, or similar).</li> <li>A demonstrated bias toward challenging existing processes and driving change, balanced with the judgment to protect content quality and customer trust.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to operate confidently with senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, and Support.</li> <li>Willingness to work in a hybrid model with occasional in-office days in the Manchester or York area, UK.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Knowledge of enterprise planning, EPM, or connected planning software is a strong plus.</li> <li>Experience running or scaling a localization/translation program for technical content.</li> <li>Background in SaaS or enterprise software documentation, including experience with API, application, or platform documentation.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! </p> <p>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  </p> <p><strong>Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer</strong>  </p> <p>It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. </p> <p>Anaplan does not:  </p> <ul> <li>Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.  </li> <li>Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  </li> </ul> <p>All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. title: Senior Product Designer
description: <h3>About Dwelly</h3> <p>Dwelly is building the AI operating system for residential lettings. Its growing network of agencies provides its AI with real-world data, continuous feedback, and control over complete workflows, making exceptional service the standard for landlords and tenants. Today, Dwelly operates more than 15,000 properties and $470 million in GMV, making it one of the UK’s ten largest lettings operators. The company has raised $263 million.<br><br>We’re a fast-growing, product-focused company, backed by top-tier investors and led by a team with deep experience in real estate, technology, and operations.</p> <h3>Position Summary</h3> <p>We are seeking a highly talented and hands-on Senior Product Designer to help shape the experience across the full set of Dwelly products (Tenant Find, Property Management, Payments, CRM) and the internal back-office tools that power them. This role involves deeply understanding our user personas (Tenant, Landlord, Maintenance Contractor, Dwelly Agent) and designing for both the customer-facing portals and the operational tools our agents use every day.</p> <p>Given the early stage of the business, our current products are hyper-functional but quite basic — an "MVP" that prioritises getting the job done across all domains. You'll work closely with product and engineering to take these to the next level: bringing clarity, usability, and craft to data-dense, workflow-heavy internal tools, and building genuinely good experiences for tenants and landlords. You'll also help establish the basic building blocks of design at Dwelly — a shared design system, patterns, and a lightweight design process — from the ground up.</p> <p>Our current development team is a team of 5, a few analysts, and one product designer. You'll join a small, fast-moving product team and have an outsized impact on how the whole product looks, feels, and works.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></h3> <p><strong>1. </strong><strong>User Research & Insights</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with product to understand user pain points across all personas — tenants, landlords, maintenance contractors, and internal agents.</li> <li>Turn qualitative and quantitative insights into design decisions.</li> <li>Act as an advocate for usability and the end user within the company.</li> </ul> <p><strong>2. End-to-End Product Design</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity UIs for both customer-facing products (tenant and landlord portals) and internal back-office tools.</li> <li>Design for data-dense, workflow-heavy operational products where clarity and efficiency matter more than decoration.</li> <li>Own the design process from concept and prototyping through to polished, build-ready specs, and iterate after launch.</li> </ul> <p><strong>3. Design Across the Product Suite</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bring consistency and quality across Tenant Find, Property Management, Payments, and the communications/portal layer.</li> <li>Partner closely with engineers and product managers to translate requirements into shippable design, balancing craft with speed and technical feasibility.</li> </ul> <p><strong>4. Design System & Process Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish and maintain a shared design system, component library, and reusable patterns.</li> <li>Introduce lightweight design workflows, documentation, and review/handoff practices suited to an early-stage team.</li> </ul> <h3><strong> Qualifications & Preferred Background:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Strong experience in product design, with a strong portfolio spanning both complex/operational tools and consumer-facing products. Comfortable in early-stage, low-structure environments as well as more structured, product-led settings.</li> <li><strong>Skills:</strong> Strong interaction and visual design skills; systems thinking; exceptional attention to detail; able to design for complexity and make it feel simple. Excellent communication and collaboration skills across product and engineering.</li> <li>In step with recent technology advancements: <strong>can prototype and ship designs quickly and independently with the help of AI.</strong></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred Background:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience designing operational, back-office, or B2B tools where efficiency and workflow are central — ideally in tech-enabled or operational businesses.</li> <li>Experience building or contributing to a design system from scratch.</li> <li>Strong sense of ownership, a "get things done" attitude, and excellent attention to detail.</li> </ul> <h3>Compensation & Benefits:</h3> <ul> <li>Competitive salary with the potential for equity options based on performance, recognising exceptional contributions to our integration success.</li> </ul> <h3>What is it like being a Dwell-er?</h3> <p>Feel free to check out <a href="https://docsend.com/view/7v8gwrjaky7mn895">Dwelly Core Principles</a>. That’s about what we believe in, how we operate and make decisions.</p> <p>What we offer is not a fancy office or a static workplace. Instead, this is solving one of worlds’ most complex problems in the largest consumer industry in the world (residential rentals), to improve the experience for >30% of households (>5M in the UK, and >100M including EU and US) that live in rental homes.</p> <p>This is about disrupting the largest, most antiquated industry in the world, with one of the strongest operational and technical teams that exist in the UK and the EU. We work hard, and we shoot for extremely ambitious results. title: Enterprise Sales Lead (French market)
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ Why we are hiring ⭐️ We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies. In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end : you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market. This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! We’re accelerating acquisition in France and doubling down on our portfolio — and the Enterprise segment is one of the core pillars of that plan . About the Enterprise segment Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees Verticals: all Verticals (Tech, Retail, Industrial Companies etc) Total Addressable Market: ~ 7M members in France Why Enterprise Sales is exciting at Alan Diverse workforce : Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support. Critical challenges : Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers, Unions, long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics; Company profiles : Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness; HR priorities : Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies) Critical business characteristics : This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise Account Executives. Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters. ⭐ What you will do ⭐ You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine . More precisely, you will: Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment . Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come) Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment. Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations , rigorous follow‑up , and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution, and pipeline management. Be on the field with the team : prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates. Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals : strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy. Ensure market fit and remove blockers: Surface customer expectations, patterns, and blockers, and ensure they’re addressed through the right strategic and execution plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.). For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-G level range . ⭐ Is it what you are looking for? ⭐ You may be a great fit at Alan if you: Have at least 10 years experience in B2B sales , with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader Have experience leading and coaching sales teams , with the ability to set a high bar , give clear direction , and help people grow Have full working proficiency in French , and advanced level in English for internal communication Have a very hands‑on mentality : you love being on the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations, and sharing what works Have experience selling to Enterprise level companies (3000+ employees and above) in multi‑stakeholder deals Are comfortable operating in fast‑paced, ambiguous environments , and can prioritize ruthlessly Are data‑driven and analytical : you know how to leverage KPIs to drive performance, run analyses, and make decisions Have strong cross‑functional collaboration skills and appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.) Are based (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area Nice-to-have: Experience selling to HR or Finance . 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible Office . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance . Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only. Transport . Country-specific commuter benefits. Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people not roles. After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply ! Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. title: Data & Analytics Manager (f/m/x)
description: Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One +, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market. Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy. We are looking for a Data & Analytics Manager to lead an international BI and Data Analytics team across EMEA. This hands-on role combines people management, technical leadership, stakeholder management, and end-to-end data project delivery. You will translate business priorities into execution plans, guide technical decisions, unblock the team, and deliver reliable data products for BI, self-service analytics, and AI-enabled use cases. What you'll do Lead, coach, and develop an international BI and Data Analytics team. Build a motivating, accountable, and change-oriented team environment. Model clean, documented datasets in dbt, from staging through to marts. Own tests, documentation, metric definitions, data contracts, and version control workflows. Develop a semantic layer with governed metrics and dimensions. Drive the ongoing adoption of dbt best practices, ensuring models and documentation are consistent, well-structured, and ready for AI-powered analytics. Support team in the diagnosis of source data issues, reconciliation inconsistencies, and establishment of a single source of truth. Support data migration, ELT pipelines, and data platform consolidation. Optimize Snowflake performance, data freshness, and data quality. Own and continuously improve the processes that keep our data platform reliable. Use Python for data checks, automation, and utilities. Partner with BI and business teams to deliver certified datasets, self-service standards, and end-to-end reporting solutions. Translate business needs into scalable data products and governed metrics. Turn business priorities into project plans, identify risks and trade-offs, unblock the team, and drive delivery to completion. Mentor the team on analytics engineering best practices, modern tooling, and AI-assisted development. What you'll bring 3+ years of experience in Analytics Engineering, BI Development, Data Engineering, or a related field, including 1+ years of people or team leadership. Expert-level SQL and strong data modeling and architecture skills, including star schemas, semantic layers, governed metrics, data contracts, and ELT pipelines. Hands-on experience building production-grade dbt projects, including staging-to-marts layering, tests, documentation, ownership, and version-control workflows. Snowflake experience, including query performance optimization, data freshness, and quality monitoring. Python skills for data checks, automation, and utilities. Experience with data quality and operations, including testing, monitoring, source-data reconciliation, CI/CD, data cataloging, and cost/performance tuning. Experience creating dbt models and documentation, AI-ready data products, and using AI-assisted development tools. Experience delivering certified datasets, self-service standards, and BI/reporting solutions end-to-end. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with a hands-on, entrepreneurial, and problem-solving mindset. A motivational leadership style, positive drive for change, and confidence to challenge assumptions and make decisions. Nice to have Experience with semantic layer tools such as dbt MetricFlow or Snowflake Semantic Views. Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience leading distributed or international teams. German language skills. German is a strong plus but not mandatory. Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️ What we offer Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition. The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities. The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities. Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee. Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you. The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events. title: Praktikant Operations & Growth (m/w/d)
description: Über uns Über 5 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland sind pflegebedürftig, und jedes Jahr werden es mehr. Ihnen stehen Leistungen zu, die oft nie ankommen, weil Formulare, Zuständigkeiten und Behördensprache dazwischenstehen. Jeden Fall einzeln zu prüfen und bis zur Entscheidung zu begleiten, war bisher zu aufwendig. Mit KI geht das zum ersten Mal für viele Familien gleichzeitig. Genau das macht Decari: Wir prüfen, welche Leistungen infrage kommen, etwa ein höherer Pflegegrad, Hilfe zur Pflege oder Eingliederungshilfe, und begleiten die Anträge bis zur Entscheidung. Pflegedienste in mehreren Bundesländern arbeiten bereits mit uns. Unser Ziel: Jede Familie in Deutschland bekommt die Pflegeleistungen, die ihr zusteht. Wir sind ein kleines, AI-natives Team mit Erfahrung aus der Versicherungs- und Pflegebranche. Wir waren frühe Mitarbeiter in Startups, die von Sequoia, Accel, Index Ventures und Y Combinator finanziert wurden und zusammen über 100 Mio. Euro eingesammelt haben. Neue Ideen testen wir erst einfach und von Hand, was funktioniert, automatisieren wir, und unsere Abläufe ändern wir jede Woche, manchmal täglich. Wir übernehmen Ownership und haben wenig Ego. Deine Rolle In deiner Operations & Growth Rolle baust du Decari mit uns auf. Du arbeitest direkt mit Julien (Operations) und den Gründern und bist operativ und taktisch mittendrin: Du sprichst jeden Tag mit Familien und Pflegediensten, siehst, wo es hakt, und gestaltest den Prozess aktiv mit. Was du machst Du bist der erste Kontakt der Familien zu Decari und verbringst den größten Teil deines Tages am Telefon. Im Gespräch findest du heraus, ob und wie wir helfen können. title: Senior Systems Engineer, Browser Isolation
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX (US), Lisbon (Portugal), London (UK)</p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/zero-trust/products/browser-isolation/">Cloudflare Browser Isolation</a> runs web content in remote browsers, helping protect users from threats while preserving a responsive browsing experience. Our team builds the Chromium-based browsing engine, remote rendering and streaming technology, and distributed services that manage browser sessions across Cloudflare’s global network.</p> <p>You will work at the intersection of systems programming, distributed systems, and security. Engineers contribute across the product, collaborating on browser changes, service orchestration, observability, and build infrastructure.</p> <p><strong>Scope and growth</strong></p> <p>At this level, you will be accountable for outcomes across a problem area that may span several components. You will establish technical direction, make uncertainty and trade-offs explicit, and help other engineers succeed while remaining hands-on. This is an individual-contributor role; people-management experience is not required.</p> <p><strong>Technologies we use</strong></p> <ul> <li>Browser engine: Chromium and C++.</li> <li>Systems programming: Rust.</li> <li>Distributed services and orchestration: Go, TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, Nomad, and Consul.</li> <li>Remote rendering and streaming: WebRTC and Skia.</li> <li>Browser client: TypeScript, WebAssembly, and WebGL.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead complex, multi-component initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation, staged rollout, and measurable production outcomes.</li> <li>Design and implement changes in our Chromium-based C++ browser and the distributed services and systems components supporting remote browsing, working across Go, Rust, and TypeScript.</li> <li>Make and explain architectural trade-offs across latency, availability, resource efficiency, security boundaries, and operational complexity.</li> <li>Investigate difficult cross-layer failures and performance bottlenecks, distinguishing browser, host, network, and control-plane causes.</li> <li>Improve resilience, capacity management, observability, and release safety; define success metrics and validate results.</li> <li>Coordinate work with partner teams, surface dependencies and risks early, and guide delivery through ambiguity.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and raise the quality of code reviews, design reviews, testing, documentation, and operational practices.</li> <li>Participate in the team’s production on-call rotation after onboarding, lead technical incident investigations as needed, and drive durable corrective actions.</li> </ul> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong production C++ proficiency, including memory and resource ownership, concurrency, and debugging in substantial codebases.</li> <li>A track record of independently leading complex systems or distributed-service improvements across multiple components, from an unclear problem to a reliable production outcome.</li> <li>Strong Linux/UNIX and networking fundamentals, with experience diagnosing correctness, latency, and resource-consumption issues using profiling and operational evidence.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating distributed systems, with sound judgment about service boundaries, data partitioning, consistency, timeouts and retries, backpressure, capacity limits, and recovery from partial failures.</li> <li>Experience designing safe rollout and recovery strategies and maintaining production software over its lifecycle.</li> <li>Ability to communicate trade-offs clearly, align stakeholders, mentor teammates, and improve engineering practices through constructive feedback.</li> <li>A willingness to work across C++, Rust, Go, and TypeScript and learn unfamiliar parts of the stack.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <p>These are preferred qualifications, not prerequisites. Prior Browser Isolation or Cloudflare experience is not required.</p> <ul> <li>Browser engines, Chromium, browser sandboxing, or security-sensitive systems.</li> <li>Low-latency streaming, graphics, remote computing, or other real-time systems.</li> <li>Container and workload orchestration, including Nomad or Kubernetes, and service discovery.</li> <li>Experience using Rust for systems programming or distributed services.</li> <li>Go or TypeScript; WebRTC, Skia, WebAssembly, or WebGL.</li> <li>Production observability, capacity planning, incident response, or build and release infrastructure.</li> </ul> <h4>Compensation</h4> <p data-path-to-node="1">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - €91,000.</p> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.</p> <h4><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h4> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="4">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More detail

title: Geschäftsführer (m/w/d) Gebäude-Energieberatung – Aufbau neuer Standort im Umland
description: Haben Sie schon länger über eine berufliche Veränderung nachgedacht? Gleichzeitig fehlen vielerorts Gebäude-Energieberater – das schafft hervorragende Chancen für Quereinsteiger. Ideal für Quereinsteiger Sie benötigen keine umfangreichen fachlichen Voraussetzungen, um einen gebietsgeschützten Standort aufzubauen. ENERDOMO unterstützt Sie von Anfang an – auch nach der Neueröffnung. Qualifizierung in 27 Tagen In der hybriden ENERDOMO Akademie (Königstein/Frankfurt & Online) erhalten Quereinsteiger ein strukturiertes Einarbeitungs- und Qualifizierungsprogramm. Projektleiter, Ingenieure, Maschinenbauer, Handwerksmeister und Immobilienmakler finden bei uns einen schnellen Einstieg in alle Themen rund um die energetische Sanierung. ENERDOMO Sanierungssprint Ein- und Zweifamilienhäuser werden in 22 Werktagen energetisch saniert. Ein Taktplan steuert die Gewerke, die parallel arbeiten. Die Sanierungssprintkoordination übernimmt Baubegleitung, Bauzeitenplanung sowie die Koordinierung der Gewerke. Zukunftsmarkt mit Sinn „Grüne Jobs“ sind dabei mehr als ein Trend. Umwelt- und Energieberufe gehören zu den wichtigsten Zukunftsmärkten. ENERDOMO gibt Know-how an Existenzgründer und Quereinsteiger weiter, die Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas Eigenes aufbauen wollen. Aufgaben Wir helfen Immobilienbesitzern (privat und gewerblich), Fördermittel für energetische Sanierungen zu beantragen. Dazu erstellen wir einen Sanierungsfahrplan (iSFP) und unterstützen bei den baulichen Maßnahmen. Statt die Arbeit von Architekten, Dachdeckern oder Heizungsbauern zu ersetzen, kooperieren wir eng mit ihnen. Als Geschäftsführer und ENERDOMO-Partner übernehmen Sie dabei folgende Aufgaben: Aufbau Ihrer eigenen, lokalen Präsenz von ENERDOMO, inklusive eines Netzwerkes aus Handwerkern und eventuellen Mitarbeitern Beraten von Kunden zu allen Fragen rund um die Gebäude-Sanierung und verfügbaren Fördermittel Beantragen von Fördermitteln mit oder für den Kunden Vor-Ort Begehung von Gebäuden zur Aufnahme von Gebäude-Daten Erstellung von individuellen Sanierungsfahrplänen (iSFP) in Hottgenroth Erstellungen von Zusatzleistungen wie z.B. Energieausweisen oder Heizlastberechnungen Schreiben von Angeboten und Rechnungen in Lexware Office Qualifikation Ein erfolgreicher Geschäftsführer im Bereich der Energieberatung sollte folgende Qualifikationen mitbringen: Interesse am Energiesektor: Kenntnisse über Immobilien, Produkte und Dienstleistungen sowie die Fähigkeit, sich in dieses Thema einzuarbeiten. Führungserfahrung: Erfahrung in der Leitung von Teams und der Entwicklung von Geschäftsbeziehungen. Unternehmerisches Denken: Fähigkeit, neue Ideen und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten umzusetzen und Verantwortung für den erfolgreichen Betrieb des Standorts zu übernehmen. Finanzielle Kenntnisse: Kenntnisse in Budgetplanung, -analyse und -berichterstattung zur Sicherstellung des erfolgreichen Betriebs. Marketing- und Vertriebskenntnisse: Fähigkeit, erfolgreiche Marketing- und Vertriebsstrategien zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, um neue Kunden zu gewinnen und den Umsatz zu steigern. Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Kunden, Mitarbeitern und Geschäftspartnern zu kommunizieren und zu präsentieren. Sie benötigen: Technisches Verständnis Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit technischen Anlagen Zusätzlich vorteilhaft: Ein Abschluss in einem technischen Studiengang oder einer berufsbildenden höheren Schule. Dies ist jedoch keine Voraussetzung bei ENERDOMO. Wir unterstützen Sie bei der Befähigungsprüfung zum Energieberater. Quereinsteiger: Selbst wenn Sie kein Handwerksmeister, Ingenieur oder Architekt sind, können Sie mit unserer Hilfe die „Qualifikationsprüfung Energieberatung“ erfolgreich ablegen. Benefits Gestalten Sie Ihr eigenes Unternehmen innerhalb eines erprobten Geschäftsmodells Profitieren Sie vom ENERDOMO-Netzwerk: Erhalten Sie die Unterstützung bestehender ENERDOMO-Partner bei fachlichen Fragen und wachsen Sie gemeinsam mit uns in einem aufstrebenden Markt. Mit ENERDOMO gestalten wir aktiv die energetische Zukunft der Immobilienberatung. Mit einer starken Marke. Aber noch wichtiger: mit starken Partnern. Deshalb rücken wir am liebsten Menschen wie Patrik Brings ins Rampenlicht. Denn letztlich geht es nicht um Logos, sondern um echte Persönlichkeiten – mit Profil, klarer Haltung und einer echten Story. Warum setzen wir so auf Personal Branding?Weil Menschen am liebsten mit Menschen zusammenarbeiten. Weil Persönlichkeit die besten Kunden anzieht – und gleichzeitig die passenden Mitarbeiter. Weil jeder Partner einzigartig ist und genau das sichtbar werden soll. Patrik hat sich entschieden, Gesicht zu zeigen – heute steht er nicht nur für ENERDOMO, sondern ist die Adresse Nr. 1 in Koblenz, wenn es um energetische Sanierung geht. Brings sagt: „Die Entscheidung für ENERDOMO war eine der besten meines Lebens. Jetzt unterstütze ich Menschen dabei, ihre Immobilien zukunftssicher zu gestalten. Diese Aufgabe ist wirtschaftlich äußerst attraktiv und gibt meinem Leben einen echten Sinn." Du fühlst dich davon angesprochen und tickst ähnlich wie wir bei ENERDOMO – Das Original? Drive turn-ups that are predictable, efficient, and repeatable.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Hardware & Spec Validation:</strong> Partner with teams to ensure delivered systems meet agreed specifications. Define acceptance criteria and validation workflows, including burn-in, benchmarking, and health checks across compute, storage, and networking. title: Software Development Engineer in Test | Luma
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Why At Dotmatics </strong></p> <p>At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.</p> <p><strong>We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.</strong></p> <p>We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.</p> <p>Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.</p> <p><strong>Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics </strong></p> <p>Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.</p> <p>You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.</p> <p><strong>We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. </strong></p></div><div class="iCIMS_InfoMsg iCIMS_InfoMsg_Job"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Container"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Text"> <div class="iCIMS_InfoMsg iCIMS_InfoMsg_Job"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Container"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Text"> <p><strong>What do we need</strong></p> <p>We are seeking an SDET to join one of our agile engineering teams and help us build quality into LUMA, our scientific software platform. You'll take ownership of testing for a specific module of the application — writing and maintaining automated tests, exploring new features, and working alongside developers, application scientists and DevOps engineers to make sure what we ship is reliable.</p> <p>This is a hands-on automation role with room to grow. You'll be contributing to established test frameworks rather than building them from scratch, with support from senior SDETs who will help you develop your technical depth and your understanding of the science behind the product.</p> <p>While the primary focus is automation, the role also involves manual exploratory testing.</p> <p><strong> In this role you will get to:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Write, maintain and extend automated test suites for your module using Cucumber, TypeScript and Cypress (and Playwright where we use it).</li> <li> Own day-to-day quality for your area: contributing test scenarios during planning, testing stories as they're built, and giving the team a clear picture of release readiness.</li> <li>Design and document test cases that cover functional, regression and integration scenarios, and keep them useful as the product evolves.</li> <li>Investigate and reproduce defects, raise well-evidenced bug reports in JIRA, and verify fixes with developers and scientists.</li> <li>Keep your tests green and trustworthy in our CI pipelines, and help improve how tests run and report.</li> <li>Learn to read and interpret API documentation and turn it into meaningful automated coverage.</li> <li>Work with leading experts in software development, scientific product management and test automation — and be mentored by them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who we're looking for:</strong></p> <p>You'll have <strong>2–5 years' experience in QA/testing, including at least a year of hands-on test automation</strong>. You're comfortable working in a code-first way, you enjoy digging into how things work, and you're happy asking questions when a domain is unfamiliar. You work carefully and pay attention to detail, and you can take a story or module, understand it and devise a concrete approach to testing going above and beyond the standard acceptance criteria.</p> <p>Just as importantly, you want to get better. We're looking for someone who takes feedback well, is curious about the scientific problems our users are solving and wants to grow into a senior automation engineer over time.</p> <p><strong>The Key Skills we are looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Practical experience with Cypress</strong> — writing tests, using selectors and custom commands, debugging failures, and working within an existing Page Object Model. Experience testing React applications is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript</strong>, including asynchronous code (promises, async/await). You don't need to be an expert in generics and interfaces, but you should be able to read and write clean, maintainable test code.</li> <li><strong>Experience with BDD / Cucumber</strong>, or a willingness to pick it up quickly — we write most of our specs in Gherkin.</li> <li><strong>Test case design and documentation</strong> — the ability to break a feature down into clear, repeatable scenarios and write them up so others can follow them.</li> <li><strong>Comfort with Git and GitHub</strong>, including branching, pull requests and code review, plus experience working in JIRA or a similar tracking system.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You may also have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Playwright, or interest in learning it — we use it for a subset of our tests.</li> <li>Exposure to API testing tools (Postman, REST clients) or writing API-level automated tests.</li> <li> Any experience with performance or load testing (K6 or similar).</li> <li> Familiarity with validating data integrity across release upgrades, migrations or schema changes.</li> <li> A background or interest in science, engineering or research software.</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Research shows us the<a class="c-link" href="https://www.theatlantic.com/magazine/archive/2014/05/the-confidence-gap/359815/" target="_blank" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-stringify-link="https://www.theatlantic.com/magazine/archive/2014/05/the-confidence-gap/359815/"> confidence gap</a> and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. title: Staff Data Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>The climate crisis is the defining challenge of our time—but it’s also the greatest opportunity for innovation, and a challenge we’re proud to take on. At Overstory, we’re harnessing cutting-edge technology to enable a resilient electrical grid that keeps communities thriving as our world changes.</p> <p>The grid is the backbone of life as we know it. It powers hospitals, keeps food fresh, and ensures communities stay connected. But extreme weather, aging infrastructure, and growing wildfire risks are putting this critical system under pressure. All of this combined makes the electric utility industry the greatest opportunity for tackling climate change. </p> <p>One of the leading causes of catastrophic wildfires and power outages? Trees and brush coming into contact with power lines. </p> <p>That’s where we help. At Overstory, we use AI and advanced satellite imagery to pinpoint and prioritize vegetation risks before they materialize. By giving utilities critical analysis on those risks, we’re helping prevent outages, reduce wildfire risks, and accelerate the transition to a safer, more resilient grid.</p> <p>Our team spans the Americas and Europe, and we work with utility partners across the Americas and beyond. We’re outdoor enthusiasts, musicians, artists, athletes, parents, and adventurers. What unites us is a passion for solving complex problems, a commitment to climate action, and the belief that technology should be a force for good.</p> <p>Join us to help us build a more resilient world together. </p></div><h2>Role & Team</h2> <p>As a <strong>Staff Data Engineer</strong> at Overstory, you will lead the design and scaling of the data platform that enables Overstory’s AI-powered vegetation analysis. Our analysis depends on moving enormous volumes of satellite imagery, model inferences, and utility network data through orchestrated pipelines reliably, repeatably, and on time to support customer decision-making. You'll own the architecture of that platform and set the direction for how it evolves.</p> <p>You'll work closely with data, ML, and product engineers, as well as product teams, to make sure the data flowing into our models and out to our customers balances pragmatic delivery with durability, traceability, and scalability. As a senior technical leader, you'll mentor other engineers, drive architectural decisions, and set standards for pipeline design, service boundaries, and data quality across Overstory.</p> <p><strong>Time zone requirement: </strong>Europe (GMT/WET, CET, EET) and Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST)</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <p>In collaboration with data, ML, and product colleagues, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Architect and evolve our orchestration layer — asset graphs, quality checks, partitioning strategies, and the patterns that keep it scaling reliably.</li> <li>Design and maintain production data pipelines for large-scale geospatial and temporal data, from ingestion through transformation to delivery.</li> <li>Lead system design work across the data platform, including service boundaries, data contracts, and designing around the failure modes that come with each.</li> <li>Drive the shift toward a service-oriented architecture, decoupling tightly bound components into services that teams can own and deploy independently.</li> <li>Build event-driven workflows, replacing brittle coupling and manual coordination with durable messaging patterns.</li> <li>Establish observability, testing, and data quality frameworks so problems surface before customers see them, allowing any result to be traced back and explained.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and define the standards for how we build, test, and operate data systems.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Skills & Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience thriving at the intersection of data engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale scientific data; deeply motivated by the opportunity to reduce wildfire risk and improve grid resilience through better data patterns and infrastructure</li> <li>10+ years of experience designing and building production-grade data pipelines and systems</li> <li>Deep hands-on experience with <strong>Dagster</strong> — asset-based orchestration, partitions, sensors, and the operational side of running it in production (comparable experience with Airflow, Prefect, or similar is a reasonable substitute if you're ready to go deep on Dagster)</li> <li>Proven track record building and operating <strong>data pipelines</strong> at scale, with a real feel for idempotency, backfills, and partitioning</li> <li>Experience in preparing systems to handle periods of high demand with a focus on testability and scalability best practices</li> <li>Strong <strong>system design</strong> skills — you can reason about boundaries, contracts, coupling, and failure modes, and explain the tradeoffs to people who'll use and build on them</li> <li>Practical experience designing <strong>service-oriented architecture</strong>, including versioning and keeping things operational through migrations</li> <li>Strong <strong>Python</strong> skills and experience with <strong>Google Cloud</strong></li> <li>Experience with <strong>Pub/Sub</strong> and event-driven patterns</li> <li>Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, ML, and product</li> <li>Comfortable leading architectural discussions and mentoring other engineers</li> <li>Experience in remote-first and globally distributed team</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice To Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Comfort working with geospatial data and the ways that it’s stored</li> <li>Experience building data pipelines that power ML training and inference</li> <li>Experience with analytics engineering tooling and warehouse modeling in BigQuery</li> <li>Infrastructure-as-code experience and comfort owning your systems in production</li> <li>Background in remote sensing, forestry, or the utility sector</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Note:</strong> We believe that all people are capable of great things. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description.</em></p> <h2><strong>What We Offer</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive, location-specific compensation and benefits </li> <li>Flexible, autonomous and collaborative working environment rooted in trust - we build our work days around our lives, not the other way around</li> <li>Home office stipend, coworking and ongoing education budgets </li> <li>A company culture that genuinely embodies each of our core values</li> <li>To be part of truly mission-driven work that reduces wildfires, protects earth’s natural resources and helps solve our climate crisis</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>About Our Team</strong></h2> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">We are a fast-growing team of about 100 people from all over the world. Fifteen nationalities are represented and at last count we speak fourteen languages: English, Dutch, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Luxembourgish, Lithuanian, Bulgarian, Finnish, Estonian, and Afrikaans.</p> <p>We work remotely from eleven countries and are looking for candidates that are living and working in one of them: United States, the Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Estonia, Portugal, France, Sweden, Switzerland, Denmark and Canada. We gather once a year in-person for our unforgettable team gathering event. We also offer the option to occasionally meet up for in-person collaboration. </p> <h2><strong>Diversity & Inclusion</strong></h2> <p>The climate crisis is a human crisis that requires diverse perspectives to solve. </p> <p>We place enormous value on diversity and believe that the best ideas emerge when people with different backgrounds and experience work together. We remain committed to scaling a team that reflects the communities we serve, and strive to uphold equitable and inclusive practices across every aspect of our business. We are responsible for creating and maintaining a culture where everyone - regardless of background - has a voice in building a sustainable future.</p> <h2><strong>Our Values</strong></h2> <h4><strong>Tackling the climate crisis is our greatest mission.</strong></h4> <p>We act with urgency.</p> <h4><strong>Our curiosity fuels our growth.</strong></h4> <p>We recognize that change is constant, and we find joy and power in exploration.</p> <h4><strong>We’re rooted in diversity.</strong></h4> <p>Just as ecosystems need biodiversity to thrive, our resiliency comes from our differences.</p> <h4><strong>We care for each other.</strong></h4> <p>We love the power of machines but we nurture each other as humans.</p> <h4><strong>Trust is fundamental.</strong></h4> <p>We assume the best in everyone, and we share ideas openly so that we have a positive impact.</p> <p>_________________________________</p> <p data-start="90" data-end="127"><strong data-start="90" data-end="125">Use of AI in Our Hiring Process</strong></p> <p><em>We sometimes use AI tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as helping us manage applications more efficiently or ensuring job descriptions are clear and inclusive. All hiring decisions are always made by people, not machines. Any data processed by AI is handled securely in line with GDPR and our <a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="https://www.overstory.com/privacy-policy" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.overstory.com/privacy-policy" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Privacy Notice</a>.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Security Engineer, Corporate Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it.
