It's the core infrastructure for a company operating across 112 countries.</p> <p>The PSI (Platform, Security & Infrastructure) team is looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own the security of Flexport's corporate environment: endpoints, identity systems, internal networks, and the SaaS estate. This is a security engineering role, not an IT support role, and not a role where you write policies and hope for the best. You'll build, automate, and be on the ground when things get real.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <p>Endpoint & SaaS security</p> <ul> <li><strong>Own and mature our endpoint security stack (EDR) across macOS and Windows fleets</strong>, writing device policy as code — configuration profiles, remediation scripts, and enforcement rules — with staged rollout and rollback built in.</li> <li><strong>Own security configuration and monitoring for Flexport's critical SaaS applications</strong> (Google Workspace, Slack, and similar) through SSPM tooling, catching risky OAuth grants and configuration drift before they become incidents.</li> </ul> <p>Access management</p> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Flexport's identity posture:</strong> SSO coverage, phishing-resistant MFA and passkey rollout, SCIM lifecycle automation, and least-privilege access across the SaaS and cloud estate.</li> <li><strong>Lead Flexport's zero-trust journey</strong> — making sure the right people have the right access, with the right controls, verified continuously.</li> </ul> <p>Detection & response</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build and tune detection rules in our SIEM</strong>, turning signal into actionable alerts, not noise.</li> <li><strong>Lead incident response for security events:</strong> triage, contain, remediate, and write the retrospective.</li> </ul> <p>Vulnerability & risk management</p> <ul> <li><strong>Run regular assessments of corporate endpoints</strong> and prioritize findings by real business risk.</li> <li><strong>Manage vendor and third-party security reviews</strong>, working with procurement and legal to evaluate risk before it lands in our environment.</li> </ul> <p>Security enablement & leadership</p> <ul> <li><strong>Partner with IT, Engineering, and People teams</strong> to embed security into the way we work without creating friction that drives people to workarounds.</li> <li><strong>Develop and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and internal documentation</strong> that make the whole team more capable, and mentor engineers earlier in their career.</li> <li><strong>Bring a point of view on how agentic AI tools and browser-based AI assistants change what corporate security needs to watch for</strong>.</li> </ul> <h2>You Should Have</h2> <ul> <li>Typically <strong>5–8 years of experience</strong> in enterprise security, corporate IT security, or information security engineering — we care more about what you've built than the exact number. If you meet most of this, apply.</li> <li><strong>Strong working knowledge of endpoint security tooling:</strong> DLP (Cyberhaven, Purview, Varonis, or similar) and EDR (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or similar).</li> <li><strong>Practical SIEM experience</strong>, writing detection logic, triaging alerts, and reducing false positive noise.</li> <li><strong>Experience leading or playing a significant role in security incident response.</strong></li> <li><strong>Working knowledge of cloud environments</strong> (AWS, GCP, or Azure).</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to Have</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with network security in a cloud-first environment (ZTNA, SASE, DNS filtering).</li> <li>Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform) for security configuration management.</li> <li>Familiarity with SCIM, OIDC, and fine-grained authorization at scale.</li> <li>Experience working in a high-growth, global technology company.</li> <li>Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar, for automating detection, response, and operational tasks.</li> <li>Exposure to privacy regulations relevant to a European and global context (GDPR, etc.).</li> </ul> <h2>How We Work</h2> <ul> <li>We come to the office 3 times a week to hang out, whiteboard, and ship together.</li> <li>We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one.</li> <li>We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.</li> </ul> <h2>Why This Role Is Special</h2> <ul> <li>Broad ownership: you're not a cog in a large security org — you own the corporate security posture end to end, from endpoints to observability to incident response.</li> <li>Real stakes: Flexport operates in 112 countries with a global workforce. Security here matters at a genuine scale.</li> <li>Build, don't just operate: we want to automate and engineer our way to a stronger posture, not just run playbooks.</li> <li>You're part of PSI: the platform, security, and infrastructure teams work hand in hand at Flexport. We value engineering quality and treat security as infrastructure, not just policy.</li> <li>We sponsor visas for the right candidate.</li> </ul> <h2>What's in it for you</h2> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you'll have the chance to create a global impact while being part of a thriving multinational environment.</li> <li>Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on a daily basis.</li> <li>Commute expenses: Flexport will cover home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam.</li> <li>25 working days as vacation days based on full-time employment.</li> <li>Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. title: (Senior) Programmatic Sales GSA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND</strong></p> <p>The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want. </p> <p>Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one.<strong> </strong>That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.</p></div><p> </p> <p><strong>THE ROLE</strong></p> <p>As a Programmatic Sales GSA, you will be responsible for the automated and data-driven sale of our digital advertising inventory (primarily video and CTV) and report directly to the Director Sales All Markets. You will manage programmatic bookings, oversee the planning, implementation and optimisation of our initiatives to boost revenue in programmatic sales, and will therefore also be directly responsible for the optimisation and smooth, technical implementation of campaigns. This makes you the primary point of contact for agency trading desks in the GSA region regarding preferred deals and PMP strategies. You’ll also help with SSP and header bidding integrations and act as the link between Sales, Tech and AdOps.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>THE ADS TEAM</strong></p> <p>The Ads Team is a small but highly efficient team that combines technology and marketing to win customers over in the long term. With a presence in two countries (based in Berlin, Hamburg and Zurich) and operations in six countries, the Ads Team is a key driver of growth within Zattoo and has established itself as the market leader in CTV in Switzerland within a year.</p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Acquisition of new customers, advice, support and guide media agencies, trading desks and direct clients through our programmatic possibilities in a way they can understand.</li> <li>Drawing up and negotiating bespoke programme packages, private deals or preferred deals.</li> <li>Maximise inventory revenue, skilfully manage floor prices (minimum prices) and analyse delivery rates and CPMs.</li> <li>Partner with regional sales teams in GSA to consult clients and pitch programmatic solutions.</li> <li>Co-lead the technical and commercial setup of Header Bidding and additional SSP integrations for CTV.</li> <li>First-line technical ownership of programmatic delivery. </li> <li>Identify technical errors during delivery, analyse tracking issues and check campaign set-ups: troubleshoot deal delivery, floor pricing, and DSP configuration issues (e.g., SSAI, VAST responses, pod management, DSP/SSP bid stream mismatches).</li> <li>Explain complex technical matters in simple terms to non-technical customers or internal departments.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL BRING</strong></p> <ul> <li>4+ years of experience in Programmatic Advertising, SSP Management, or Programmatic Account Management (strong experience in CTV/Video)</li> <li>A proven track record in the sales of digital advertising products</li> <li>Deep understanding of Google Ad Manager, DSP/SSP workflows, OpenRTB specs, and deal types (Preferred Deals, PMP, PG)</li> <li>Experience or strong technical familiarity with Header Bidding frameworks (e.g., Prebid) and SSP integrations</li> <li>Strong network or understanding of the DACH Agency Trading Desk landscape</li> <li>Fluent in German and English</li> <li>Independent, strong communicator, able to work under pressure, with strong negotiation skills  </li> <li>Teamplayer and creative thinker with a questioning mindset.</li> </ul> <p><strong><br>WHY JOIN US? </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.</span></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>WHAT WE OFFER YOU </strong></span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Reward</strong>: strong market competitive salary</li> <li><strong>Recharge</strong>: 30 days vacation plus public holidays</li> <li><strong>Regulate</strong>: <span style="font-weight: 400;">trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year</span><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Plus:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>We’re </strong><strong>sharing: </strong>Free access to the best streaming experience on the market</li> <li><strong>We're developing: </strong>Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days</li> <li><strong>We’re inclusive: ‘</strong>Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities</li> <li><strong>We’re healthy:</strong> Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!</li> <li><strong>We’re responsible:</strong> We are carbon neutral, an active employee Green team, discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals</li> <li><strong>We’re sociable: </strong>A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we share the applicable compensation range with you before your first interview.</p> <p class="text-justify">You can learn more about us at: <a href="https://zattoo.com/company/jobs/">https://zattoo.com</a></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive (Existing Accounts)
description: <h2><strong>About Aiven</strong></h2> <p>Aiven is the open source based data platform that builders trust to run PostgreSQL®, Apache Kafka®, ClickHouse®, OpenSearch®, Valkey™ and more in production, on any cloud. Builders ship faster. Their companies run on data that stays available, secure and under control.</p> <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p>You own the commercial relationship with a book of existing Aiven customers across the UK & Ireland, worth more than $4m in ARR. Your job is to keep those customers, grow them, and turn their success into proof for the next customer. You spot risk early, and find the next use case before the customer asks for it. </p> <p>You also open new doors: cold and warm outreach into accounts that look like your best customers, from first conversation through close.</p> <p>You lead with AI from the front. It shapes how you plan, how you engage and what you say in every customer conversation. Agents do the research, monitoring and first drafts; you decide what matters and where to push. The outcome is growth: more ARR retained, more expanded and more pipeline created, earlier and more predictably.</p> <p>Why now: Aiven has ambitious growth plans, and we're on track. Every customer we serve is building AI, and AI depends on the data platform underneath it. Our open source based platform means no lock-in, so builders ship faster and our customers move with more innovation velocity. You sit at the centre of that, working with customers from Fintech and AI innovators through to Utilities whose AI ambitions depend on us.</p> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <h4><strong>Own the strategic partnership</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Grow each account in your book beyond its current baseline in usage and commitments. This is the primary mandate of the role.</li> <li>Build and run an account plan for every priority account, with clear goals, stakeholders, risks and expansion opportunities across the Aiven platform.</li> <li>Partner with Solutions Architects and Technical Account Managers on technical validation, and bring in Product Engineering, Aiven leadership and executives where a customer needs senior backing.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Retain and grow ARR</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Spot contraction and churn risk early, using usage and sentiment signals surfaced by agents, then act on them before the customer does. Build a protection plan for each risk with the Aiven customer team.</li> <li>Find cross-sell and upsell opportunities across the Aiven platform, and see them through to close.</li> <li>Run renewals as a plan, not an event. Know the commercial position, the decision makers and the competing options well before the renewal date. Lead commercial and contract negotiation through to signature.</li> <li>Qualify and manage every renewal, expansion and new logo opportunity with MEDDPICC.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Build relationships at every level</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Build relationships with the builders who use the Aiven platform day to day (engineering, platform and product leads) and the teams who consume the services it delivers.</li> <li>Build relationships with executives, budget holders and senior IT decision makers.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Turn happy customers into proof</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Use your relationships to build positive sentiment, then work with Marketing to turn it into events, webinars, case studies and references matched to the right prospect.</li> <li>Represent Aiven at UKI industry events, and feed customer, competitive and market insight back to Product, Engineering and leadership.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Open new doors</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Own new logo opportunities in the UKI territory, from prospecting through close, using cold and warm outreach.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Run the book AI-native</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Own how your work gets done: decide which tasks you do, which agents do and which stop entirely. Review this as the tools improve.</li> <li>Run account research, risk and usage monitoring, outreach drafting and forecasting through agents. title: Senior Product Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.</p></div><p data-pm-slice="1 3 []">Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest. Our mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives extends beyond borders. Consumers across the globe need safe, transparent financing. Our retail partners need Affirm to be there for them, wherever that might be. To help achieve this vision, we are expanding our product lines and becoming a global company.</p> <p>The International Consumer product team is responsible for building and scaling Affirm’s direct-to-consumer products and experiences across international markets. This includes our apps, wallets, marketplace, and related offerings that help consumers discover, use, and manage Affirm.</p> <p>As a Senior Product Manager on the International Consumer team, you will drive the strategy, execution, and growth of Affirm’s direct-to-consumer products across international markets – from iterating on the product vision, refining the product strategy, developing a roadmap, and leading execution.<br>In this role, you will work closely with a broad set of cross functional teams across the entire business, as well as a number of engineering teams. Effective stakeholder management and ability to successfully navigate organizational dynamics are a must for success. You should be commercially minded, be high agency with a bias towards action, and comfortable having technical conversations (and opinions). </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Drive the execution, growth, and scale of Affirm’s consumer products and experiences across international markets</p> </li> <li> <p>Take Affirm’s direct-to-consumer products and adapt them for international markets by understanding consumer needs, analyzing performance data, and iterating on the product’s features and capabilities</p> </li> <li> <p>Drive success metrics by shipping high impact work that meaningfully moves the needle for Affirm’s business and customers</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner effectively with engineering teams across the organization to drive product development and prioritization</p> </li> <li> <p>Collaborate with stakeholders (such as Design, Research, Analytics, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, Credit, Fraud, etc.) to shape your product roadmap and incorporate legal, governance, and regulatory oversight into your products</p> </li> <li> <p>Understand Affirm’s international consumers at a deep level: what’s important to them, what drives their decision making, why they love Affirm, and what they wish we could do better</p> </li> <li> <p>Identify and create the experiences that make it seamless for consumers to discover, use, and manage Affirm across our apps, wallets, marketplace, and related direct-to-consumer offerings</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What We Look For</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>This isn’t your first rodeo. You’ve directly managed technical software products from kick-off to post-launch – driving meaningful business impact that you can speak to</p> </li> <li> <p>You have experience working on consumer technology products in Canada, UK, EU, or Australia (bonus points if that experience is in fintech, commerce, marketplaces, or payments)</p> </li> <li> <p>You’re equally comfortable diving into technical details with an engineer, iterating on a Figma with a designer, and breaking down a funnel with a data analyst</p> </li> <li> <p>You have the discipline, organizational skills, and interpersonal communication skills necessary to navigate complex organizational dynamics – you have specific examples of times when you’ve secured a decision from a broad group of senior stakeholders</p> </li> <li> <p>You’ve worked in an environment where you were reliant on engineering teams outside of your direct purview and were able to effectively influence them to prioritize and build what you needed for your product</p> </li> <li> <p>You’re the kind of person who cares about getting things done. You have a bias towards action and can effectively navigate obstacles and blockers</p> </li> <li> <p>You can turn incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous inputs into a solid action plan</p> </li> <li> <p>You have direct experience shipping high-quality products on time</p> </li> <li> <p>You feel comfortable jumping into the commercial aspects of product development – you’re able to connect customer needs, product decisions, and business outcomes, and make clear tradeoffs across them<br><br></p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Pay Grade - N</strong><br><strong>Equity Grade - 5</strong><br><br>Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. <br><br>Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).<br><br>GBR base pay range per year:  £120,000–£168,000 GBP</p> <p>Location - Remote UK<br><br>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><strong>Remote-first with flexibility built in</strong><strong><br></strong>Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.</p> <p><strong>Benefits designed for you</strong><strong><br></strong>Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:</p> <ul> <li>Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.</li> <li>Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.</li> <li>Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.</li> <li>Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.</li> </ul> <p>We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.</p> <p>For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.</p> </div> <div> <p>By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's <a href="https://www.affirm.com/global-candidate-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Global Candidate Privacy Notice</a> and consent to the use of your personal information as described.</p> </div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Full Stack Engineer
description: About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. Department Description Technology sits at the centre of Allica. We design and build the platforms that power the bank, working closely with every part of the business to deliver real impact for customers. Our teams move quickly, focus on outcomes, and take ownership from concept through to delivery. We solve complex problems, modernise processes, and enable the business to scale with confidence. What makes us different is the level of influence and autonomy engineers have. We work without the weight of legacy systems, which means we can focus on building for the future. Everyone contributes ideas and helps shape how we operate, and roles evolve as the organisation grows. This is a place for people who want to have a tangible impact and do their best work in a modern, collaborative environment. Role Description The Staff Full Stack Engineer is responsible for setting technical direction across multiple squads, typically overseeing 2–3 squads and line-managing 3–5 Full Stack Engineers. The role exists to shape architecture, ensure the success of these squads, and drive consistent, secure, and compliant delivery across Allica’s digital products. You will use your expertise in Spring Boot microservices (Java/Kotlin) and modern web technologies (React/TypeScript) to define and evolve cross-squad patterns, shared tooling, and platform capabilities. Our backend microservices are containerised and deployed to Azure Container Apps, and our web applications are deployed to Azure Static Web Apps; you will help define and uphold the standards that make these platforms robust, cost-effective, and easy to operate. You will own key cross-cutting concerns such as authentication, observability, performance, accessibility, and regulatory compliance, ensuring our systems meet the standards expected of a UK bank. You are hands-on: you design and review architectures, pair with engineers, and contribute code to high-impact initiatives. You work closely with Product, Design and other engineering leaders to align technical direction with business goals and to unblock delivery. You drive the responsible adoption of GenAI and agentic engineering practices (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot), setting organisation-wide standards and measuring impact. Success in this role is reflected in simpler architectures, improved delivery consistency and reliability, stronger engineering effectiveness, and the growth and performance of your direct reports and squads. Principal Accountabilities Set and evolve cross-squad technical patterns and guardrails for: Backend services (Kotlin/Java Spring Boot microservices, REST/OpenAPI, messaging, integrations). Frontend architectures (React/TypeScript, shared design system, Nx, micro frontends where appropriate). Authentication/authorisation, API gateways and API governance (versioning, contracts, deprecation). Own platform-level technical initiatives that reduce complexity and duplication, including shared libraries, design system tokens, infrastructure templates, observability frameworks, and code/scaffolding templates. Define and maintain organisation-wide standards for performance, reliability, security, accessibility, and operational excellence, in partnership with Architecture, InfoSec, Risk, and Compliance. Establish and improve SLOs, error budget policies, and incident management practices across key services; lead post-incident reviews and drive follow-through on structural fixes. Lead cross-squad system design for complex initiatives, ensuring coherent architectures, well-managed dependencies, clear domain boundaries, and effective interactions between services and frontends. Shape and continuously improve cloud-native deployment patterns on Azure (Container Apps, Static Web Apps, networking, configuration, and scaling), working closely with Platform Engineering teams. Drive improvements to developer experience (CI/CD, local development workflows, test strategy, release processes) across multiple squads, leveraging GitHub, Azure DevOps and other approved tools. Define and champion responsible AI-assisted engineering practices, including: Standards for using Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot and other approved GenAI tools. Expectations for review and validation of AI-generated code. Measurement and optimisation of productivity gains and quality improvements. Mentor and line-manage Senior Full Stack Engineers, supporting their growth in technical leadership, people leadership, and impact across squads. Foster a culture of learning and continuous improvement through communities of practice, architecture forums, and regular knowledge-sharing. Influence and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders (Product, Design, Operations, Risk, Compliance), aligning technical strategies with product and business roadmaps. Personal Attributes & Experience Extensive experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale using Spring Boot (Kotlin/Java) and modern web technologies (React/TypeScript). Proven track record of simplifying complex architectures and defining cross-team patterns and platforms in a multi-squad environment. Solid experience with containerised workloads and cloud platforms (Azure preferred; AWS or Google Cloud also valuable), including deployment, monitoring, and scaling of microservices and web applications. Deep understanding of secure coding practices (e.g. OWASP), privacy, auditability, and regulatory expectations in financial services or similarly regulated environments. Strong experience with observability, SLOs, incident management, and operational excellence (logging, tracing, metrics, dashboards, on-call practices). Strong understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices, ideally using GiHub actions or Azure DevOps Pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and automated testing at multiple levels. Experience designing and governing APIs at scale (REST, OpenAPI, API gateways, versioning, backwards compatibility, service contracts). Demonstrated ability to lead technical programmes or initiatives that span multiple teams and systems, delivering measurable improvements to reliability, performance, or developer productivity. Experience introducing and scaling the use of new tools and standards across organisations, including GenAI technologies (e.g. GitHub Copilot) with appropriate guardrails. Proven people leadership experience: line-managing senior engineers, coaching technical leaders, and building high-performing, inclusive teams. Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, communicate trade-offs clearly, and build consensus. Working at Allica Bank At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers. Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind: Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities Options for flexible working Regular social activities Pension contributions Discretionary bonus scheme Private health cover Life assurance Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave Don’t tick every box? Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you! Flexible working We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate. Diversity We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like. title: Investment Director (Diagnostics) - Lyon, France
description: Location : Lyon, France ABOUT ARCHIMED With offices in Europe, the US and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare. Our mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise positions us as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Priority areas include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools and Biologic Services, MedTech and Pharma Services. ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages $11 billion across its funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based GP. MED I, MED II and MED Platform I are all top-decile performers for their vintage according to Preqin data. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation. THE TEAM An global team with complementary backgrounds across investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational disciplines. Alumni of INSEAD, Wharton, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, École des Ponts ParisTech, ESSEC, Imperial College and Dartmouth, among others. Professional backgrounds spanning Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, Capiton, Partners Group, KKR), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC, Goldman Sachs, Jefferies) and Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, Stryker, Phillips, Pfizer, Baxter, LivaNova, J&J, Galderma, Sanofi). THE DIAGNOSTICS TEAM The Director will serve as a senior investment professional with direct responsibility for sourcing, evaluating and executing investments across the Diagnostics portfolio. The Director will lead deal activity across an assigned geography, technology platform or investment theme, and will carry accountability for investment outcomes, value creation and portfolio company support. This is a senior operating role combining strategic direction setting with hands-on deal execution, positioning the Director as a trusted senior advisor to Partners and portfolio management teams. Investment Sourcing & Strategy Drive sourcing and pipeline development across assigned Diagnostics sectors or geographies, identifying and cultivating relationships with sellers, intermediaries and LP co-investors. Lead the formation and evolution of investment theses within assigned focus areas, including category mapping, competitive positioning and market trend analysis. Serve as primary investment decision maker and deal sponsor, with direct accountability for investment committee presentations and recommendation. Lead the negotiation of transaction terms, pricing and deal structure in partnership with Partners and external advisors. Due Diligence & Execution Oversee comprehensive commercial, financial and operational due diligence, working with external advisors to validate assumptions and identify key risks and levers. Lead the development of post-acquisition value creation roadmaps, including 100-day plans and multi-year operating strategies. Manage the investment committee approval process and coordinate all transaction closing mechanics with legal and finance teams. Portfolio Leadership & Value Creation Serve as the primary investment relationship owner for assigned portfolio companies, working directly with management teams on strategy, M&A, capital deployment and operational priorities. Lead add-on acquisition identification, evaluation and execution, including syndication with co-investors. Drive performance monitoring and problem-solving, escalating key decisions to Partners and intervention areas to senior management. Sponsor and mentor portfolio company boards, ensuring robust governance and strategic clarity. Team & Platform Development Mentor and develop Senior Analysts and Associate-level team members, contributing to talent development and succession planning within the Diagnostics function. Contribute to ARCHIMED's Diagnostics thought leadership and external positioning through conference participation, investor communication and industry engagement. Identify and build capabilities across the Diagnostics platform to support scaling and evolution of the investment program. Requirements 8 to 12 years of investment or operating experience, with a strong track record in private equity investing, transaction execution or operational leadership within diagnostics sector. Demonstrated success originating, evaluating and closing significant investments (€50 million+ enterprise value preferred), with evidence of value creation across the portfolio. Deep expertise in the Diagnostics landscape, including brand strategy, omnichannel distribution, and regulatory dynamics . Exceptional executive presence and communication skills. Able to command credibility with sophisticated management teams, institutional LPs and external partners. Strong financial acumen and fluency with investment modeling, valuation and deal structuring. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills required. Proven operational judgment and the ability to translate market insights into concrete investment theses and deal opportunities. Track record of building and leading high-performing teams. Comfort with mentoring junior professionals and shaping investment culture. Strategic, entrepreneurial and partnership-minded. Takes ownership of outcomes, moves with pace and brings a builder's orientation to platform development. Advanced degree preferred. MBA or equivalent experience strongly valued. Embodies and reinforces ARCHIMED's cultural values of inclusion, meritocracy, partnership, accountability, client focus and trust. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description: We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly! Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale. This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use. Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems. This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data. What you will do Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption. Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration. Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code. Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products. Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution. Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery. Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes. Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations. What we are looking for Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments. Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes. Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance. Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more. Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows. Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership. Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty. Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries. Useful experience, but not required DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems. Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems. GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems. Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing. Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations. Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby. What we offer you At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team. Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives. Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale. Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working. Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: About the team Within the Global Operations organisation, our mission is to build the best customer experience in the fintech industry by delivering an effortless customer experience to all our merchants. We are seeking a skilled and passionate Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our talented AI team and lead the development of AI models and algorithms that will drive our customer support service to new heights. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SumUp, you will be responsible for building and optimising state-of-the-art AI models and algorithms. Your expertise with machine learning, deep learning, and LLMs will be crucial in driving the success of our AI-driven initiatives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including backend engineers, data scientists and product managers, to translate business requirements into innovative AI solutions. Your contributions will shape the future of our support products and help us stay at the forefront of technological advancements in the field of AI. What you'll do Architect, design, develop and deploy our AI solutions and systems in production environments, ensuring reliability, high performance and scalability. Collaborate and communicate closely with data scientists, product managers, developers and other business stakeholders to bring state-of-the-art AI solutions to Customer Support, enhancing customer experience and improving operational efficiency. Develop and maintain ML infrastructure and pipelines to support efficient data processing, model training and serving. Optimize and fine-tune machine learning models to improve accuracy, efficiency and scalability. Collect, preprocess and clean large text datasets to ensure high-quality input for model training and evaluation. Embrace software development principles, best practices and industry standards, including version control, CI/CD processes and unit testing frameworks as your day-to-day work. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of machine learning solutions into software applications and platforms. You'll be great for this position if you have: Bachelor's degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science or an engineering-related field. +8 years of proven experience working as a Machine Learning Engineer, focusing on building and deploying scalable machine learning or AI solutions and data-driven systems. Relevant experience building AI products, such as Chatbot Assistant, RAG system, etc. Excellent software development engineering skills to design computationally effective solutions and maintenance in large-scale production environments (data version control, model serving, continuous monitoring & alerting) Experience building and deploying ML models using cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Expert in Python and familiarity with MLOps tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, Langfuse). Experience with machine learning workflow orchestration and algorithms optimisation, feature engineering pipelines, data ingestion and transformation. Good understanding of data pipelines, APIs, containers (Docker), and version control (Git). Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail. You have working proficiency and communication skills in verbal and written English. Why you should join SumUp: 🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup. 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education. 🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions 🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp. 🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team. 🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, relocation assistance, subsidised office lunches. title: Finance Business Partner - Membership & Consumer Finance (m/w/d)
description: Für ein wachstumsorientiertes Dienstleistungsunternehmen mit kundenbasierten, wiederkehrenden Geschäftsmodellen suchen wir einen Finance Business Partner (m/w/d) . In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die kaufmännische Steuerung zentraler Geschäftsbereiche und sind geschätzter Sparringspartner für Management und Fachbereiche. Aufgaben Kaufmännische Begleitung der verantworteten Geschäftsbereiche sowie Beratung des Managements in steuerungsrelevanten Fragestellungen (Business Partnering) Verantwortung für Budget, Forecast und Mehrjahresplanung inklusive P&L-, Bilanz- und Cash-Planung sowie Analyse und Kommentierung wesentlicher Abweichungen Weiterentwicklung der finanziellen und operativen Steuerung mit Fokus auf Wachstum, Umsatz, Marge, Profitabilität und Cash-Bedarf Analyse zentraler Werttreiber wie Neukundengewinnung, Pricing, Akquisitionskosten, Kundenbindung sowie Produkt- und Partnerkosten Steuerung von Finanzierungsvolumen, Forderungen, Unit Economics sowie Ergebnis-, Funding- und Cash-Entwicklung Erstellung von Business Cases, Szenario- und Sensitivitätsanalysen für neue Produkte, Kooperationen und Wachstumsinitiativen Erstellung adressatengerechter Management- und Board-Reportings sowie Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen Qualifikation Sie haben ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Controlling, Finance oder Rechnungswesen abgeschlossen. Sie arbeiten sehr sicher mit gängigen ERP-Systemen und Excel und setzen PowerPoint für Entscheidungsunterlagen ein. Sie kommunizieren sicher mit dem Management und verfügen über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Benefits Arbeitsort ist Frankfurt am Main. Bei der angebotenen Position handelt es sich um eine Vollzeitstelle in Festanstellung. Sie erhalten Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung und beruflichen Entwicklung. Sie profitieren von flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen und der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten. Sie können eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und einen Zuschuss zur Ausstattung für mobiles Arbeiten nutzen. title: C005435 Principal Technician (ICT Systems) (NS) - MON 26 Oct
description: Deadline Date: Monday 26 October 2026 Requirement: Principal Technician (ICT Systems) Location: The Hague, NL Full Time On-Site: Yes Time On-Site: 100% Total Scope of the request (hours): 300 Required Start Date: 3 November 2026 End Contract Date: 31 December 2026 Required Security Clearance: NATO SECRET Duties & Role: The Principal Technician (ICT Systems) is responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of information and communication technology systems. He/she provide technical support to end-users and troubleshoot any issues that arise. They stay up to date with the latest technology trends and make recommendations for system improvements. They handle tasks related to configuring hardware and software, managing computers and networks devices, troubleshooting technical issues, ensuring data security and system reliability, and provide technical support to end-users. They collaborate with various departments to understand their technology needs and optimize the organization's ICT infrastructure to support business operations efficiently. Duties and Responsibilities: Software configuration Assists in designing, verifying, documenting, amending and refactoring moderately complex software configurations for deployment. Applies agreed standards and tools, to achieve a well-engineered result. Collaborates in reviews of work with others as appropriate. System software Monitors operational systems for resource usage and failure rates, to inform and facilitate system software tuning. Applies system software parameters to maximise throughput and efficiency. Installs and tests new versions of system software. Contributes to preparation of software implementation procedures with fall back contingency plans. Network support Carries out agreed network maintenance tasks and specified operational configuration of network components. Establish and diagnose network problems/faults using the required troubleshooting methodology and tools. Uses network management software and tools to collect agreed performance and traffic statistics. Systems installation and removal Installs or removes hardware and/or software, using supplied installation instructions and tools, including handover to the client. Uses standard procedures and diagnostic tools to test installations, correct problems, and document results. Records details of all components that have been installed and removed. Assists users and follows agreed procedures for further help or escalation. Contributes to the development of installation procedures and standards. Release and deployment Uses approved tools and techniques for specific deployment activities. Administers the recording of activities, logging of results and documents technical activities undertaken. Additional duties for this post: The Principal Technician (ICT Systems) will provide 24/7 Immediate On-Call Response to the Service Operations with technical AirC2 expertise and solutions at Level 2 support with ticket response and resolutions that will meet current operational needs and defined Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). The Principal Technician (ICT Systems) will work as an on-site integrated member of the assigned service team, when not on 24/7 on-call duty for immediate ticket response and resolution. He will help with the design, development, test and on-site support of engineering changes to services, processes, organisation, operating model and other aspects. description: <p>The Continuous Profiler (<a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/continuous-profiling-fourth-pillar/">https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/continuous-profiling-fourth-pillar/</a>) team at Datadog is building a cutting-edge continuous profiling product that has low enough overhead to run continuously in production, unlocking insights into how customer applications perform under real workloads at scale. As AI reshapes software development and teams lose touch with how their code works and interacts with the hardware, this capability is becoming more essential than ever, for humans and AI alike. Today the information produced by our profilers is used for everything from automatic performance tuning to root cause analysis.</p> <p>As a distributed systems engineer on the profiling team, you will be contributing to the systems that intake, process, index, store and make sense of the data collected. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: <p>Duetto's platform runs 24/7 for hotels, resorts, and casinos around the world, and that reliability doesn't happen by accident. We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to architect, build, and own the AWS infrastructure that keeps our Revenue & Profit Operating System fast, secure, and always on, while helping shape how our engineering org automates its way out of manual toil.</p> <h2><strong>What Makes Us Different?</strong></h2> <p>Duetto is the hospitality industry's leading revenue management platform, founded in 2012 by former Wynn Resorts executives who knew the industry needed better technology. We built the world's first Revenue & Profit Operating System — a suite of tools (GameChanger, ScoreBoard, BlockBuster, Advance and more) that goes beyond room pricing to give hotels, resorts and casinos a complete picture of their revenue and profitability. Trusted by clients ranging from independent boutique hotels to global chains, we've been named the #1 Revenue Management Software by HotelTechAwards four years running and the #1 Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech in 2025. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, we're accelerating our investment in AI, and we're genuinely passionate about the industry we serve. We build products we're proud of, for customers we care about.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Architect and implement infrastructure for seamless migrations of critical systems, keeping uptime and reliability front and center</li> <li>Design, build, and maintain the tooling and processes that let our SaaS products scale and run themselves on AWS</li> <li>Partner closely with developers to strengthen the reliability, performance, security, and scalability of our application architecture</li> <li>Build and maintain the critical infrastructure components that keep everything highly available and secure</li> <li>Drive alignment across technical and non-technical teams, making sure infrastructure decisions serve the whole business</li> <li>Take your turn as last line of defense in our weekly on-call rotation, leading root cause analysis and driving fixes that stick for good</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <p><strong>You may be a good fit if you have the following:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years in an Ops, DevOps, or SRE role, with real system design and architecture chops. You're comfortable administering cloud infrastructure hands-on (AWS preferred, Azure or GCP also welcome), and you know your way around networking and security at an engineering level. </li> <li>You're fluent in the AWS ecosystem (IAM, VPC, EC2, ELB, RDS, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch, CloudTrail), have run Terraform/Terragrunt in production, and have worked with Chef or Puppet. </li> <li>You're at home with GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, JFrog Artifactory, and GitOps workflows, and you've used DataDog, Prometheus, or Grafana to keep tabs on system health. </li> <li>You can read Java, Ruby, Bash/Zsh, HCL, Python, and JavaScript well enough to move fast across a codebase.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strong candidates may also have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with ECS or EKS, exposure to SOC2 or secure-by-default practices</li> <li>Familiarity with L7 load balancing.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Why Duetto?</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You'll own meaningful infrastructure decisions, not just execute someone else's blueprint. New tooling choices are proposed with a business case and decided as a team, so your judgment matters</li> <li>We're an AI-forward company across every function, not just engineering. You'll be equipped to use AI for things like incident triage, IaC code generation, and runbook authoring, and encouraged to push that further</li> <li>You'll work at the intersection of serious infrastructure and an industry we genuinely love. Our customers depend on us around the clock, and that shows up in how seriously we take reliability</li> <li>Real collaboration, not silos. You'll partner directly with developers and cross-functional teams to solve problems together, not just file tickets</li> <li>We celebrate diverse perspectives and back that up with the room to debate ideas openly. Come as you are, and bring your full self to the work</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>The Details</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Location: Remote, Croatia, Spain or UK</li> <li>Work model: Fully remote</li> <li>Weekly on-call rotation as last line of support for 24/7 services</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Duetto is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Sound like you?</strong></h2> <p>If this sounds like the kind of infrastructure work that gets you excited, apply even if you don't check every single box. We'd rather meet someone with the right instincts and hunger to grow than tick boxes on a checklist.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-REMOTE</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Product Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who we are:</strong></p> <p>Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.</p> <p>Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.</p> <p>Visit <a href="http://gomotive.com">gomotive.com</a> to learn more.</p></div><h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>As the Staff Product Manager, UK Market, you will define and execute Motive's product strategy for the UK, with the opportunity to expand your scope to continental Europe over time. You will own the commercial roadmap: where we compete, what we build, and in what order. You will then deliver it, working with engineering teams and peers across the product organization.</p> <p>International expansion is one of the most important strategic initiatives at Motive. You will partner closely with sales, marketing, customer success, finance, product leaders, designers, and engineers to bring our products to customers who face different regulations, vehicles, hardware, and buying needs than in the US. You will be a senior voice in the room as leadership decides where to invest, and you will see those decisions through to shipped product.</p> <p>To succeed, you must be comfortable influencing leaders across the company and navigating complex technical and organizational challenges. We operate like a startup within a larger organization, so you will wear many hats. Being entrepreneurial, commercially minded, and growth-oriented is critical.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define the UK product strategy. Decide which segments, products, and use cases to prioritise to win, grounded in customer, competitive, and regulatory insight.</li> <li>Align the company on the right commercial roadmap. Work with GTM, finance, and executive leadership to turn market opportunity into prioritised roadmaps, business cases, and investment asks.</li> <li>Execute with engineering. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>The Senior Payroll Specialist owns end-to-end Dutch payroll, operated in Nmbrs, and acts as the designated backup for the company’s other international payrolls. This role harmonizes, simplifies, and continuously improves payroll execution and payroll accounting across the company’s Dutch entities, pay groups, providers, and systems. This is to make sure payroll remains accurate, compliant, trusted, and understandable as the company grows without a proportional increase in manual work or risk. As international backup, the role maintains working proficiency in the company’s other country payrolls and provides continuity during peak periods, absences, and year-end.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Your responsibilities will include:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true}"> </span></p> <ul> <li>Own end-to-end Dutch payroll execution in Nmbrs across entities and pay groups: monthly and off-cycle runs, holiday allowance, year-end close and annual statements (jaaropgaven), and the payroll calendar; define consistent execution standards that meet Dutch statutory and contractual requirements.</li> <li>Ensure Dutch payroll tax and social security compliance: wage tax and national insurance contributions (loonheffingen), employee insurance and Zvw premiums, the work-related costs scheme (WKR), timely and accurate loonaangifte to the Belastingdienst, corrections, and resolution of Belastingdienst and UWV correspondence.</li> <li>Administer regulated and complex pay items accurately: the 30% ruling and other expatriate and cross-border arrangements, equity income (RSU/option) taxation, pension contributions and provider files, sick leave and statutory leave schemes, transition payments and termination settlements, wage garnishments (loonbeslag), and taxable benefits-in-kind.</li> <li>Run and reconcile shadow payrolls in Nmbrs for internationally mobile employees (inbound assignees, cross-border and remote workers, and outbound Dutch employees with a host-country shadow payroll)</li> <li>Serve as the designated backup for the company’s other international payrolls: maintain working knowledge of country calendars, providers, and controls, and run or support pay cycles during absences, peak periods, and year-end in coordination with the payroll owners.</li> <li>Lead root-cause analysis for recurring payroll, accounting, or service failures; design and implement durable fixes.</li> <li>Drive process harmonization and simplification to reduce manual steps, handoffs, rework, and off-cycle runs; make full use of Nmbrs functionality, integrations, and reporting.</li> <li>Lead payroll execution during transitions (new entity launches, provider or system changes, restructures/M&A), ensuring continuity and control.</li> <li>Ensure payroll accounting remains clean as scope changes: consistent journals, accruals, reversals, and reconciliation standards.</li> <li>Monitor preventative controls by design, including SOX-aligned payroll controls; improve evidence pack quality and audit readiness.</li> <li>Act as escalation owner for complex or sensitive pay issues; provide authoritative explanations to employees and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Partner with HR Ops, Finance, Legal/Compliance, Nmbrs, and international payroll providers to deliver scalable operating models and service quality.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">We expect you to have:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true}"> </span></p> <ul> <li>At least 7+ years of Dutch payroll experience, including multi-entity scope in complex environments (growth, change, or hybrid in-house/outsourced models).</li> <li>Hands-on Nmbrs experience: running payroll end to end, configuring wage components and journal mappings, managing loonaangifte and corrections, and using its reporting and integrations (HRIS, GL, pension and benefits providers).</li> <li>Deep working knowledge of Dutch payroll compliance: loonheffingen and social security, WKR, the 30% ruling, expatriate taxation and shadow payroll, pension administration, sick leave and statutory leave, termination settlements, and year-end reporting.</li> <li>Working knowledge of international payroll (running or overseeing outsourced country payrolls) and readiness to act as the designated backup for the company’s other payrolls.</li> <li>Strong payroll controllership skills: ability to design controls, enforce SoD/approvals, and ensure audit-ready evidence.</li> <li>Proven capability improving payroll processes (standardization, automation enablement, reducing manual effort and errors) and leading transitions (vendor/system/new entity) with structured planning and issue resolution.</li> <li>Strong payroll accounting knowledge and experience working with Finance during close and audits.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management; comfortable acting as an escalation owner and payroll authority.</li> <li>Fluent English and professional working proficiency in Dutch (statutory correspondence, legislation, and provider documentation are in Dutch).</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">It will be an added bonus if you have:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true}"> </span></p> <ul> <li>Dutch payroll qualification (PDL and/or VPS) and/or Nmbrs certification.</li> <li>Experience with international payroll providers or aggregators and multi-country operating models (SLAs, KPIs, remediation).</li> <li>Experience operating payroll controls in a SOX-compliant, US-listed company environment.</li> <li>Experience with equity compensation payroll (RSUs/options), including cross-border cases and trailing tax liabilities.</li> <li>Experience supporting Global Mobility programs: shadow payroll set-up, tax equalization/protection and hypothetical tax, gross-ups, and year-end assignee reconciliations with tax advisors.</li> <li>Experience turning statutory/operational requirements into system/workflow requirements (e.g., Nmbrs–HRIS–GL integrations).</li> <li>Project management certification or comparable experience leading cross-functional initiatives.</li> </ul> <h4>Competencies & Behavioral Traits:</h4> <ul> <li>Systems thinking: redesigns the process so it scales, rather than adding checks and manual work.</li> <li>Bias for prevention: anticipates issues and builds guardrails.</li> <li>Influence without authority; can align multiple stakeholders around standards.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity and change; makes decisions with incomplete information.</li> <li>Reliability and ownership: a dependable backup who keeps continuity across payrolls when it matters most.</li> <li>Strong coaching mindset; elevates capability across the payroll team.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits & Perks:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation</li> <li>Career growth and learning opportunities</li> <li>Flexibility and ownership</li> <li>Collaborative and innovative culture</li> <li>Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects</li> <li>International environment and talented teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's it like to work at Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI </p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://redditinc.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div><p>Working as a Senior Growth Manager supporting Reddit’s International Community team, you will develop and execute initiatives that strengthen Reddit’s user and community ecosystems in the US and across international markets.</p> <p><strong>This position is open to candidates based in the UK or the US - East Coast.</strong></p> <p>This is not a marketing role. You will identify high-impact growth opportunities, design and execute experiments, and develop successful interventions into repeatable models that can be applied across markets. Your work may include building and scaling communities, increasing the supply of relevant content and contributions, reaching underserved audiences, and strengthening Reddit’s user experience.</p> <p>The role combines growth strategy, hands-on experimentation, data analysis, and cross-functional influence. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketing, and Community teams while maintaining the autonomy and entrepreneurial mindset required to scale successful initiatives to other markets.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>User & Community Growth Strategies: </strong>Establish and execute comprehensive strategies to grow the user base and nurture communities. </li> <li><strong>Growth Experimentation:</strong> Design and execute growth experiments aimed at addressing gaps in content supply, community density, contribution, discovery, engagement, and user growth. Determine which elements can scale broadly, which require local adaptation, and what operational or product support is needed to unlock broader impact.</li> <li><strong>Data & Performance Analytics: </strong>Monitor key growth and ecosystem indicators, including DAU, contribution, content supply, community health, and retention. Analyze performance trends, identify risks and opportunities, and establish clear measurement frameworks for experiments and scaled programs.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional Collaboration: </strong>Partner with various internal teams to provide insights, shape priorities, and scale growth initiatives. Build compelling evidence through experimentation to influence cross-functional investment and product development.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>7+ years of experience in user growth, product operations, or market expansion, with a demonstrated track record of executing growth initiatives at scale.</li> <li>Strong entrepreneurial instincts, hands-on execution skills, and the ability to make progress independently in ambiguous or resource-constrained environments.</li> <li>Data-driven and analytical mindset, with proficiency in Excel modeling, working knowledge of SQL, and experience creating scalable processes and automations.</li> <li>Strong systems thinking, with the ability to distinguish between market-specific problems and growth opportunities that can be addressed through repeatable approaches.</li> <li>Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and align cross-functional stakeholders across global teams.</li> <li>Results-oriented mindset, strong attention to detail, and a bias toward execution.</li> <li>Comfort balancing a portfolio of opportunities across the US and international markets and prioritizing based on potential impact, feasibility, and strategic relevance.</li> </ul> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.  We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.  We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.  For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our <a href="https://redditinc.com/policies/candidate-privacy-policy">Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors</a>.</span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.  Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.</span></em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description: Do you get energy from winning new customers? Do you know how to build a pipeline from scratch, engage senior decision-makers and turn complex business challenges into successful deals? At Yenlo, we are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive who knows how to create opportunities, not just manage them. We have the technology expertise, strong partnerships and delivery capabilities. What we need is someone who can bring us to the right table, create demand and win new business. We do this with around 100 colleagues from over 18 nationalities, with offices in the Netherlands, Germany, Spain, Sri Lanka, the United States and Canada. We have been a WSO2 Platinum Partner since 2008 and a Boomi partner since 2015, and our customers include Boeing, Hard Rock Café and several ministries and universities. Now we are building on our integration expertise with Data, AI and Automation, so customers can bring their technology into production securely and reliably. For that, we are looking for someone who opens new markets. What will you do? As Enterprise Account Executive, your primary mission is to win new customers and build profitable, long-term business relationships. You will focus on mid-market and enterprise organisations across the Benelux and DACH regions, particularly those facing complex challenges around applications, integration, data, cloud transformation and AI. Your responsibilities include: Win new logos and build your own pipeline. Identify target accounts, open doors and generate business through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and strategic partnerships. Engage senior decision-makers and sell business value. Build relationships with CIOs, CTOs and other business and technology leaders, and translate their challenges into opportunities around Integration, Data, AI, Automation and Control. Own the sales cycle. Lead opportunities from initial engagement through proposal, negotiation and closing, together with our solution architects, consultants and product specialists. Help shape our go-to-market. Bring customer insights and market feedback into Yenlo to help us improve our propositions and commercial approach. Deliver results. Take ownership of your pipeline, forecasts, new-business targets and the profitability of the deals you win. You will have access to existing customer references, partner relationships and marketing support. A new-business role with the freedom to develop opportunities and make a visible commercial impact. Attractive earning potential. A competitive fixed salary and a substantial performance-based bonus, with uncapped upside for overachievement. A strong technology portfolio. Established capabilities in Integration, API Management, IAM and Managed Services, complemented by growing propositions in Data, AI and Control. Access to specialists. Experienced solution architects, consultants and product teams to support discovery, demonstrations, assessments and proposals. An international ecosystem. Partnerships with leading technology providers, including Boomi and WSO2, alongside Yenlo's own Connext platform. Room to build. The opportunity to contribute to our evolving commercial approach, propositions and go-to-market strategy. Professional benefits. Pension arrangements, holiday allowance, a lease car or mobility allowance, laptop and phone. A realistic start. An appropriate ramp-up period, recognising that enterprise sales cycles take time and building a pipeline starts from day one. You will work closely with our sales leadership and wider commercial organisation. We believe in face-to-face collaboration, both with customers and colleagues, and expect you to spend time at our Schiphol-Rijk office on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays. We are looking for a commercially driven, entrepreneurial sales professional with a proven track record in complex B2B technology sales. You know how to build relationships, navigate enterprise organisations and close significant deals.
