An entrepreneurial mindset and the resilience to succeed without a fully established sales playbook. The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with technical and commercial colleagues. Professional proficiency in Dutch and English. Experience with platforms such as Boomi, WSO2, MuleSoft, AWS, Azure or related enterprise technologies is an advantage, but not a requirement. An existing network in the Benelux or DACH enterprise market would be a strong plus. description: Wer wir sind und was wir suchen Ob die Energiewende gelingt, entscheidet sich nicht allein an Technologien, sondern an Kosten, Märkten und politischen Weichenstellungen. Genau dazu arbeitet das Energy Lab des Dezernat Zukunft – und um unsere Arbeit weiter zu vertiefen, suchen wir Dich. Das Dezernat Zukunft ist ein überparteilicher Berliner Think Tank an der Schnittstelle von Politik, Verwaltung und Forschung. Rund 30 Personen verfolgen gemeinsam das Ziel, Geld-, Finanz- und Wirtschaftspolitik neu zu denken und verständlich zu vermitteln. In dieser Position konzipierst Du Analysen und Studien zu Energiemärkten – insbesondere zum Strommarkt – und führst sie eigenständig durch. Dabei betrachtest Du Energiekosten, Investitionsbedarfe, Gesamtsystemkosten sowie die Wechselwirkungen politischer Instrumente mit diesen Größen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Fragen, wie sich Energiepolitik mit Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, Nachhaltigkeit und Bezahlbarkeit zusammendenken lässt, wie Energiekosten strategisch und gezielt gesenkt werden können, und wie das regulatorische Umfeld so ausgestaltet werden kann, dass es den Erfolg der „zweiten Hälfte der Energiewende“ und damit die Erreichung der Klimaneutralität ermöglicht. Deine Aufgaben Du analysierst Energiemärkte und -preise, einschließlich Systemkosten, und koordinierst dazu Forschungsprojekte . Dabei betrachtest Du auch fiskalpolitische Auswirkungen sowie Wechselwirkungen mit dem Stromnetzausbau. Du entwickelst konkrete Politikvorschläge, Analysen und Positionen zu den oben genannten Themen , in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Kolleg:innen im Energy Lab des Dezernat Zukunft sowie den weiteren Teams der Organisation. Außerdem organisierst Du Expert:innen-Gespräche und andere inhaltliche Veranstaltungen. Du interagierst aktiv mit Vertreter:innen von Parlamenten, Regierungen, Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft und Medien . Einen Arbeitsplatz in Berlin-Mitte mit der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten und gemeinsam vereinbarten Kernzeiten. Unbürokratische, verständnisvolle Regelungen bei kurzfristigen Care-Bedarfen; bezahlte Freistellung nach § 29 TVöD bei persönlichen Anlässen (z. B. kranke Kinder). Einen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket oder JobRad. Und nicht zuletzt: Ein dynamisches,motiviertes Team, gemeinsame Events (z. B. Berg- oder Paddel-Ausflüge) und Arbeit, die zählt. Dein Profil Du teilst unsere Werte und Ziele , begeisterst Dich für Energie- und Klimapolitik und brennst dafür, dass die Transformation gelingt. Du hast einen Master-Abschluss in einem relevanten Fachgebiet sowie mindestens zwei Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung. Du kennst Dich in Energiemärkten – insbesondere im Strommarkt – aus, verstehst politische Instrumente und erkennst, welche Zahlen für politische Entscheidungen und ökonomische Weichenstellungen wirklich zählen. Du konzipierst und erstellst eigene Analysen – quantitativ wie textlich – selbstständig und gründlich. Du hast bereits erfolgreich Forschungsprojekte umgesetzt und Ergebnisse sowie politische Handlungsempfehlungen prägnant kommuniziert. Du bist Dir bewusst, dass unsere Analysen und Vorschläge in der Öffentlichkeit intensiv geprüft werden, und arbeitest entsprechend gewissenhaft und bist bereit, als Eigentümer:in für Deine Projekte einzustehen. Du kommunizierst sehr gut in deutscher und englischer Sprache und verfasst in beiden Sprachen anspruchsvolle, gut verständliche Texte. Du hast fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in der praktischen Anwendung gängiger KI-Programme. Du willst den Dingen auf den Grund gehen und jeden Tag dazulernen. Noch wichtiger als mitgebrachtes Wissen ist für uns die Fähigkeit, es zu erweitern und Meinungen zu ändern. Du arbeitest gern im Team, hörst zu und unterstützt und förderst Deine Kolleg:innen. Die perfekte Kandidat:in erfüllt nicht immer jede Anforderung. Wenn Du glaubst, dass Du zu uns passt – bewirb Dich gern trotzdem und sag uns, warum. Beschäftigungsbeginn & Vertragsbedingungen Beginn: Von uns aus so schnell wie möglich. Im Anschluss an das Bewerbungsverfahren rechnen wir mit einem Start im Januar 2027. Das genaue Startdatum ist verhandelbar. Umfang: 32–39 Stunden/Woche (flexibel je nach Deiner Verfügbarkeit). Befristung: zunächst 1 Jahr (Entfristung nach zwei Jahren angestrebt). Bewerbungsverfahren Bitte bewirb Dich online mit Lebenslauf und einem kurzen Anschreiben, das Deine Eignung entlang der oben genannten Kriterien zeigt. Bitte teile uns auch mit, wie Du auf die Stelle aufmerksam geworden bist und welche Wochenarbeitszeit Du bevorzugen würdest. Bewerbungsfrist: 08. November 2026 Das Bewerbungsverfahren besteht aus drei Runden: im ersten Schritt einem Assessment-Test, der aus einer schriftlichen Aufgabe besteht und ca. 1-2 Stunden Arbeitszeit beansprucht; anschließend ein längeres Gespräch bei uns vor Ort im Büro und einem abschließenden Gespräch mit unserem Head of Energy Lab – Janek Steitz. Wir schätzen Vielfalt und möchten die Diversität unseres Teams fördern. title: Recruiting Coordinator, Tokyo
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission. We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator in our Tokyo office to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process in Japan and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion. WHAT YOU’LL DO: CREATE A CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS NOTION You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome. COORDINATE INTERVIEWS WITH CARE AND PRECISION You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across multiple time zones, primarily supporting Go-To-Market teams, including remote interviews and onsite panels. You’ll balance speed with attention to detail, anticipate needs, and communicate proactively to keep candidates and interviewers aligned. You’ll ensure logistics, materials, and feedback loops are clear and on time, and troubleshoot day-of changes and scheduling conflicts with a calm, solutions-oriented approach, making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly. BUILD STRONG RECRUITING FOUNDATIONS This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, talent branding projects, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow, creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles. WHAT YOU’LL BRING: - At least 1–2 years of experience in recruiting coordination or interview scheduling, ideally in a high-volume environment - Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with a proactive, reliable approach and thoughtful attention to detail - A growth mindset, with a willingness to take ownership of mistakes, learn from feedback, and refine your processes to improve accuracy and consistency - A steady, calm approach in fast-moving environments - Ability to navigate ambiguity with optimism - Clear, kind, and professional communication skills to represent Notion to a large and diverse group of candidates - Fluency in Japanese and business-level English proficiency, with the ability to communicate effectively with candidates and colleagues in both languages - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results NICE TO HAVES: - Experience supporting both technical and non-technical roles, including remote and in-person interview scheduling - Experience with Ashby, Workday, Slack, and Notion - Experience in a high-growth or startup environment #LI-Onsite By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Account Solutions Architect - Engaged - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></h2> <p>The infrastructure powering the AI era doesn’t sell itself, and the customers building on it don’t want to be sold to. They want a peer. You’ll work as part of a focused three-person team alongside one Account Executive and one Account Manager, together responsible for landing new accounts and expanding within them across the region. The customers you’ll work with are AI labs, research institutions, and enterprises running some of the most demanding GPU workloads in the world. This is a role for someone who shows up with substance, who can hold a real conversation about model training and MLOps tooling in the morning and cluster networking in the afternoon, and who finds the space between infrastructure and application more interesting than either on its own.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role:</strong></h2> <p>As an Account Solution Architect covering Northern EMEA, you’ll move across the full stack depending on what the customer needs, from ML training workflows and MLOps platforms like Weights & Biases to bare metal GPU infrastructure and physical AI deployments. This isn’t a role built around a single layer of the stack, but the majority of your conversations will live in the ML layer. You’ll be expected to go deeper than most when the infrastructure conversation demands it, while staying commercially aware enough to support both new logo pursuits and in-flight account expansion. This role requires up to 40% travel.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Cover Northern EMEA, with a focus on the Nordics and Benelux regions (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg).</li> <li>Work closely with one Account Executive and one Account Manager as a dedicated three-person unit, supporting the full land and expand motion across the region.</li> <li>Lead technical discovery with prospects and existing customers to understand model training requirements, MLOps workflows, and infrastructure constraints.</li> <li>Design and present solutions spanning ML infrastructure, GPU compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes-based orchestration, and MLOps tooling.</li> <li>Run proof-of-concept engagements and architecture reviews, and see them through to a decision.</li> <li>Act as the internal voice of the customer, feeding technical requirements and product gaps back to Engineering and Product.</li> <li>Maintain clear documentation of customer architectures, solution designs, and outstanding technical questions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>3+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or solutions architecture role, ideally with a focus on AI/ML platforms, cloud infrastructure, or HPC.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of ML training and inference workflows - you understand how models are built, optimized, and deployed, not just where they run.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with MLOps platforms and the tooling AI teams use day-to-day, including experiment tracking, pipeline orchestration, and model serving.</li> <li>Experience with AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.</li> <li>Comfortable going below the SaaS layer when the conversation demands it - GPU topology, network fabric, and cluster architecture shouldn’t be unfamiliar territory.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads at scale.</li> <li>Strong communication skills - you can adjust your register from a research engineer to a VP of Infrastructure without losing credibility at either end.</li> <li>Experience managing multiple concurrent opportunities across a geographic territory.</li> <li>Fluency in English required; proficiency in Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, or Finnish is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100, A100, H200) and the software stack around them: CUDA, NCCL, cuDNN.</li> <li>Working knowledge of high-performance networking concepts: InfiniBand, RDMA, RoCE, TCP/IP.</li> <li>Background working directly with AI labs, research institutions, or enterprise ML teams.</li> <li>Exposure to physical AI use cases and the infrastructure requirements they bring.</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.</li> </ul> <p>Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams - even if you aren’t a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.</p> <ul> <li>You’re comfortable going one layer deeper than the demo - whether that’s a networking topology, a training job that won’t converge, or a rack layout question from a facilities team.</li> <li>You’ve worked across more than one layer of the stack and find the intersections more interesting than any single discipline.</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-moving environment and take ownership of your region like it’s your own business.</li> <li>You’re a natural collaborator who makes the people around you - including your AE and AM - better at their jobs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h2> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p><em>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
description: TopChrono , leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies. Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous ! Ce que nous vous offrons Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs). Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière. Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement. Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation. Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact ! Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes : Rattachement hiérarchique • Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au niveau national. Mission principale Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Métrologie et maîtrise de la température • Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise. • Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques. • Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.). • Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements. • Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives. • Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC. Étude et déploiement des matériels • Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise. • Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée. • Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués. • Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels. • Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test. • Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température. • Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils. Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation • Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules. • Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité. • Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température. • Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels). • Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées. • Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées. Gestion des fournisseurs • Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques. • Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations. • Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires. • Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée. Qualité et amélioration continue • Participer aux audits internes et externes. • Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail. • Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance. • Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité. • Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue. • Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température). ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à : • proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ; • valider les choix techniques des installations ; • décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ; • arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ; • sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation. • Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations. RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES En interne • Direction des Opérations • Responsable Parc Automobile • Responsable Exploitation • Service Qualité • Conducteurs • Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température). En externe • Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques • Prestataires de métrologie • Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques. PROFIL RECHERCHE Formation • Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent. Expérience • 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire. • Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne. Compétences techniques • Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision. • Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid. • Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15- 140 / COFRAC). • Analyse de données de température. • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique. Qualités personnelles • Sens de l'organisation. • Rigueur et méthode. • Esprit d'analyse. • Capacité de prise de décision. • Aisance relationnelle. • Force de proposition. • Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs. • Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence. Objectifs du poste • Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques. • Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules. • Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique. • Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température. • Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport. • Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

support for day-to-day tasks.</li> <li>Roadmap Management: Maintain a prioritized backlog of automation opportunities, assessed by time savings, compliance impact, and implementation complexity; Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>New York, US</li> <li>San Francisco, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a Strategy Manager to join the Developer GTM Strategy & Incubation team, focused on Technical Programs. This person will help Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, Professional Services, and Developer GTM leadership identify the right customer opportunities, organize technical GTM work, and turn high-value customer engagement into repeatable programs and operating rhythms.</p> <p>The Developer GTM Strategy & Incubation function exists to evolve the way the Developer GTM team works, designing systems, processes, and GTM motions that accelerate consumption at Cloudflare. This role is focused on the technical side of that motion: where we should spend time, how we coordinate technical resources, how we run customer-facing programs, and how we measure whether technical work is driving the right business outcomes.</p> <p>The right person is a high-agency operator with strong technical fluency. They do not need to be a Solutions Architect, but they should be comfortable working with technical products, customer architectures, implementation workflows, developer platforms, and customer-facing technical teams.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Build and scale technical programs: </strong>Design proactive programs for Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and related technical GTM teams. Clarify goals, stakeholders, timelines, resourcing, risks, success criteria, and follow-up.</li> <li><strong>Plan and scale technical onsite visits:</strong> Build the planning model for strategic customer onsites, including intake, agenda design, staffing, prep, execution, post-onsite follow-up, and measurement.</li> <li><strong>Improve prioritization and visibility:</strong> Own a clear view of active technical engagements, upcoming opportunities, blockers, outcomes, and resourcing needs. Partner with Revenue Engineering, Data, Sales Strategy, and technical leaders on account propensity, engagement tracking, dashboards, and operating reviews.</li> <li><strong>Support Professional Services packaging and commercialization: </strong>Partner with Professional Services, Finance, Product, Sales Strategy, and GTM leaders on pricing, packaging, business cases, rollout plans, and feedback loops for technical services offerings.</li> <li><strong>Incubate and launch new technical programs:</strong> Lead high-priority projects across Developer GTM, support team planning and process improvements, turn technical activity into clear business narratives, and incubate new motions until they are measurable and ready for durable ownership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of projects this person may own</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build a proactive SA/FDE engagement program for a priority customer segment or product motion.</li> <li>Partner on an account propensity model that helps determine SA/FDE prioritization, resourcing, and account coverage.</li> <li>Stand up a technical engagement tracker for active customer work, resourcing, blockers, and outcomes.</li> <li>Design the planning and follow-up model for technical onsite visits with strategic customers.</li> <li>Partner with Professional Services to package a repeatable services motion and build the business case for rollout.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solutions Architects and FDEs have a clearer operating model for proactive programs and strategic customer engagements.</li> <li>Leadership has a reliable view of technical revenue pipeline, engagement health, account propensity, and investment ROI.</li> <li>Strategic customer initiatives and technical onsite visits move faster because goals, staffing, owners, success criteria, and follow-up are clear.</li> <li>Professional Services offerings are easier to understand, price, package, and align to Cloudflare's broader consumption-led strategy.</li> <li>New technical GTM motions move from ambiguous ideas to measurable programs with durable owners.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p><em><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</span></em></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of experience in GTM strategy, business operations, revenue operations, technical program management, solutions strategy, consulting, or a similar cross-functional execution role.</li> <li>Experience working with technical customer-facing teams such as Solutions Architects, Sales Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Professional Services, Customer Engineering, Developer Relations, or Product.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency, including the ability to understand customer architecture discussions, implementation tradeoffs, developer platform concepts, and the operating needs of technical GTM teams.</li> <li>Strong program management ability, including managing complex work streams, driving accountability without direct authority, and keeping teams aligned under pressure.</li> <li>Strong sense of ownership; someone who takes initiative, works independently, and manages time effectively.</li> <li>Excellent cross-functional communication skills and the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.</li> <li>Highly customer-centric, with natural curiosity about technical products and a strategic mindset for solving complex problems.</li> <li>Comfortable working under pressure and adjusting priorities to meet deadlines in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, including comfort using spreadsheets, CRM data, and business dashboards to prioritize work and inform decisions.</li> <li>Prior experience with Salesforce CRM, Tableau, BigQuery, or BoostUp is a plus.</li> <li>Background in SaaS or Product-Led Growth (PLG) is a strong plus.</li> <li> </li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $161,000 - title: Director, Global Design & Construction
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. This role demands a unique combination of high-level strategic vision, a passion for experimentation, creativity, and a relentless commitment to world-class physical execution.</p> <p>First and foremost, you are a builder of impactful, high-performance spaces. You will be responsible for leading the end-to-end design and construction of workspaces that serve as the tangible, physical manifestation of the local Cloudflare culture.</p> <p>At the same time, you are stepping into uncharted territory. To keep Cloudflare at the absolute forefront of our industry, we are up-leveling how we deliver projects by integrating an AI-first, data-driven approach. We are looking for a visionary leader who can think outside the box to identify and implement how AI can automate workflows, optimize budgets, and improve data-driven design decisions.</p> <p>While automation and AI are the engines of efficiency in this role, the <strong>human element</strong> is its heart. Map out and execute opportunities to eliminate manual bottlenecks across the entire project lifecycle - including vendor onboarding/benchmarking, contracting, cost estimation, budget/project tracking, and risk identification - by implementing automated review pipelines and data-driven quality controls.</li> <li><strong>Drive Spatial Experimentation:</strong> Treat our workplaces as living laboratories. Conceptualize and implement pioneering internal qualitative and quantitative data-collection methods - such as tracking real-time utilization patterns and capturing continuous employee feedback loops - to architect data-driven proposals that evolve our global footprints based on your findings.</li> <li><strong>Evolve the Design Framework:</strong> Use data insights and post-occupancy metrics to constantly challenge existing design assumptions. Lead formal change management efforts to iterate on our physical footprints and champion a generative design-supported “kit of parts” for global serviced offices, ensuring they fluidly adapt as work styles and distributed team needs change.</li> <li><strong>Predictive Capital & Site Strategy:</strong> Collaborate with Real Estate and FP&A teams to direct predictive modeling concepts for site selection, due diligence, project cash flows, long-term financial reporting, and financial risk mitigation, steering the department toward highly optimized capital allocation.</li> <li><strong>CapEx Budget Ownership & Financial Governance:</strong> Own and manage the global capital expenditure (CapEx) budget, delivering accurate multi-year financial forecasting, cost-variance reporting, and executive-level capital reporting.</li> <li><strong>Executive Cross-Functional Leadership:</strong> Serve as the strategic bridge and primary liaison between internal executive business customers and external delivery partners (including architects, GCs, and furniture dealers). Ensure Physical Security, IT, Legal, and Workplace leadership are deeply aligned under a unified, technology-supported project pipeline and data layer that prioritizes the employee experience.</li> <li><strong>Lifecycle Handover & Commissioning:</strong> Establish rigorous commissioning protocols to ensure flawless handovers from construction completion to local Workplace Operations  teams.</li> <li><strong>Global Pipeline Governance & Compliance:</strong> Oversee a global project pipeline across all international hubs and time zones, seamlessly balancing highly creative local refreshes with complex, large-scale 100,000+ square foot tenant improvement projects. Ensure all construction activities and global workflows are in strict compliance with local laws while maintaining a focus on sustainable, high-performance building standards.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Seniority:</strong> 10-12+ years of experience leading interior design and complex construction project management, specifically within high-growth technology companies or global enterprises.</li> <li><strong>Scale Mastery:</strong> A proven track record of successfully directing a global corporate office portfolio in excess of 250,000+ total square feet.</li> <li><strong>Curiosity & Growth Mindset:</strong> A profound curiosity for how technology can optimize human interaction. You must be comfortable with ambiguity and excited by the challenge of building unprecedented internal tools from scratch rather than managing legacy workflows.</li> <li><strong>Technical Integration:</strong> Knowledge of technical infrastructure (MEP systems, architectural principles, AV/IT) and a clear vision of how they connect with automated building systems.</li> <li><strong>Sophisticated Communication:</strong> Outstanding leadership and collaboration skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional executives and external partners across multiple time zones.</li> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field such as Architecture, Project Management, Interior Design, or Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Global Mobility & Presence:</strong> Willingness to work in-office ~3 days a week to lead by example within our local workplace laboratory, with the flexibility to travel globally to oversee high-stakes project transformations.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Certifications:</strong> LEED, WELL, or PMP Certifications.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Technical Skills:</strong> Experience with AI-enhanced workflows, generative design platforms, or transitioning legacy portfolios into AI-assisted operational models.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $223,000 - $307,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations:  Austin or Lisbon (Hybrid)</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare has embarked on a transformation of our entire quote to cash process. We’re looking for a seasoned product leader who will take charge of these processes, providing leadership, communication and accountability for successful delivery. You will: </p> <ul> <li>Take leadership. You will manage a small team of product managers ensuring coverage and accountability for the myriad projects across the organization. </li> <li>Work horizontally. Disparate groups like Engineering, Program Management, Finance, Revenue Operations, Business Intelligence and external vendors like Stripe and Salesforce all need to keep plans aligned and work together to deliver commitments.</li> <li>Span timescales. Short term deliverables like supporting product launches, medium term ones like migrating billing progresses and longer term ones like a full ERP implementation all need to be serviced. The urgent cannot starve the important. </li> <li>Span domains. You need to simultaneously let other teams rely on the roadmaps you publish while being responsive to the interrupt-driven nature of the business. When shifts do occur, you need to proactively communicate with other teams to maintain trust. </li> <li>Commit to quality. Our #1 priority is to have an accurate picture of revenue and service of our customers but we also have numerous other concerns like speed of innovation and advancing the roadmap.</li> <li>Communicate and collaborate. Essential to the success of this program is the ability to listen, learn, synthesize and communicate outwards as well as influence through persuasion.</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare. Many of our largest customers want to speak to us about their concerns and our plans in the billing domain. You will spend time learning from them. </li> <li>Provide and demand accountability. You are responsible for the delivery of your commitments and you will hold your peers and subordinates accountable for theirs. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Some of the domains you will touch include</strong>: Billing, Invoicing, Sales & Opportunity management, Credit & Collections, Pricing & Quoting, Contract & Entitlement Management, Partners & Resellers, Taxation, Bad debt, BI Reporting, ERP Implementation. </p> <p><strong>Success Factors</strong></p> <p>100% essential to taking on this role will be a history of success delivering projects within the financial domain. A history of product management in billing, fintech, financial reporting, compliance or other similar domain in companies with scope similar to or larger than Cloudflare is required. We will also only consider candidates who have successfully managed teams of other product managers in one of these domains. </p> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Internet native companies tend to think a little differently than the Fortune 500. We’d love to meet folks with a history of delivering with the cadence and timescales of those born on the Internet. </li> <li>Engineering fluency - while it’s not required, we tend to find success with candidates who have a technical background, formal or otherwise. You don’t need a CS degree but building credibility with our engineering teams is critical and so some history of technical acumen would be super helpful</li> <li>Finance fluency - You’re dealing with data that represents money and that implies a certain level of care. title: Director, Strategic Finance & Investor Relations
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. This role reports to the VP of Strategic Finance, Treasury, Deal Desk, & Investor Relations and is the engine room of how Cloudflare tells its financial story to the public markets — translating one of the most differentiated technology platforms in the world into a clear, credible, and compelling investment narrative.</p> <p>You will own the end-to-end quarterly earnings cycle, drive our long-term financial model and consensus discipline, partner directly with the CFO and senior leadership on guidance, and lead the analytical and communications work behind every major investor and analyst touchpoint — quarterly calls, conferences, our annual Investor Day, and ad-hoc executive projects. We move fast, we ship work that goes directly to the CEO, CFO, Board, and public markets, and we hold ourselves to an exceptionally high bar on accuracy — and we are AI-native in how we work, treating modern tooling as a force multiplier on insight, productivity, and rigor.</p> <h4><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h4> <p>As the Director, Strategic Finance & Investor Relations, you will be the operational and analytical lead for Cloudflare's engagement with the public markets. build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with our covering analysts and shareholders.</li> <li>Articulate the Cloudflare investment narrative — our connectivity cloud strategy, the Workers and Developer Platform story, and our long-term financial model — in a way that is both compelling and credible.</li> <li>Plan and execute the calendar of investor events: sell-side conferences, one-on-ones, on-site investor visits, and our annual Investor Day.</li> <li>Prepare the CEO, CFO, and other senior executives for every investor interaction with tailored briefing materials, talking points, and Q&A prep.</li> <li>Develop and maintain core IR collateral: investor presentation, fact sheets, IR website content, and board-of-directors investor update materials.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Investor Day and special projects</strong></p> <ul> <li>Co-lead the planning and execution of our annual Investor Day — invite tracker and registration management, co-author all presentation content and prepared remarks across all presenters, own the supporting documentation, validation, day-of logistics, and post-event follow-through.</li> <li>Lead select strategic finance projects: peer benchmarking analyses, long-range financial modeling, competitive analyses, and ad-hoc executive-level financial analyses.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional partnership and analytics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be a trusted partner to Finance, Accounting, Legal, Communications, FP&A, and the executive team — the person who knows where every number comes from and what it means.</li> <li>Monitor and synthesize analyst coverage, peer performance, investor sentiment, market dynamics, and industry trends; provide actionable insights to the CFO, CEO, and Board of Directors.</li> <li>Build and maintain the internal analytical infrastructure that powers the function — the models, dashboards, trackers, and validation systems that let a small team operate at scale.</li> <li>Drive the IR function's use of AI-native tooling and automation, treating modern tools as a force multiplier on insight, productivity, accuracy, and stakeholder communications.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></h4> <p>To succeed in this role, you should be a strategic thinker with deep financial acumen, exceptional written and verbal communication skills, an ownership mindset, and a genuine intellectual curiosity about both the business and the public markets. Specifically:</p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li><strong>10+ years of experience</strong> combining investor relations, equity research, investment banking, FP&A, corporate finance, or equity investing — ideally with meaningful time in-house at a high-growth public technology company.</li> <li><strong>Deep technical fluency </strong>with public-company reporting, financial statements, capital markets, valuation methodologies, and SaaS / consumption-based revenue models. Comfort debating modeling assumptions and valuation mechanics.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills</strong> — including the ability to draft in the voice of senior executives, translate complex technical or financial concepts into clear narratives for non-technical audiences, and operate confidently in high-stakes external communications.</li> <li><strong>Advanced financial modeling skills </strong>— fluency in building, maintaining, and stress-testing operating models, share-count and dilution forecasts, guidance sensitivity analyses, and consensus benchmarks.</li> <li><strong>An ownership mindset</strong> — comfort owning a process end-to-end, driving operational structure in a fast-paced environment, and operating with the integrity and accuracy demanded by external disclosure.</li> <li><strong>High-trust collaboration</strong> — the ability to build credibility quickly with senior internal stakeholders (CFO, CEO, Board, Legal, Accounting, FP&A) and external stakeholders (sell-side analysts, institutional investors).</li> <li><strong>AI-native curiosity and skill </strong>— fluency with modern AI tooling and a track record of using it to amplify your impact. We are building an AI-forward organization and the right candidate sees AI as a partner, not a threat.</li> <li><strong>Sound judgment with confidential information</strong> — a clear understanding of materiality, fair disclosure, Reg FD, and the discretion required when working with pre-announcement financial data.</li> <li><strong>Sector background</strong> in cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, or AI preferred — existing relationships with top-tier infrastructure / software sell-side analysts and institutional investors a plus.</li> <li><strong>Bachelor's degree</strong> in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or a related field; MBA, CFA, or CPA preferred.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $200,000 - $275,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York City based hired: Estimated annual salary of $190,000 - $262,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete pac

We build and maintain the C++ and Rust codebase that embeds the JavaScript engine, manages isolate lifecycles, enforces resource limits (CPU, memory, I/O), and orchestrates how customer scripts are loaded, cached, and executed. We operate in a hostile multi-tenant environment where security must be foundational — from side-channel attack mitigations to isolate sandboxing — and performance is measured in microseconds.</p> develop strong systems engineers; set clear expectations, provide technical mentorship, and create an environment where people do their best work.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge & programming, process models, and networking.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Experience building high-performance distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience working with cloud platforms, real-time environments such as game streaming, game engine architecture, high-frequency trading, or payment systems.</li> <li>Experience debugging, optimizing, and identifying failure modes in a Several of us maintain or regularly contribute to the Linux kernel, and our default is to fix problems in mainline rather than carry private patches. This role is built on that principle.</p> <p><strong>The problem you would own</strong></p> <p>Using memory efficiently is one of the highest-leverage problems we have. At our scale, how the kernel's memory-management subsystem behaves under pressure has direct consequences for both performance and cost. As DRAM prices climb, getting more out of the memory we already own is a real lever on infrastructure spend.</p> <p>Using custom low-overhead instrumentation on production servers, we have identified several scalability bottlenecks in the kernel memory layer that show up under real workloads. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>This

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p> </p> <h3>Job Location: Paris</h3> <p><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </p> <p> </p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, Texas</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Created in January 2025, our centralized Developer Go-to-Market (GTM) organization functions as a "speedboat" to maintain focus, control direction, and iterate quickly. Our mission is to build long-term relationships with developers by addressing their unique needs and challenges with specialized attention and resources.</p> <p>Our team operates across four core pillars: Marketing, Developer Relations, Growth Programs, and Sales. These functions work in close collaboration to support customers throughout their journey, from raising awareness and inspiring new use cases to driving platform adoption, consumption, and scaling customer relationships. Each function amplifies the impact of the others through strategic partnerships and shared insights.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <p>You'll own the GTM-facing software and data products our sales motion runs on, end to end. That includes the data foundation underneath it and the signals that flag which accounts a rep should act on and when. You'll also lead our hardest cross-functional projects, the ones that span many teams and systems. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations: Washington, D.C.</h3> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <p>As a Principal Public Sector Architect you understand your customer’s scope and mission. You have a deep understanding of key drivers for the technology decisions in large government and education and how those drivers support their goals. You are familiar with key regulatory guidelines and constraints and the unique nature of those factors on technology modernization.</p> <p>You can credibly engage across various technical domains. You have the capability to converse on risk management and have the ability to articulate the impact of risk to the organization in terms the government understands. You have an understanding of the factors and trends that are top of mind in government for CIOs, CISOs and other agency executives are thinking about to increase government services’ effectiveness, security and end user experience.</p> <p>You will help our customers build digital transformation strategies using the Cloudflare technologies and platform.. You are aware of what comes next and you can position the value proposition of the Cloudflare platform in tangible benefits to the government mission, without necessarily referring to specific individual technologies.</p> <p>Your aim is to understand our customers' journey, helping them identify, understand, and scope their needs as they replace or migrate from existing edge cloud and/or on-premises technologies. You will help them comprehend the value proposition of Cloudflare technology in relation to their transformation or other mandates, and you will guide them in building a roadmap towards their next-generation secure digital architecture using our platform. </p> <p>In this role, you will work as a part of a highly visible structured team to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders within our strategic customers. You will have a track record of public engagement and experience working internally to build the business case for solution development and enhancements. An equally important component of this role is the expectation that you scale your industry expertise and knowledge across the wider Pre-Sales organization.</p> <p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Responsible for working with customers to define tailored visions, creating a path for innovation stretching multiple years out. Develop a roadmap with customer and internal Cloudflare stakeholders and together push the boundaries on how Cloudflare can help large government and education move forward. This includes identifying, understanding, scoping, and guiding the journey to replace or migrate from existing edge cloud and/or on-premises technologies.</li> <li>Build and maintain the long term technical relationship of strategic accounts, ensuring the successful design, proof and adoption of Cloudflare as a part of the customers critical infrastructure.</li> <li>Identify and drive strategic conversations with key stakeholders with the purpose of increasing our reputation and authority within the marketplace, and further establishing our footprint within the customer’s landscape.</li> <li>Collaborate with specialists, architects, and subject matter experts across diverse functions. Apply extensive vertical knowledge and domain expertise to enhance the depth and effectiveness of engagement.</li> <li>Available for consultation throughout a strategic engagement's lifecycle, from account planning and initial vision setting to guiding stakeholders through Solution Design.</li> <li>Support for Business Value Assessment creation and delivery.</li> <li>Contribute industry events, and collaborate with your teammates.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills, knowledge and experiences:</strong></p> <ul> <li>15+ years of prior Technical Sales, Engineering, and/or first-hand
