description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). VOTRE RÔLE Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. Vous imaginez de nouveaux langages graphiques, développez des concepts créatifs avec le Brand Concepts Director et accompagnez leur déploiement sur l'ensemble des points de contact. VOS MISSIONS Participer au développement des concepts créatifs des projets spéciaux, collaborations et initiatives de Brand Expansion. Participer au développement des identités visuelles des campagnes, collections, défilés et projets spéciaux, de leur conception à leur déclinaison. Développer les systèmes graphiques, lettrages, traitements typographiques et directions artistiques associés. Réaliser des recherches créatives, iconographiques et graphiques pour alimenter les réflexions du Studio Image. Concevoir les propositions graphiques des campagnes de communication et des grands temps forts de la Maison. Concevoir les supports de communication liés aux défilés (invitations, moodboards, présentations, dossiers de presse…). Développer les principes d'identité visuelle destinés au Retail Design, aux expériences de marque et aux activations. Participer au développement de nouveaux formats digitaux, motion et contenus innovants. Encadrer la déclinaison graphique des identités sur les différents supports. Assurer la cohérence créative de l'ensemble des livrables en collaboration avec les équipes Image, Retail, Digital et Communication. VOTRE PROFIL Excellente culture graphique et artistique. Très forte maîtrise de l'identité visuelle, de la typographie et des systèmes graphiques. Capacité à développer des concepts créatifs. Excellente maîtrise de Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects et Premiere. Aisance avec Keynote et PowerPoint. Très bonne maîtrise du motion design. Intérêt voire maîtrise d’outils IA appliquée à la création. Capacité à travailler de manière transversale avec plusieurs équipes. Le poste est situé rue de Lisbonne dans le 8è arrondissement de Paris. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description: Diabolocom is the leading European sovereign cloud contact center (CCaaS) and customer experience management (CX) platform. It helps organizations transform customer experience by augmenting agents' capabilities through AI-human collaboration, automating routine customer interactions, and delivering personalized experiences at scale. Built on proprietary AI, private cloud, and native telecom infrastructure, the platform automates workflows, improves data quality, and empowers customer service and sales teams across every channel. Backed by more than two decades of experience and twice recognized by Frost & Sullivan for AI technology innovation and customer experience technology leadership, Diabolocom is trusted by more than 400 organizations—including BPCE, Carrefour, Nikon, and Mitsubishi—to power mission-critical customer operations in over 60 countries, helping organizations strengthen customer loyalty and accelerate growth. About the role To support our growth, we are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to join our HR team in Paris. You will manage recruitment processes end-to-end, from understanding the hiring need and identifying the right sourcing strategy to interviewing candidates, managing the selection process and closing the hire. A significant part of your activity will involve recruiting technical and highly specialized profiles, including Software Engineers, AI and Research profiles, Infrastructure experts, senior technical specialists and, depending on business needs, leadership and C-level positions. You will work with a wide variety of stakeholders across the company: experienced hiring managers, technical experts, senior leaders and managers who may need more guidance throughout the recruitment process. Being able to adapt your approach, challenge when necessary and keep recruitment processes moving will therefore be an important part of your role. You will join a collaborative Talent Acquisition team composed of a Talent Acquisition Team Lead, another Talent Acquisition Manager and an HR team member combining recruitment with broader HR projects, within the HR department. We are looking for someone who is already comfortable managing recruitment independently, while remaining curious and eager to learn, develop their expertise and adopt our recruitment practices. What you will do Manage recruitment processes from A to Z , from the initial briefing with the hiring manager through sourcing, interviews, coordination of the selection process, offer management and contract signature. Partner with hiring managers to understand their needs, challenge requirements when relevant and translate them into an effective recruitment and sourcing strategy. Recruit across a variety of roles, with a strong focus on technical and complex profiles , including senior Software Engineers, AI/Research profiles, Infrastructure specialists, technical leadership and other hard-to-find profiles. Take ownership of direct sourcing and headhunting , identifying and engaging passive candidates rather than relying primarily on inbound applications. Build relevant talent pools and continuously explore new sourcing channels, tools and approaches. Conduct structured interviews to assess candidates' experience, skills, motivations and potential fit with the role and environment. Provide hiring managers with clear, fact-based candidate assessments and recommendations throughout the selection process. Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment journey and contribute to a professional, transparent and engaging candidate experience. Adapt your way of working to different stakeholders, from very experienced senior leaders to managers who require more support in structuring their recruitment process. Keep our ATS and recruitment data accurate and up to date and contribute to the monitoring of key recruitment indicators. Share market insights with the team and hiring managers, including candidate availability, compensation expectations, competitive dynamics and sourcing challenges. Contribute to continuous improvement projects within Talent Acquisition, such as sourcing practices, interview methodologies, candidate experience, automation, documentation and recruitment processes. Work closely with the rest of the Talent Acquisition and HR team, sharing knowledge, candidates, sourcing techniques and best practices. What we are looking for You already have a first solid experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally around 3 to 5 years, either in-house or in a recruitment agency/search environment. You are able to manage a recruitment process independently from initial briefing to hire, while knowing when to ask for input or collaborate with the team. You have already recruited technical and/or particularly complex profiles. Previous exposure to Software Engineering, AI/Data, Infrastructure, Research or senior technical positions would be particularly relevant. You are comfortable working on senior and hard-to-find profiles and understand that some searches require persistence, creativity and a highly targeted approach. Direct sourcing is part of your recruiter DNA: you are comfortable approaching passive candidates and using tools and techniques such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean searches, talent mapping and other relevant sourcing channels. You are comfortable interacting with stakeholders at different levels of seniority, including senior leaders and C-level executives, and can adapt your communication and level of guidance accordingly. You know how to manage several recruitment processes simultaneously, prioritize effectively and maintain momentum even when working with busy stakeholders. You combine autonomy with a strong team mindset: you take ownership of your searches but naturally share information, help colleagues and contribute to collective recruitment goals. You are curious and eager to keep developing your recruitment expertise. You already have strong foundations, but you are still keen to learn new approaches, tools and practices. You have strong interpersonal and communication skills and care about building high-quality relationships with both candidates and hiring managers. Ability to build, manage and improve recruitment dashboards would be a strong plus for this role. You are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Spanish would be a strong plus, as would experience recruiting across several European or international markets. What's in it for you A structured onboarding program to discover our product, technology, teams and culture. The opportunity to work on challenging searches across Software Engineering, AI, Infrastructure, Product, business and leadership roles. Exposure to an international environment and stakeholders across multiple countries. A Talent Acquisition team where you can operate autonomously while continuing to learn and develop your expertise. The opportunity to contribute to the evolution of our recruitment practices and have a visible impact on how we attract and hire talent. An office in the heart of Paris, close to Opéra Garnier. A hybrid working model, with up to 2 days of remote work per week. Lunch vouchers (€11/day via Swile). High-quality IT equipment. Regular company and team events Salary range for the role An annual gross package (fix +performance based bonus) ranging from 50 000 euros to 55 000 euros. Interested in joining us? Let’s talk. As part of our hiring process, please note that any employment offer will be subject to a background check, including verification of your identity, educational credentials, and previous employment history. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:  </strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Reliability Engineer with focus on Identity and Access Management (IAM) to join the Corporate Engineering team. As an SRE together with other engineers you will be responsible for the continuous operation, further development and enhancement of Planet’s corporate infrastructure and applications, acting as the technical authority for our enterprise identity ecosystem. </p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help to ensure the operation of Planet’s internal IT systems, specifically architecting and maintaining our identity providers (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak).</li> <li>Improve existing and create new solutions by engineering automated zero-day Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) workflows directly from our HRIS (e.g., HiBob).</li> <li>Scripting & Tooling: Use Python or Go to automate repetitive tasks, build custom provisioning connectors for legacy applications, and enforce identity data minimization.</li> <li>Identify and reduce operational toil through automation, making our systems self-healing and predictable.</li> <li>Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Leverage APIs, Terraform, Ansible, or SaltStack to manage configurations as code, moving away from manual UI/CLI changes across our identity platforms.</li> <li>Participate in an on-call rotation and drive the continuous improvement of incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-mortem processes for complex authentication failures.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Security and other IT teams to embed reliability, scalability, and security best practices from the ground up, ensuring our identity architecture complies with GDPR and Zero Trust principles.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years experience in infrastructure development and/or operations, with a dedicated focus on Identity and Access Management.</li> <li data-path-to-node="2,1,0">Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.</li> <li data-path-to-node="2,1,0">Expertise with a scripting language like Python.</li> <li>Track record of working with large web applications or computer clusters and managing complex identity architectures (Okta, Auth0, Keycloak).</li> <li>Experience integrating HR Information Systems with identity directories and handling complex edge cases (re-hires, cross-border transfers).</li> <li>Solid understanding of Network principles and operations alongside modern identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM).</li> <li>Practical understanding of PKI, certificate lifecycles (S/MIME, X.509), and managing legacy directories like Active Directory.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operational experience in deploying and maintaining databases.</li> <li>Experience using Docker, ECS or Linux Containers in a production environment.</li> <li>Awareness of best practices about systems security and defensive programming</li> <li>Experience with version control e.g. Git.</li> <li>Experience in deploying and maintaining virtual machines e.g. KVM, ProxMox.</li> <li>Experience in software development using CI/CD processes and tools e.g. Jenkins, GitLab.</li> <li>Experience with Access Control systems, e. g. Avigilon, Verkada or dormakaba.</li> <li>Experience with  Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and deployment automation, renewal, and revocation of personal S/MIME certificates.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.</p> <p><strong>Export Control Requirements:</strong></p> <p><em>Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. title: Senior Solutions Architect | Netherlands | Remote
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><div> <div> <div> <p data-start="239" data-end="573"><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p data-start="239" data-end="573">We’re looking for a <strong>Senior </strong><strong data-start="259" data-end="306">Solutions Architect (Professional Services)</strong> to join Grafana Labs’ world-class Customer Experience team. This is a highly hands-on role for technically skilled professionals who thrive on helping customers solve complex problems, accelerate adoption, and drive real business outcomes with Grafana at the center.</p> <p data-start="575" data-end="930">As a Solutions Architect, you’ll be a <strong data-start="613" data-end="642">trusted technical partner</strong>—not a quota-carrying seller, but a customer-first advocate who leads with authenticity and insight. You’ll guide organizations through onboarding, implementation, and expansion by offering white-glove support, best practices, and proven strategies gathered from across our customer base.</p> <p data-start="932" data-end="1337">You’ll operate with one foot in the code and the other in the customer’s world. Whether it’s understanding container orchestration in Kubernetes, fine-tuning Prometheus queries, or clarifying the nuances between logs, metrics, and traces—you’ll bring clarity and confidence to complex technical landscapes. You know the difference between "pets and cattle" and why that matters for scalable observability.</p> <p data-start="1339" data-end="1823">You’ll deliver high-impact training, jumpstart engagements, and offer tailored technical consulting to help customers succeed. As an embedded partner during critical phases, you’ll provide roadmap assurance, guide project execution, and ensure Grafana's capabilities align with the customer’s architecture, goals, and constraints. Along the way, you’ll identify recurring issues, monitor support needs, and advocate for product improvements in close collaboration with internal teams.</p> <p data-start="1825" data-end="2086">Success in this role means being a strategic thinker <strong data-start="1878" data-end="1885">and</strong> a command-line problem solver. You’re passionate about OSS, love engaging with customers, and have the instincts to manage timelines, unblock teams, and deliver value at every stage of the engagement.</p> <p data-start="2088" data-end="2206">Join us and help elevate the Grafana customer experience through world-class technical delivery and meaningful impact.</p> <p data-start="2088" data-end="2206"><strong>What You'll Be Doing:</strong></p> </div> </div> <div> <ul> <li>Effective in working with customers, including business executives, project managers, and IT development staff.</li> <li>Effective in understanding business needs and distilling the information into business and technical requirements.</li> <li>Comfortable working with complex business and technological requirements and translating into the design of solutions, including data visualization, workflow recommendations, migrations, and enterprise scale architecture.</li> <li>Ability to act as a functional lead and able to demonstrate clear approach to methodology as well as functional capabilities. Leads functional workshops with customers, documents requirements, and designs appropriate solutions.</li> <li>Speed is paramount. This team is nimble and is the fulcrum to accelerate the delivery of the solution for customers.</li> <li>Be a strong advocate for adherence to standards and best practices.</li> <li>Stay current on Grafana Labs, observability, and related technologies.</li> <li>You'll be a key resource for our Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Support, and Professional Services teams as they look to drive innovation and improvements into future product and offering enhancements.</li> <li>If you enjoy working with customers to help them succeed and thrive on working with leading-edge technologies, this is the role for you.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Located in the Netherlands </li> <li>5+ years of experience working on deployment teams, using project management techniques.</li> <li>Direct experience with o11y.</li> <li>Best practices for both using and deploying an o11y stack (visualization, alerting, metrics, logs, traces) - preferably with Grafana products (Grafana, Prometheus/Cortex/Enterprise Metrics, Loki/Enterprise Logs, Jaeger/Tempo).</li> <li>A proven track record of successful delivery of customer projects, preferably enterprise o11y implementations for large customers</li> <li>Excellent communication skills to communicate with customers, partners, and internal members.</li> <li>Kubernetes (kubectl, Helm, Tanka preferred).</li> <li>Experience with Cloud Platforms - AWS, GCP, Azure</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Self-starter, adept at picking up new skills and technologies, and eager to break new ground.</li> <li>Vision to help us take our company to the next level.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation & Rewards:</strong></p> </div> </div> <div> <p>In the Netherlands<strong>,</strong> the base compensation range for this role is 109,697 - 131,636 EUR. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.</p> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. title: Founding Customer Value Manager (m/w/d)
description: Intro Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder , weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind. Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche . Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden . Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern. Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen. 75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut. Lasst uns sie von Anfang an richtig bauen. Tasks Customer Experience ist bei uns kein Support-Ticket-Job. Du besitzt den kompletten Kundenlebenszyklus nach dem Vertragsabschluss — kommerziell, operativ und im Produkt . Damit sitzt du an der Stelle im Unternehmen, an der beide Seiten gleichzeitig sichtbar sind : Du weißt, was Kunden wirklich brauchen und wofür sie zahlen — und du weißt, was das Produkt kann und was es kosten würde, es zu können. Genau daraus entstehen die besten Produktentscheidungen und die besten Deals. Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und baust den Bereich so, wie er in zwei Jahren für dreißig Leute funktionieren muss. 💰 Revenue Ownership Du besitzt einen Kundenstamm mit klarer Umsatzverantwortung: Retention, Expansion, Renewals. Du erkennst, wo ein Kunde mehr Wert ziehen könnte, und machst den Upsell selbst – weitere Nutzer, weitere Projekte, weitere Produkte. Du verhandelst Verlängerungen und Erweiterungen und führst sie bis zur Unterschrift. 🚀 Value Creation über den gesamten Kundenlebenszyklus Du übernimmst den Kunden ab dem ersten Onboarding-Kontakt : Setup, Projektdaten, Konfiguration, Schulung der Teams. Du führst den Rollout vom Pilotprojekt in die Fläche – und sorgst dafür, dass die Nutzung nicht nach vier Wochen einschläft. Du machst Value Reviews mit messbaren Zahlen statt Höflichkeitsterminen und machst sichtbar, was alago dem Kunden konkret gebracht hat. 🛟 Customer Support Du verantwortest unseren Support: Anfragen beantworten, priorisieren, Muster erkennen. Du debuggst Customer Flows in der Software selbst – du reichst ein Problem nicht weiter, du reproduzierst es, grenzt es ein und beschreibst es so, dass es lösbar ist. Du baust Doku, Self-Service und KI-gestützte Antworten so auf, dass dieselbe Frage nicht zehnmal auf deinem Tisch landet. ⚙️ Product Engine – du baust mit Du löst selbst, was sich ohne Engineering lösen lässt : Konfiguration, Datenbereinigung, kleine Automatisierungen und Skripte – mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder n8n. Was Code im Kernprodukt braucht, übergibst du so präzise an unser Engineering-Team, dass es schnell gelöst ist. Du verantwortest Integrationen und Datenimporte : Du scopst die Anbindung an Kundensysteme, prüfst, was machbar ist, und bringst Migrationen gemeinsam mit unserem Engineering-Team ins Ziel – damit ein Onboarding Stunden statt Tage dauert. Du übersetzt, was Nutzer, Projektleitungen, IT und QM wirklich brauchen, in klare, priorisierte Produkt-Inputs – mit Belegen, nicht mit Bauchgefühl. Was du selbst lösen kannst, löst du selbst. Du testest neue Releases aus Kundensicht, bevor sie live gehen, und bist die Stimme des Kunden im Produktprozess. 🏗️ Den Bereich aufbauen Du schreibst die Playbooks für Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell – und automatisierst sie, wo immer es geht. Du entwickelst und betreibst die KI-Agents und Automatisierungen , die Customer Experience bei uns skalierbar machen, statt den Bereich mit Köpfen zu vergrößern. Requirements Muss-Kriterien Du hattest bereits direkten Kundenkontakt in einer verantwortlichen Rolle – du hast Kunden selbst geführt, nicht nur zugearbeitet Du hast Umsatzverantwortung getragen oder Umsatz ausgebaut (Renewals, Upsells, Expansion, Abschlüsse) und kannst das mit Zahlen belegen Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau und sicheres Englisch Standort München oder Bereitschaft, dauerhaft von hier aus zu arbeiten Wie du arbeitest AI-native: Du nutzt KI nicht gelegentlich, sondern reflexhaft. Du hast dir selbst Agents, Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (n8n, Claude Code, Lovable o. Ä.), probierst neue Modelle aus, sobald sie rauskommen, und hast eine fundierte Meinung dazu, was taugt. Systems Thinker: Du siehst nicht den einzelnen Kunden, sondern das System dahinter. Statt zehnmal dasselbe manuell zu lösen, baust du beim zweiten Mal den Prozess, der es überflüssig macht – und dokumentierst ihn so, dass ihn die nächste Person versteht. Technische Tiefe: Du gehst ins Produkt hinein: Daten prüfen, Flows nachvollziehen, Logs lesen, ein Problem sauber eingrenzen – und wo es geht, mit KI-Tools selbst beheben , sonst so beschreiben, dass es lösbar ist. Du fühlst dich in einer Software wohl, nicht nur in einer Präsentation darüber. Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss. Was du übernimmst, landet nicht im Nirgendwo. Kommerzieller Instinkt: Du erkennst den Moment, in dem aus einem zufriedenen Kunden ein größerer Kunde wird – und sprichst ihn an, statt zu warten. Persönlicher Hintergrund DISC-Profil: Du bist extrovertiert und findest eine gute Balance zwischen People- und Task-Fokus Persönliche Eigenschaften: Du bist leidenschaftlich, neugierig, wettbewerbsorientiert und lernbereit / gut coachbar Du bist deiner Leidenschaft gefolgt und hast dir in einem kompetitiven Umfeld (z. B. Projekte, Sport, Musik, Kunst o. Ä.) messbare Erfolge erarbeitet Idealerweise bist du über eine persönliche Empfehlung aus unserem AAA-Netzwerk (Founders, Team, Partner, VCs etc.) auf uns aufmerksam geworden Pluspunkte Du hast selbst schon aktiv entwickelt – eigene Projekte, Skripte, Integrationen, ein Side Project, das tatsächlich läuft Du hast schon mit Claude Code (oder vergleichbaren Coding-Agents) echte Sachen gebaut und weißt, wie weit man damit ohne Engineering-Team kommt Du kennst Teile unseres Stacks ( TypeScript, React, Supabase ) schon aus eigenen Projekten Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr Du hast bereits in einem schnell wachsenden Early-Stage-Startup gearbeitet und weißt, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn es noch kein Playbook gibt Du hast schon einmal einen Bereich oder Prozess von null aufgebaut Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du gut zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve. Warum alago? Du bist die erste Person für Customer Experience bei alago. Es gibt keinen bestehenden Bereich, in den du dich einfügst – du entscheidest, wie er aussieht: welche Prozesse, welche Tools, welche Standards, welche Kennzahlen. Was du baust, bleibt. Du wirst einer der tragenden Pfeiler dieser Firma alago wird von sechs, sieben Bereichen getragen. Customer Experience ist einer davon – und du besitzt ihn. Du sitzt bei den Entscheidungen am Tisch, die die Firma prägen, nicht nur bei denen über deine Kunden. Der Weg von hier führt zum Head of Customer Experience mit eigenem Team. Du entwickelst dich in eines der gefragtesten Profile überhaupt Die stärksten KI-Unternehmen der Welt suchen gerade händeringend Leute, die Kunde und Produkt gleichzeitig beherrschen — bei Palantir heißt dieses Profil Forward Deployed Engineer , und es ist deshalb so wertvoll, weil es so selten ist. Bei uns wächst du genau in diese Richtung: Du lernst an echten Kunden, wie man Vertrauen aufbaut und schwierige Gespräche führt , und wie man einen Kunden über Monate zu messbarem Wert begleitet , statt ihn nach dem Onboarding sich selbst zu überlassen. Dazu kommt die technische Seite: Du arbeitest so nah am Produkt, dass du selbst Hand anlegen kannst — je tiefer du da einsteigst, desto größer wird dein Hebel. Du hast ab Tag eins Zugriff auf unsere Codebasis, pairst mit unserem Engineering-Team und bekommst echte Code-Reviews – dein technisches Level wächst messbar mit, nicht nebenbei. Wer beides kann, hat danach jede Tür offen. Du baust deine eigene Marke – und vervielfachst deinen Marktwert Du schärfst deine Persönlichkeit und deine Prinzipien kontinuierlich weiter. Du steigerst deine Glaubwürdigkeit: Du begleitest unser Wachstum von 11 auf 30 Mitarbeitende in zwei Jahren , du knackst den Code, wie man Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell vorhersehbar und wiederholbar macht, und du baust dir dein eigenes Playbook – eines, das du überallhin mitnimmst. Du beschleunigst deine persönliche & berufliche Entwicklung Egal ob du hier die Fähigkeiten für die eigene Gründung sammeln oder Richtung Head of Customer Experience wachsen willst: Durch halbjährliche Performance-Reviews kannst du mit konkreten Entwicklungsschritten alle ~9 Monate rechnen. Zugang zu erfahrenen Coaches, Trainern und Mentor:innen. Wöchentliche Trainings- und Coaching-Sessions. Eine umfangreiche Bibliothek, aus der du dir von den glaubwürdigsten Menschen der Welt etwas abschauen kannst. Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern – Du bist Tag für Tag Seite an Seite mit Janick (Go-to-Market & Strategy) und Ann-Christin (Product & Domain) . Bewerbungsprozess Bewerbung – Lebenslauf plus ein kurzes Beispiel, in dem du Verantwortung übernommen und Wirkung erzielt hast Erstgespräch (45 Minuten) Deep-Dive mit einem Founder (50 Minuten) Case Study (halber Tag vor Ort in München) – z. B. ein hängendes Rollout retten, einen Upsell-Case rechnen oder einen Customer Flow im Produkt debuggen Entscheidung – Rückmeldung innerhalb von 24 Stunden . Wenn es für beide Seiten passt – freuen wir uns sehr auf die Zusammenarbeit! 🎉 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

As an Account Manager , you’ll be at the heart of this ecosystem by partnering with developers, shaping game success through data and strategy, and helping define what great web gaming looks like. If you enjoy working at the point where creativity, data, and commercial impact come together, this role is for you. What this job is about: As an Account Manager, you are the trusted partner for a portfolio of high-potential game developers within our ecosystem. Your mission is to help them become more successful on the Poki platform by building strong relationships and using data and platform knowledge to guide decisions and priorities. You’ll assess game performance, define partnership roadmaps, and act as the bridge between developers and our internal teams such as product, data, developer support, and marketing. Your work directly impacts the growth of games, studios, and the platform as a whole. Your challenge as an Account Manager: In your first year, you’ll focus on three core challenges: Growing your portfolio: Help developers improve performance, launch new games, and identify opportunities for long-term growth Managing complexity at scale: Balance priorities, expectations, and workflows across many different accounts, each with their own needs and challenges Understanding how the Poki ecosytem works: Learn how our platform, data, products, and partners fit together, and how to leverage them for developer success You’ll work with a wide variety of developers (from small indie teams to large hit studios) and your work will have visible & measurable impact. At the same time, you’ll need to navigate shifting priorities, unpredictable game development cycles, and occasionally challenge the developers to drive the right outcomes. Your day-to-day will include developer check-ins, analyzing game performance, coordinating with internal teams, and jumping in when an account needs extra attention or direction. You: 5+ years of experience in account management or partnerships (medior+ level), with a proven track record of managing complex stakeholders and high-potential relationships Solid knowledge of games or digital products, allowing you to advise developers on design choices, updates, and strategy Strong analytical skills, with the ability to ground conversations and decisions in data Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to connect with creative teams and speak their language A strong sense of ownership and proactivity, anticipating challenges and driving decisions across internal teams Bonus experience: Experience working with game studios, publishers, or developer communities. Familiarity with web games, free-to-play models, or ad-based monetization. Experience collaborating with international partners or cross-cultural teams. Why work at Poki? We believe great work comes from feeling supported, trusted, and able to grow. Alongside meaningful professional development in the position mentioned above, we offer: A competitive salary, with annual performance reviews. Flexible working hours and a culture that genuinely supports a healthy work–life balance. €2,000 annual Learning & Development Budget for courses, training, and learning. Travel cost reimbursement for employees living outside of Amsterdam. 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus additional discretionary days. Hybrid work policy, with time split between home and our office, and the option to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. State-of-the-art equipment, plus a €2,000 work-from-home budget. Free breakfast, daily catered lunch, and unlimited coffee and drinks in our pet-friendly office at Spui, in the heart of Amsterdam! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: (Founding) Solutions Engineer
description: At Duna, we see the company as the second product we're building and are continually working to create a transparent, ambitious culture. We want this to be the place where you do your best work. Our mission is to redefine identity for the global economy. We're backed by world-class investors including CapitalG and Index Ventures, as well as founders and executives from companies like Stripe, Adyen, Notion, Remote, Qonto, Framer, Anthropic, Mollie, OpenAI, and Goldman Sachs. Since your role with us will rarely fit a job description, we only wrote a crisp overview. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING IN THIS ROLE Be the technical partner to our Account Executives, from the first call to go-live Run integration workshops with customer engineering teams, before and after they sign Scope what a customer needs to get live, and find the simplest path to get there Demo Duna live and answer the hard questions on our API, webhooks and data model Be the first line between customers and our engineers, so our engineers can stay focused on the platform Bring what you hear from customers back to product and engineering, and help us improve our docs WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You've done this before, as a solutions engineer, solutions architect, integration engineer or in a similar customer-facing technical role You've written plenty of integrations yourself. You're pragmatic, API first, and know webhooks, auth and system mapping well You can hold a room of senior engineers: you set the agenda, keep people engaged and earn their trust You care as much about how the platform works as about whether the customer succeeds You're comfortable switching between several customers and workstreams in the same day You're happy to travel regularly to meet customers Fluent English. Other languages are a plus Bonus: experience in payments, identity verification, fraud, or other integration-heavy products like CRMs Our current stack includes Node.js + TypeScript, React, Event Sourcing, Express, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Kubernetes, and AWS. You don't need to know all of it, but you should be comfortable reading code and building a working integration against an API. A final note before you apply: please read through our website in detail. You'll find the fundamentals there: what we believe in, how we work, and why we're building this company. We're a remote-first, fast-moving team of builders looking for exceptional people who love to create, build, and ship. Beyond passion and grit, we highly value curiosity, authenticity and kindness. If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you! PS. We are looking to hire passionate people from a variety of backgrounds. So even if you don't check all the boxes, we welcome your application! title: Quality Officer
description: Bij Crisp willen we beter eten mogelijk maken voor meer mensen. Dat begint met eten waar je op kunt vertrouwen: veilig, hygiënisch en elke keer net zo goed als we beloven. Daarom zorg jij ervoor dat kwaliteit, hygiëne en voedselveiligheid op de productievloer elke dag kloppen. Je bent onze ogen en oren op de vloer. Het fundament staat als een huis: HACCP, kwaliteit en specificatiebeheer zijn op orde. Jij zorgt dat de praktijk daar dagelijks bij aansluit en je stuurt bij waar het nodig is. Je bent veel op de productievloer te vinden voor controles en om processen te verifiëren. Af en toe zit je in ons eigen lab voor experimenten en testen. Wat deze rol zo leuk maakt? Je hebt direct invloed op ons product en je zit er altijd dichtbij. Schuurt het ergens op kwaliteit, dan ben jij het aanspreekpunt voor de productie. Klachten pak je grondig op en je zoekt praktische oplossingen. Wat je gaat doen Je loopt dagelijks kwaliteits- en hygiënerondes op de productievloer. Je controleert of collega’s de werkwijzen en kwaliteitsstandaarden naleven. Je neemt monsters en doet snelle producttesten en metingen, zoals pH en temperatuur. Ook controleer je inkomende grondstoffen en inkoopartikelen. Je voert gerichte controle- en testprogramma’s uit op smaak, microbiologie, chemie, fysieke eigenschappen en allergenen, bij processen, grondstoffen en eindproducten. Je coördineert en interpreteert laboratoriumonderzoeken (M/C/F/A) en voert houdbaarheidsstudies uit. Je coördineert en zet smaaktesten en proeverijen in. Je onderzoekt klachten van klanten over producten grondig. Je duikt de productie in, achterhaalt waar het misging en borgt de oplossing. Je let op de juiste toepassing van onze vaste productspecificaties en etiketteringseisen tijdens de productie. Je controleert, test en kalibreert meet- en weegapparatuur. Je spreekt productiemedewerkers aan, coacht ze en geeft korte, praktische trainingen en instructies, bijvoorbeeld over hygiëne en allergenen. Zo tillen we de voedselveiligheidscultuur elke dag naar een hoger niveau. Afhankelijk van je ambities en ervaring is er ruimte om mee te denken over productontwikkeling, bezoek je leveranciers om grondstoffen aan de bron te toetsen, help je bij inkoop en hygiënemanagement en ondersteun je bij kwaliteit in warehouse en logistiek. Dit ben jij Je bent praktisch en zichtbaar. Je zit niet graag hele dagen achter een bureau. Jij bent op je best op de productievloer. Je bent een goede communicator en coach. Je legt kwaliteitsregels helder uit en spreekt collega’s op een prettige, opbouwende manier aan als iemand zich er niet aan houdt. Je bent kritisch en nauwkeurig. Je let op details, kijkt scherp naar het proces en neemt geen genoegen met half werk. Je bent zelfredzaam en oplossingsgericht. Je pakt zaken zelf op, weet bij wie je moet zijn en komt je afspraken na. Je bent flexibel. Loopt je dag op de vloer anders door een kwaliteitsprobleem of een urgente klacht? Dan schakel je snel en pas je je prioriteiten aan. Je hebt minimaal MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau. Je hebt gedegen basiskennis van levensmiddelen (microbiologie, chemie en allergenen). Je weet hoe kruisbesmetting werkt en kunt labuitslagen interpreteren. Je kent de basis van HACCP, de hygiënecode, algemene warenwetgeving en GFSI-normen, zoals BRCGS, IFS of FSSC 22000. Pre: een opleiding in Levensmiddelentechnologie, Voedingskunde of een vergelijkbare richting. Wat wij bieden Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem. 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden. Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen. Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp. Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven. Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor. Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. RF/Microwave Design: Solve complex challenges related to insertion loss, impedance matching, and cross-talk at the PCB and package levels. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan de installatie van warmtepompen in 50 woningen binnen één wijk, waarbij meerdere installatieteams, bewoners en externe partners betrokken zijn. Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste: Ervaring met woningcorporaties, vastgoedbeheerders of andere zakelijke partijen in de vastgoedsector. Een fijne werkplek in Den Haag, met de mogelijkheid om ook op projectlocaties te werken. Laptop en telefoon van de zaak. Gezamenlijke lunch op kantoor. En krijg je energie van het organiseren, verbinden en oplossen van problemen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Je zoekt samen met het team uit hoe we het probleem structureel kunnen oplossen. Daar ligt voor jou veel ruimte om de rol verder uit te bouwen. Regelmatige teamactiviteiten, van borrels tot onze jaarlijkse winter trip. De mogelijkheid om mee te groeien met een bedrijf dat nog volop in ontwikkeling is. Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar we snel schakelen, elkaar helpen en niet wachten tot iemand anders een probleem oplost. Zie je iets dat beter kan? Dan horen we dat graag. En nog liever zien we dat je helpt om het ook daadwerkelijk beter te maken. Compensation: €3K – €4K per month • €3K – €4K per month Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Daarnaast bewaak je de voortgang en het resultaat. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de CEO. Cross-functionele verbeterprojecten die over meerdere teams heen lopen, leid je in principe zelf. Dat vraagt senioriteit. Je moet een Head kunnen challengen wanneer de customer experience niet goed genoeg is, maar net zo makkelijk zelf een review beantwoorden, een geautomatiseerde e-mail herschrijven of een (kleiner) verbeterproject van A tot Z uitvoeren. Wat ga je doen? Je beheert en verbetert onze bestaande customer journey en bijbehorende process maps en gebruikt deze om continu te identificeren waar de customer experience beter kan. Je ontwikkelt samen met de verschillende teams onze CX-standaarden voor de belangrijkste customer touchpoints, bewaakt deze en spreekt teams erop aan wanneer de ervaring daar niet aan voldoet. Je gebruikt reviews, klachten, customer feedback en operationele data om structurele problemen en verbeterkansen te identificeren en te prioriteren. Je vertaalt deze inzichten naar een duidelijke, geprioriteerde CX-improvement roadmap. Je initieert verbeterprojecten binnen Marketing, Sales, Operations, Installation, Support & Service, Software en andere teams en zorgt voor een duidelijke eigenaar, doelstelling, deadlines en kwaliteitsstandaard. Je bewaakt de voortgang en het resultaat van deze verbeterprojecten en zorgt dat afgesproken verbeteringen daadwerkelijk worden gerealiseerd. Cross-functionele CX-projecten die over meerdere teams heen lopen, leid je in principe zelf van analyse tot implementatie. Je meet na implementatie of verbeteringen daadwerkelijk het gewenste effect op de customer experience hebben gehad. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onze aanpak rondom Google Reviews en Trustpilot: je zorgt dat reviews snel en goed worden beantwoord, dat problemen bij de juiste eigenaar terechtkomen en dat noodzakelijke opvolging snel plaatsvindt. Hoe ziet succes eruit? Makkelijk van het gas af. Dat moet de ervaring van onze klanten zijn gedurende de hele customer journey. Na de belangrijkste onderdelen van deze journey vragen we onze klanten actief om feedback. De scores op deze customer feedback vormen belangrijke KPI’s voor deze rol en laten zien waar de ervaring goed is en waar deze beter moet. Onze Google- en Trustpilot-scores zijn belangrijke overkoepelende KPI’s voor de totale customer experience. Het doel is daarbij niet alleen om scores te verbeteren, maar vooral om de onderliggende customer experience structureel beter te maken. Daarom kijken we ook naar hoe snel en goed customer feedback en reviews worden opgevolgd, hoeveel structurele customer pain points we oplossen en hoe snel en met welke kwaliteit de belangrijkste CX-improvement projecten worden gerealiseerd. Wie zoeken we? We zoeken iemand die continu ziet hoe het beter kan en vervolgens zorgt dat het ook beter wordt. Je combineert een hoge kwaliteitsstandaard en sterk analytisch vermogen met executiekracht. Je kunt diep de details induiken, maar ook bepalen waar de grootste impact ligt en op senior niveau door de hele organisatie verbeteringen realiseren. Je hebt: Meerdere jaren relevante ervaring binnen customer experience, customer operations, customer journey management, process improvement, projectmanagement of een vergelijkbare rol. Wat je aantoonbaar hebt gerealiseerd vinden we daarbij belangrijker dan je functietitel. Ervaring met het verbeteren van customer journeys en processen, bij voorkeur in een snelgroeiende B2C-omgeving met een complexe operationele customer journey. Aantoonbare ervaring met het omzetten van customer feedback en data naar concrete verbeteringen. Een sterk analytisch vermogen: je kunt individuele klachten onderscheiden van structurele problemen, komt tot de root cause en weet waar je de meeste impact kunt maken. Een uitzonderlijk oog voor detail en een hoge kwaliteitsstandaard. Je ziet inconsistenties, spelfouten, onduidelijke communicatie en afwijkingen van onze branding die anderen missen. Ook wanneer klanten tevreden zijn en duidelijke feedback opdroogt, blijf je zoeken naar hoe de customer experience nog beter kan. Sterke projectmanagementvaardigheden. Je brengt structuur aan, maakt ownership en deadlines expliciet en krijgt meerdere verbeterinitiatieven daadwerkelijk over de finish. De senioriteit en overtuigingskracht om stakeholders op verschillende niveaus te challengen en accountable te houden, ook wanneer zij niet aan jou rapporteren. Een hands-on mentaliteit. Je vindt het prima om zelf een review te beantwoorden, een process map uit te pluizen of een (kleiner) project van A tot Z uit te voeren als dat nodig is. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels. Duits is een plus. Ervaring in een scale-up, consumer tech, energy, mobility, home services of een andere omgeving met een complexe operationele customer journey is een sterke plus. Wat wij bieden Een sleutelrol waarin je direct invloed hebt op hoe duizenden klanten DeWarmte ervaren. Veel verantwoordelijkheid en ownership vanaf dag één, met een organisatiebreed mandaat en een directe rapportagelijn naar de CEO. Een salaris van €4.500 tot €5.700 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring, plus deelname aan ons SAR-programma waarmee je meedeelt in de waardeontwikkeling van DeWarmte. Een snelgroeiende scale-upomgeving waarin nog lang niet alles vastligt en je dus echt kunt bouwen. De kans om nauw samen te werken met de CEO en Heads van de verschillende teams en je snel verder te ontwikkelen in het leiden van verbeteringen door de hele organisatie. Een ambitieus team dat samenwerkt aan een duidelijke missie: zoveel mogelijk woningen van het gas afhalen. Gezamenlijke lunches op kantoor. Hybride werken: 3 dagen op kantoor, 2 dagen waar jij wilt. title: Lead Controls & Data Engineer
description: At DeWarmte, we develop technology that helps homes move away from gas. Our heat pumps combine hardware, embedded control software, cloud services and data—and the quality of the software connecting those elements directly determines how well our products perform in customers’ homes. We are looking for a Lead Controls & Data Engineer to take ownership of two foundations of our products: the control software that operates our heat pumps and the data platform that helps us monitor, understand and improve them. This is a hands-on leadership role. Initially, most of your time will be spent writing code, diagnosing real-world behaviour, improving reliability and delivering new functionality. At the same time, you are in the lead for collaborating with external partners, ensuring data reliability and scalability. Additionally, you will build the technical foundations, documentation and team that move us away from dependence on any one engineer. Your mission Build reliable, scalable controls and data capability that is owned by a team—not an individual. You will inherit working systems and products already operating in the field. Your job is to understand them deeply, keep them running, improve their performance and evolve their architecture. You will then recruit and develop the engineers needed to create durable, shared ownership. What you'll do Own and improve our control software Work directly in the production code that controls our heat pumps. Design, build, test and deploy new control functionality. Improve product performance, stability, safety and energy efficiency. Diagnose and understand complex behaviour across software, electronics, sensors, hydraulics and the physical installation. Manage controlled software rollouts across both new products and the installed fleet. Establish appropriate automated testing, simulation, observability and release practices. Current stack includes Bash/Shell, Python, Kafka, Telegraf and Influx. You will own the evolution of the stack together with our Hardware R&D team. Build our product data platform Take technical ownership of the systems that collect, process and expose data from our connected smart heat pumps. Make product behaviour and fleet trends observable for engineering, service and product teams. Improve the quality, reliability and accessibility of operational data. Ensure pipeline and server capabilities are able to handle rapid scaling. Create the foundations for performance analysis, remote diagnostics and continuous product improvement. Define clear interfaces between device software, cloud systems, the customer app and internal tools. Build a team and eliminate key-person dependency Turn implicit knowledge into clear documentation, tooling and repeatable engineering practices. Design systems that other engineers can intuitively understand, easily test and safely change. Define the roles and capabilities the team will need as DeWarmte scales. Recruit, onboard and mentor controls, embedded-software and data engineers. Introduce effective code reviews, technical decision-making and shared operational ownership. Gradually move from being the primary implementer to leading a capable team—without losing touch with the code. Work across the product You will collaborate closely with colleagues in hardware, software, data, product development, assembly, installation and service. You will help resolve immediate customer and operational issues while protecting the long-term quality of the platform. What success looks like In your first months You understand the existing controls, data flows and operational risks. You can independently maintain, debug and release the current systems. The most important technical risks and knowledge gaps are visible and prioritised. Monitoring, documentation and development practices begin to improve. As the role develops New control functionality can be delivered predictably and safely. You work closely together with Hardware colleagues, developing the next generation of products Product data supports faster diagnosis and better engineering decisions. Critical systems are understood and maintained by more than one person. A small, strong controls and data team is in place, with clear ownership and effective ways of working. DeWarmte is no longer dependent on a single engineer to operate or evolve this part of the product. What we are looking for Strong hands-on software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems. Experience developing control or embedded software for physical products, machines or connected devices. A track record of taking functionality through design, implementation, testing, deployment and real-world operation. The ability to reason across software, hardware and physical-system behaviour. Experience working with telemetry, time-series data, data pipelines or connected-device platforms. Strong engineering fundamentals, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability and structured incident resolution. The ability to create clarity in an environment where systems and processes are still developing. Experience mentoring engineers and improving how a team works. The ambition and ability to recruit and lead a team while remaining highly hands-on. Experience with heat pumps, HVAC systems, safety-critical design, fleet-management systems or optimisation is valuable, but we care more about your ability to learn a complex physical product and take genuine end-to-end ownership. How you work You solve urgent problems without allowing permanent workarounds to become the architecture. You explain complex technical matters clearly to people with different backgrounds. You balance reliability today with the investments needed to scale tomorrow. You share knowledge by default and measure success by what the team can own without you. You are comfortable switching between debugging a specific installation, reviewing architecture and interviewing a future teammate. You are able to maintain alignment between your own team’s development roadmap and the roadmap of other product teams. What you will get Direct influence on technology that contributes to the energy transition. Ownership of software and data that sit at the heart of a real physical product. The opportunity to shape both the technical platform and the team around it. A role that starts deeply hands-on and grows into broader engineering leadership. Close collaboration with colleagues across the complete product lifecycle. What we offer A monthly gross salary between €4.500 and €6.000, based on full-time. 27 vacation days plus 8% holiday allowance Participation in our SAR (Stock Appreciation Rights) programme Plenty of ownership and responsibility from day one The opportunity to shape products that directly contribute to the energy transition A talented, ambitious, and highly collaborative team A healthy daily lunch at the office Laptop and everything you need to do your best work Regular team events, company drinks, our annual beach day, and winter trip Lots of room to grow, develop yourself, and make a lasting impact Interested? Do you want to build the software, data platform and engineering team behind the next generation of DeWarmte heat pumps? We would like to meet you. Compensation: €4.5K – €6K per month • €4.5K – €6K per month Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Open source contributions, or writing and talks on cloud, platform or distributed systems. Het beheren van wereldwijde infrastructuur voor gaming en zakelijke klanten brengt grote verantwoordelijkheden met zich mee. Onze klanten vertrouwen erop dat wij hun diensten en gegevens beschermen. Tegelijkertijd vragen regelgeving zoals NIS2 en normenkaders zoals ISO 27001 ons om aan te tonen dat onze beheersmaatregelen goed zijn ingericht én in de praktijk effectief werken. Je bepaalt de strategische richting, adviseert het senior management en bouwt onze Governance, Risk & Compliance-functie verder uit. Daarbij blijf je voldoende betrokken bij de dagelijkse operatie om te begrijpen wat er binnen de organisatie speelt en vereisten te vertalen naar praktische, werkbare oplossingen. In deze invloedrijke rol help je i3D.net om de informatiebeveiliging te versterken, zich voor te bereiden op toekomstige ontwikkelingen in wet- en regelgeving en een schaalbare GRC-functie op te bouwen voor de komende jaren. Wat je gaat doen GRC-strategie en roadmap : Je ontwikkelt en realiseert een meerjarige roadmap voor Governance, Risk & Compliance, afgestemd op onze bedrijfsstrategie, internationale activiteiten en veranderende wet- en regelgeving. Leiderschap en teamontwikkeling : Je geeft leiding aan het GRC-team, coacht collega’s en ondersteunt de verdere ontwikkeling van het team. Je biedt duidelijke richting en helpt minder ervaren collega’s bij hun professionele groei. Compliance en regelgeving : Je vertaalt regelgeving zoals NIS2 en de Nederlandse Cyberbeveiligingswet naar praktisch beleid, beheersmaatregelen, trainingen en acties binnen de organisatie. Certificeringen en audits : Je leidt of coördineert certificeringstrajecten, gap-analyses, interne en externe audits en de gestructureerde opvolging van bevindingen. Internationale governance : Je ondersteunt compliance binnen onze internationale organisatie en werkt samen met stakeholders in Nederland, Frankrijk, Canada en de Verenigde Staten, en met ons moederbedrijf Ubisoft. Praktische ondersteuning : Je bent bereid om waar nodig zelf operationeel bij te dragen, terwijl je de strategische en leidinggevende focus van je rol bewaakt. Relevante normenkaders en regelgeving Bij i3D.net werk je met of draag je bij aan: Informatiebeveiliging : ISO 27001 en de verdere ontwikkeling van ons managementsysteem voor informatiebeveiliging (ISMS). Privacy en gegevensbescherming : ISO 27701 en relevante privacyvereisten. Assurance : SOC 2, bij voorkeur met ervaring met SOC 2 Type II. Risicomanagement en regelgeving : NIS2, de Nederlandse Cyberbeveiligingswet en andere relevante Europese en nationale vereisten. Aanvullende normen : Ervaring met NEN 7510, ISO 9001 of ISO 50001 is waardevol. Audits en beheersmaatregelen : Interne en externe audits, het toetsen van beheersmaatregelen, gap-analyses, risicoregisters en het beheren van bewijsmateriaal. Je hebt het ISMS versterkt en ervoor gezorgd dat beleid, beheersmaatregelen, documentatie en bewijsmateriaal goed worden bijgehouden. Je hebt belangrijke certificerings- en audittrajecten succesvol ondersteund en een gestructureerde aanpak opgezet voor het opvolgen van bevindingen. Je hebt de verantwoordelijkheden en de samenwerking tussen GRC, Security, Technology en het senior management verduidelijkt. Je hebt het GRC-team verder ontwikkeld en collega’s geholpen om met meer vertrouwen en zelfstandigheid te werken. Je hebt verbeterd hoe informatiebeveiligings- en compliancerisico’s aan de directie worden toegelicht en worden vertaald naar zakelijke beslissingen. Je hebt i3D.net en SmartDC voorbereid op relevante ontwikkelingen in wet- en regelgeving, waaronder NIS2 en de Nederlandse Cyberbeveiligingswet. Je bent uitgegroeid tot een betrouwbare en deskundige adviseur voor het senior management en stakeholders binnen de hele organisatie. Certificeringen : CISM heeft een sterke voorkeur vanwege de brede focus op management en governance. CISSP of vergelijkbare kwalificaties op senior niveau zijn eveneens zeer relevant. High ownership and real technical depth: You’ll design systems, not just implement them, and take full ownership from idea to production. Competitive Perks : Enjoy great pay, shift bonuses, an annual bonus, 25 vacation days (excluding national holidays), travel allowance, and a premium-free pension. Skill Development : Level up with career guidance and education reimbursement. title: Backend Engineer
description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The opportunity: Backend Engineer As a Backend Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the platform infrastructure that powers our products. You will work closely with our Frontend Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and other stakeholders to design and build scalable, reliable, and high-performance products. Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance to our office in Amsterdam. What you'll do in this role: Design and implement scalable and reliable backend systems and infrastructure to support our products Develop and maintain our micro-services to expose platform functionality to internal and external clients Collaborate with development and quality assurance teams to ensure high availability, scalability, and security of our systems Collaborate with DevOps Engineers to ensure the continuous delivery and deployment of software products Work with software developers to identify and implement improvements to our platform architecture and functionality Develop and maintain documentation of our systems and processes Mentor and train junior members of the backend team Keep up-to-date with the latest trends and technologies What you bring to the table: Proficiency in Python programming language 3+ years of experience in the related field Experience with relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle Experience with the cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and as part of a team Strong communication skills and the ability to work with stakeholders across the organization Excellent English communication skills What success in the first 6 months looks like: You’ve built trust with Product, Frontend, and DevOps peers and taken clear ownership of 2-3 domain APIs/services, including stewardship of their contracts and SLAs. You’ve established an API-first workflow: starting from use cases, you propose and socialize OpenAPI specs, align on naming and conventions, then implement in FastAPI with Pydantic models. You’ve delivered impactful API features end-to-end (design → implementation → tests → docs) that are consumed by internal and external clients without hand-holding. You’ve raised API robustness: strong request/response validation, consistent error models, pagination and idempotency where appropriate, and backward-compatible versioning enforced via automated contract tests in CI (ruff, Poetry, pre-commit). You’ve improved the reliability and performance of our service by adding meaningful observability (metrics, logs, tracing) and defining SLIs/SLOs for key endpoints—reducing 5xx rates and improving p95 latency. You’ve made safe database changes in MySQL with SQLAlchemy migrations, optimized critical queries, and contributed to data access patterns involving DynamoDB or Neo4j while keeping API contracts stable. You’ve strengthened the security of APIs (authN/authZ boundaries, scoped tokens, least-privilege access, secrets management, rate limiting) and documented the approach. You’ve written clear API documentation and examples (e.g., snippets/collections), shared knowledge with the team, and mentored junior engineers so others can build on your work. Current tech stack: We are fully cloud-native, leveraging AWS and adopting a Lean, API-first product development approach driven by modern cloud technologies and thoughtful design practices. Our backend applications are built using Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy (MySQL). On the front end, we predominantly develop with Angular and also utilize Headless Wagtail and WordPress for select products. To ensure code quality and a consistent release pipeline, we employ GitHub Actions for CI/CD along with tools like Renovate, ruff, Poetry, and pre-commit. We containerize our applications using Docker and Docker Compose. Currently, we are transitioning from AWS Lambda-based deployments to Kubernetes-managed services and moving from AWS CloudFormation to Terraform for infrastructure as code. We continue to expand our capabilities in knowledge graphs (Neo4j) and database technologies (MySQL, DynamoDB). What we offer: Impactful work that helps patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments. International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organizational structure that encourages creativity and accountability. Competitive salary, annual performance bonus and an Employee Stock Option Plan. Great career development opportunities in a fast-growing company. Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions. Attractive pension plan, full premium covered by myTomorrows. Hybrid working model. Policies to support working parents. Healthy lunch at the thriving Amsterdam office. Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists via OpenUp Enjoy monthly events hosted by our vibrant Culture Club as well as an annual ‘myTomorrowland’ company-wide celebration! Equal opportunities myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

This is one of the last great frontiers of travel to come online, and as the category leader, we are at the forefront of this change. Last year alone, our platform was trusted by 8,000 organizers to lead over a million travelers on adventures in 150+ countries. That's especially the case for group travel and multi-day travel (think of a 7-day safari in the Serengeti, a 5-day scuba diving trip in the Galápagos, or a multi-week pilgrimage) where travelers get to really immerse themselves. Passionate travel organizers make this magic happen, and WeTravel is here to support them. Multi-day travel businesses use WeTravel as their end-to-end operating system : publishing trip offerings, generating and converting leads, processing payments around the world, paying suppliers and vendors. WeTravel helps them grow sales, save time, and save money, so they can focus on delivering incredible bucket-list experiences. WeTravel is a 400+ person company representing more than 50 countries. We combine global diversity with the agility and closeness of a much smaller team. More than 90 colleagues are based in our Amsterdam office in Rokin, including the entire Product Org and most of our Engineering team. You will have fun innovating fast with brilliant, low-ego colleagues. Our clients are also easy to reach, which helps us stay close to their needs and build with them. Financially, WeTravel is highly secure and growing fast, with 50 to 100 percent year-over-year growth depending on the metric. This gives us a strong foundation to build from. About the Role This is the domain where our biggest bet is playing out. Building and selling a great multi-day trip is a lot of work: crafting a story worth booking, assembling the content that tells it, and presenting it all in a page a traveler trusts. Our goal is to cut that turnaround down so organizers get back to their client faster, convert more of them, and sell more trips. It also has to hold up as they grow, because a boutique agency selling bespoke trips and a student travel operator running hundreds of departures are building on the same tools. The way we get there is great technology in the hands of organizers and their teams. You will own that end to end, the experience and the engine behind it. What you'll work on WeTravel Trips give organizers the tools to create proposals, detailed itineraries and a high-conversion booking experience, while giving them time back to grow and operate their business. We're now looking for a Staff PM to take this domain through its next phase of growth, and make WeTravel the best software for travel businesses to build, present and sell their trips. Our success in this domain will drive the growth of our organizers by expanding in several areas: An integrated building experience that helps organizers find the right content and craft the right trip for the right travelers. Shared libraries that pay off most when a team works from them, so every proposal that leaves the company is consistent, beautiful, and unmistakably theirs, whoever wrote it. AI-enabled tools to imagine and create new trips, produce world class content, and optimize their sales funnel. Trip pages organizers can publish and promote wherever their travelers are. 1/ Designing the trip page and selling the trip Think of the trip page as the product detail page of the travel industry. It is where an organizer's work becomes something a traveler wants, understands, and buys. Dynamic Trip Builder: Intuitive tools for organizers to create their trip offerings, in the languages their travelers read, on WeTravel and beyond it. Day by day itineraries: the plan that makes a trip feel real before anyone has booked it, built fast and kept accurate as the trip changes. High converting pages and proposals: whether an organizer publishes a trip for the world or sends a tailored proposal to one client, the result has to look professional, capture travelers' imaginations, and turn interest into a booking. Mobile app for travelers: once they have booked, travelers carry the trip page in their pocket, with everything they need before and during it. 2/ The content and AI engine that turns hours of work into minutes WeTravel Library: a curated library of properties, activities, and reusable content on its way to 20,000 properties, so organizers build with high quality content. The organizer's own library: their photos, their descriptions, their reusable blocks, so a growing team sells in one voice instead of rewriting content from scratch. AI-assisted building: Copilot that drafts and improves trips inside the builder, so organizers start from a strong draft rather than an empty page. And the team behind it. Our content specialists will report to you, and you will own the content strategy, the regional prioritization, and the pipeline that keeps the library growing. I'm looking for an experienced, generalist product manager to lead this domain end-to-end. You will deeply study travel organizers' needs, prioritize them, come up with solutions (or hypotheses to test), drive all necessary functions to build and launch the solutions, drive adoption, and ultimately grow our revenue and profit. You will also manage our content team, and you will have direct and continuous access to C-level executives to ideate and create products. If you've ever wanted to empower businesses with innovative tech and have fun in a well-funded rocketship in the heart of Amsterdam, this is it. An Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate would bring a track record of exceptional results and a well-rounded product management skill set, especially the ability to break down any problem and drive high-velocity execution. Must-haves: Deep product management experience owning real outcomes, not just execution. 10+ years in product management is ideal (for staff level) 7+ years is minimum (for senior level) Travel industry knowledge. Comfortable being accountable for product-led commercial outcomes, not just features shipped. Strong cross-functional stakeholder leadership across sales / account management, engineering, design. Growth and experimentation mindset , with the judgment to decide without perfect data. Willing to ship, learn, and iterate. Data self-sufficient. You can pull your own numbers, find where a funnel leaks, and size the opportunity before asking for engineering time. Things that will likely help you in this particular role: You have owned a builder, editor or CMS-like product where the artifact your users create is what earns them money. You have shipped AI features that people kept using, and you can tell the difference between a good demo and real adoption. You have treated content as product, not as someone else's job, and have worked with or led a content operation. Experience with public APIs, webhooks, or platform work. Experience managing people, even a small team or a dotted line. Interview process Our process aims to be high-signal and help you learn about WeTravel and our people. Two interviews will be realistic working sessions. No take-home assignments. The whole process will take only a few weeks. Screen Recruiter screen (30 min): introduction, background, motivation. 1st round Hiring manager interview (60 min): your background in depth, the role, your questions. 2nd round Live whiteboard session (60 min, onsite): a real Trips decision worked through together, for example Trip page redesign, Copilot scope, or Library content prioritization. Assesses structured thinking, clear reasoning out loud, and product judgment under incomplete information. Team working session (45 min): with a Product Manager, an Engineering Manager, and a Designer: Working through your product management experience, plus a UX collaboration exercise. 3rd round CEO conversation (30 min): A two-way discussion about mission, ambition, and culture. A Final Note Our clients are entrepreneurs and artisans who pour their passion into creating bucket-list experiences. Helping them grow their businesses is what motivates us, and what would motivate the right PM for the Trips domain. If that resonates, I'd love to meet you.
